title: Slagtermester MENY´s Køkken - MENY Sæby – stå i spidsen for en succesafdeling
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for vores store og flotte slagterafdeling i MENY´S Køkken?

Brænder du for godt slagterhåndværk, stærke resultater og glade medarbejdere?

Vil du lede et dygtigt team af medarbejdere og sætte dit præg på en afdeling med store ambitioner?

Så er du måske vores nye slagtermester i MENY Sæby.

Velkommen til en slagterafdeling med succes og store ambitioner

I MENY Sæby bliver du en del af et yderst velfungerende MENYs Køkken, hvor kvalitet, madglæde og godt håndværk er fundamentet for vores succes.

Hos os er vi rigtige slagtere. Vi brænder for fersk kød, professionelle udskæringer og gode madoplevelser. Vi vil være kundernes foretrukne kulinariske fyrtårn, hvor faglighed, inspiration og personlig betjening gør forskellen.

Bliv leder for et stærkt team af MADarbejdere

I MENY kalder vi vores medarbejdere for MADarbejdere – og hos os bliver du leder for et engageret og fagligt stærkt team, der hver dag gør en forskel for vores kunder.

Vi tror på, at fortsat succes skabes gennem mennesker. Derfor søger vi en slagtermester, der ikke alene kan skabe resultater, men som også prioriterer medarbejdertrivsel, sammenhold og udvikling højt.

Stort ansvar, stor frihed og store muligheder

Som slagtermester får du ansvaret for at videreudvikle en afdeling, der allerede står stærkt. Du får stor indflydelse på sortiment, koncepter og den daglige drift – og frihed til at sætte dit eget præg på afdelingens fortsatte udvikling.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:

  • Lede, motivere og udvikle afdelingens dygtige medarbejdere med særligt fokus på trivsel og arbejdsglæde
  • Sikre fortsat høj vækst gennem stærkt købmandskab, kvalitet og attraktive kundeoplevelser
  • Videreudvikle sortiment, koncepter og inspirerende måltidsløsninger
  • Sikre høj faglighed, effektiv drift og stærke rutiner i hverdagen
  • Være en synlig og aktiv del af både produktionen og kundebetjeningen.

Er du vores nye slagtermester?

Du er uddannet detailslagter og brænder for dit håndværk.

Måske er du allerede slagtermester og klar til en større udfordring. Måske er du en dygtig mestersvend med lederpotentiale og ambitioner om at tage næste skridt.

Det vigtigste er, at du:

  • Er en engageret og nærværende leder, der sætter mennesker først
  • Kan skabe følgeskab, arbejdsglæde og stærke resultater gennem dit team
  • Har et stærkt købmandsgen og motiveres af vækst og udvikling
  • Brænder for kvalitet, gode kundeoplevelser og det stolte slagterhåndværk.

title: Studentermedhjælpere til Kontor for Statens Business Intelligence i Økonomistyrelsen
description:
Ønsker du et studierelevant job, hvor du får praktisk erfaring med offentlig administration, data og statslige it-systemer? Har du gåpåmod og trives med at arbejde struktureret og selvstændigt? Så er du måske den, vi søger til Kontoret for Statens Business Intelligence (Statens BI).

Om stillingen

I Økonomistyrelsen søger vi engagerede studentermedhjælpere til Kontor for Statens BI. Her arbejder vi med drift og udvikling af centrale fællesstatslige løsninger, der understøtter styring og drift på tværs af staten. Afhængigt af din profil og interesse kommer du til at bidrage til den daglige drift af kontoret og de systemer, vi arbejder med, samt til tværgående opgaver, der understøtter den fælles opgaveløsning på tværs af styrelsen. Du kan være i starten af dit studie eller allerede have erfaring fra et tidligere job - det er ikke det vigtigste for os. Det afgørende er, at du kan arbejde struktureret, tager ansvar for og leverer dine opgaver.

Læs mere om Økonomistyrelsens digitale løsninger her:

Dine opgaver kan fx være, at

  • understøtte og koordinere tværgående processer, herunder planlægge og følge op på leverancer

  • udarbejde præsentationer og materiale til møder, workshops og træning.

  • løse administrative opgaver inden for løn, økonomi, indkøb og HR, fx budgetopfølgning og fakturahåndtering

  • Vedligeholde og kvalitetssikre data og lister samt håndtere udsendelser, opfølgning og øvrige administrative opgaver

  • udarbejde og opdatere system-, proces-, arkitektur- og forretningsdokumentation

  • bidrage til kommunikation fra styrelsen og koncernen, fx vedligeholde indhold på oes.dk og udarbejde nyheder til interne og eksterne interessenter

  • understøtte implementering af løsninger hos kunder, fx planlægge opsætning og konfiguration

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du læser en relevant videregående uddannelse, fx inden for statskundskab, økonomi, sociologi, offentlig forvaltning eller IT. Du kan være i starten af dit studie eller have erfaring fra et tidligere job. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at sætte dig ind i nye opgaver og bidrage til arbejdet med løsninger, der bruges på tværs af staten.

I stillingen skal du både kunne løse dine egne opgaver og samarbejde med kollegaer om fælles leverancer. Du kommunikerer klart mundtligt og skriftligt, uanset om du udarbejder mødemateriale, dokumentation eller indhold til interne og eksterne interessenter. Du er fortrolig med Office-pakken, særligt Excel og PowerPoint, og har en generel IT-forståelse.

Hvad lægger vi særligt vægt på?

  • Du arbejder struktureret og kan holde styr på opgaver, leverancer og deadlines.
  • Du tager ansvar, følger op og sikrer, at dine opgaver bliver løst.
  • Du er nysgerrig og kan sætte dig ind i nye arbejdsområder og digitale løsninger.
  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, men spørger om sparring, når du har brug for det.
  • Du er engageret og bidrager positivt til samarbejdet med dine kollegaer.

Om os

Vi er 25 kollegaer i Statens BI på Landgreven i Københavm, der sætter pris på godt samarbejde, sparring og data. Derudover har vi også en filmklub, der fokuserer på klassikere inden for forskellige genrer, og det sker, vi tager en fredagsøl.

Vi tilbyder et udviklende studiejob med ansvar og fleksibilitet, så arbejdet kan hænge sammen med dit studie. Du får praktisk erfaring med offentlig administration, data og digitale løsninger og mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og gradvist få mere ansvar. Du får også mulighed for at bidrage til at forbedre arbejdsgange og processer i et godt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede og hjælpsomme kollegaer.

Hos os betyder tilstedeværelse sammen med vores kollegaer meget, og vi mener, at samarbejde og videndeling på tværs af styrelsen er afgørende for et godt arbejdsmiljø. Samtidig vil vi gerne sikre fleksibilitet for vores medarbejdere, og hjemmearbejde kan løbende aftales mellem chef og medarbejder, når det er foreneligt med opgavevaretagelsen.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Vi forventer en arbejdstid på ca. 15 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge, men med mulighed for fleksibilitet i eksamensperioder, ligesom der i perioder kan være mulighed for at arbejde mere end 15 timer.

Du ansættes efter fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det statslige område (OAO-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for Kontorfunktionærer, Laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) i staten.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og efterfølgende kan opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen i hele din ansættelsesperiode. Du vil i forbindelse med ansættelsen blive bedt om at fremsende en privat straffeattest, som du rekvirerer via , eller ved fysisk fremmøde på din lokale politistation. Vi fortæller mere om dette undervejs i ansættelsesforløbet.

Det er derudover en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du er aktivt studerende.

Ansættelsesområdet er Finansministeriet med tilhørende institutioner: Finansministeriets departement, Statens Administration, Statens It, Medarbejder- og Kompetencestyrelsen samt Økonomistyrelsen.

Yderligere oplysninger

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fuldmægtig Line Gravesen på tlf. 23 82 70 25 eller mail lingra@oes.dk.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag via knappen ”Søg stillingen” senest den 20. november 2026.

Du er velkommen til at bruge AI til din ansøgning. Vedhæft dog gerne dit prompt, så vi kan se, hvilken tankegang, du har brugt.

Finansministeriet ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle interesserede kandidater uanset personlig baggrund til at søge. Vi ser frem til at læse din ansøgning.

title: Advanced Mech Design Engr
description:
We are seeking a motivated Materials Obsolescence (MO) Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing material and component obsolescence throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring continuity of supply, minimizing production disruption, and supporting product sustainment activities.

The role requires close collaboration with Product Engineering, Component Engineering, Supply Chain, Supplier Engineering, Program Management, and cross-functional Obsolescence Management Teams to proactively identify obsolescence risks and drive effective resolution strategies. Responsibilities align with the governance and lifecycle management principles described in

Key Responsibilities Obsolescence Risk Management

  • Monitor obsolescence forecasts, End-of-Life (EOL) notifications, Product Change Notifications (PCNs), and supplier lifecycle updates impacting products and programs.
  • Perform obsolescence assessments on Bills of Materials (BOMs) and identify components or materials at risk.
  • Support product teams in evaluating the impact of obsolescence on product lines and production schedules.

Resolution Development

  • Work with Product Engineering, Integrated Supply Chain (ISC), Component Engineering, and site Obsolescence Management Teams to identify suitable drop-in replacements, alternate materials, and alternate sources.
  • Evaluate technical compatibility and suitability of replacement materials or components.
  • Support redesign initiatives when alternate solutions are not available.

Engineering Change Management

  • Process and support Engineering Change Requests (ECRs), Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), and related change documentation required to implement obsolescence solutions.
  • Maintain technical documentation, traceability, and system records associated with obsolescence resolution activities.

Supply Chain & Supplier Engagement

  • Collaborate with suppliers to obtain lifecycle status, availability information, and continuity plans.
  • Support Last Time Buy (LTB), bridge buy, and inventory planning activities for obsolescence mitigation. These terms are defined within the internal governance documentation.
  • Partner with Supplier Engineering and Procurement teams to reduce supply chain risk.

Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure alignment with internal obsolescence governance guidelines and engineering processes.
  • Verify compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, purchase order requirements, and product traceability requirements.
  • Support audits and reviews by maintaining objective evidence, documentation, and process compliance records.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop obsolescence risk reports, dashboards, and management summaries.
  • Track key metrics related to risk exposure, resolution status, and program impact.

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen obsolescence management processes

Required Qualifications Education

  • Bachelor's Degree /Masters Degree/ Phd in:
    • Materials Engineering
    • Metallurgical Engineering
    • Mechanical Engineering
    • Aerospace Engineering
    • Or related engineering discipline

Experience

  • 8-12 years of experience in:
    • Materials Engineering
    • Component Engineering
    • Obsolescence Management
    • Aerospace, Industrial, Electronics, or High-Reliability Manufacturing Industries

title: Head of Stock Investment NCCHS
description:
Role: Head of Stock Investment

Contract Type: Permanent

Working Hours: 37 hours per week

Worker Type: Hybrid Worker

Salary: Grade SLMG 5 – starting salary of £63,466 per annum (level 1), rising to £66,147 per annum (level 4).

Location: Loxley House, NG2 3NG

We’ve got an exciting opportunity available for a talented individual to join our workforce as the Head of Stock Investment - perhaps this is the opportunity you’ve been looking for? Read on to find out more…

Working for Nottingham City Council has great benefits. As well as competitive pay, great leave entitlement, and access to a generous pension scheme. We strive to create an innovative, inclusive, and progressive work culture where everyone is supported to do and be their very best.

In return, we are looking for people like you - people who are innovative, driven and committed to serving and improving Nottingham. So, if you are passionate about making a difference to the lives of those who live and work in our city, we want to hear from you.

* You can read more about the different benefits offered to colleagues working for Nottingham City Council here.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and forward-thinking Head of Stock Investment to lead the strategic management and long-term investment of Nottingham City Council Housing Services' homes and assets. This is a key leadership role within our Asset Management Division and Housing Leadership Team, helping to ensure our homes are safe, sustainable, compliant and fit for the future.

You will lead the development of asset investment strategies, capital programmes and planned maintenance delivery, using high-quality stock condition data and insight to drive investment decisions. Working collaboratively across Housing Services, the wider Council and external partners, you will champion innovation, continuous improvement and resident-focused service delivery.

The role is responsible for ensuring compliance with housing legislation and regulatory standards, overseeing asset data and survey programmes, leading disrepair services, and driving the use of innovative technologies and predictive modelling to support effective asset management. You will also lead and develop multidisciplinary teams, manage significant budgets and contracts, and ensure investment priorities reflect the needs and feedback of tenants and leaseholders.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of council housing in Nottingham, delivering positive outcomes for residents while supporting the Council's commitments to equality, diversity, inclusion, sustainability and financial responsibility.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will bring a combination of strategic leadership, technical expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality housing services. We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:

  • Extensive experience (over 5 years) in strategic asset management, housing stock investment planning.
  • Proven ability to manage large-scale housing databases and deliver long-term investment programmes.

title: Vagtplanlægger til Demenscenteret Pilehuset i Brønshøj
description:
Er du verdensmester i at holde overblik, er du yderst struktureret, og er du altid et skridt foran med dine opgaver? Trives du samtidig på en travl arbejdsplads, hvor humøret er højt og det gode samarbejde er intakt?

Hos Demenscenteret Pilehuset, som er en specialiseret enhed for borgere med demens med 125 borgere og 250 ansatte fordelt på seks afdelinger, ønsker vi at frigøre endnu mere tid til vores beboere og en hverdag med oplevelser, som fremmer deres livskvalitet.

Derfor har vi brug for en ny kollega, som er vagtplanlægger, og som kan hjælpe og understøtte os i vagtplanlægning.

Som vagtplanlægger er du ansvarlig for at

  • sikre en stabil og fremadrettet vagtplanlægning i samarbejde med afdelingslederne
  • sikre effektiv vagtplanlægning i overensstemmelse med gældende overenskomster og lokalaftaler
  • sikre at vagtplanlægningen sker efter principper og standarder for god vagtplanlægning i Sundheds- og Omsorgsforvaltningen
  • sikre daglig kontakt med afdelingslederne med henblik på bedst mulig planlægning af dagen
  • supportere ledelsen med analyser og bidrage til at optimere vagtplanlægningen, så ressourcerne bruges så hensigtsmæssigt og effektivt som muligt
  • ledelsen er opdateret med hensyn til ændringer i arbejdstidsregler og vagtplanlægningssystemet i KAS
  • varetage budget/økonomi – vagtplanerne skal udfærdiges på den mest økonomiske måde
  • dagsplanerne er ajourførte og bliver fulgt
  • føre rettelser (fx sygdom) på vagtplan
  • sikre overblik over lokalaftaler og personalepolitikker af relevans for vagtplanlægningen

Som vagtplanlægger vil nogle af dine primære opgaver være at

  • forberede og understøtte før grundplanlægningen
  • udarbejde grundplan og mødeplan/dagplan (der er forskellige modeller)
  • udmelde mødeplan/dagplan
  • planlægge i forhold til ferier, perioder med høj grad af kursus og anden læringsaktivitet
  • indhente ønsker til ferier, FO, A9 m.fl., som vedrører medarbejdernes ønsker til arbejdstid
  • udbyde vagter i KAS-WEB
  • bidrage med forslag til fordeling af ressourcerne på tværs af plejehjemmet ved sygefravær
  • gennemføre ændring af en medarbejders vagtplan efter afdelingslederens accept
  • formidle forståelse og information om, hvordan en vagtplan læses
  • taste afvigelser
  • anvende Sundheds- og Omsorgsforvaltningens vagtplanlægningssystem (KAS)
  • deltage i vagtplanlæggerforummøder
  • deltage i relevante opdateringskurser
  • hjælpe og varetage vagtplanlægning på andre enheder i SUF

Vi tror på, at du lykkes i denne stilling, hvis du

  • har erfaring med vagtplanlægning – du får selvfølgelig en god introduktion til vores vagtplanlægningssystem
  • har evnen til at arbejde hurtigt og have det store forkromede overblik over store og små opgaver
  • har styr på Microsoft Office-pakken og er rutineret IT-bruger (det er ikke et krav at kende København Kommunes vagtplanssystem, men en fordel)
  • har kendskab til arbejdstidsregler og overenskomster
  • har stærke tværfaglige samarbejdskompetencer og hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i forskellige fagligheder og arbejdsgange
  • har gode analytiske evner og organisatorisk forståelse
  • kan planlægge, prioritere og er god til at arbejde struktureret
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, systematisk og bevare overblikket
  • kan lide at finde de gode løsninger
  • er selvkørende, målrettet og trives med ansvar og korte deadlines
  • har kendskab til og erfaring med overenskomster og arbejdstidsregler, samt at læse og forstå tolkningen af disse
  • er rummelig og professionel og kan gå i dialog med medarbejdere og ledere på en god og imødekommende måde
  • er nysgerrig og god til at stille de rigtige spørgsmål, så planlægningsopgaven skaber værdi for driften

Vigtigst er det, at du er en person med masser af gåpåmod, som forstår dig på at holde hovedet koldt i travle perioder og har en imødekommende og serviceminded tilgang til både mennesker og alle typer af opgaver. Og så tør du også godt selv gå foran med opgaver og lære nyt. Det er en fordel, hvis du har en uddannelse eller kendskab indenfor sundhedssektoren. Har du en anden relevant uddannelse og mener, at du har de rette kompetencer og at vagtplanlægning lyder sjovt, så hører vi gerne fra dig.

Motivation, godt humør og højt til loftet
Hvis du kommer med den rette tilgang til jobbet, får du en arbejdsplads med engagerede kollegaer, som passer på og motiverer hinanden. Du får mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt et sted, hvor der er højt til loftet og plads til, at du kan bidrage med dine gode idéer. Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi kommer glade på arbejde og spreder god stemning, og hvor ledelsen er nærværende og lyttende.

Da vi har højt til loftet, er der særligt gode muligheder for, at du kan sætte dit præg på, hvordan opgaverne løses mest effektivt.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og inden for rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med ansættelse fra den 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Mere information
Vi vil altid gerne fortælle mere om stillingen og Pilehuset, så du er mere end velkommen til at kontakte souschef Adis Crneta på 38 27 40 04.

Du kan også læse lidt mere om os her.

title: Manager - Enterprise Platform Engineering and Developer Experience
description:
Costco IT is responsible for the technical future of Costco Wholesale, the third largest retailer in the world with wholesale operations in fourteen countries. Despite our size and explosive international expansion, we continue to provide a family, employee centric atmosphere in which our employees thrive and succeed.

This is an environment unlike anything in the high-tech world and the secret of Costco’s success is its culture. The value Costco puts on its employees is well documented in articles from a variety of publishers including Bloomberg and Forbes. Our employees and our members come FIRST. Costco is well known for its generosity and community service and has won many awards for its philanthropy. The company joins with its employees to take an active role in volunteering by sponsoring many opportunities to help others.

Come join the Costco Wholesale IT family. Costco IT is a dynamic, fast-paced environment, working through exciting transformation efforts. We are building the next generation retail environment where you will be surrounded by dedicated and highly professional employees.

As a member of the IT Management Team, you are responsible for managing, developing, and leading a team of employees. Your role includes leading the specific functional responsibilities of your team, which involves overseeing team performance and deliverables. However, your role as a leader within our organization requires more than the management of resources and day-to-day operations. As a steward of the company, you are charged with the development and execution of your team’s strategic vision and plan and ensuring that your team’s actions align with the larger goals of the company and the IT Division.

The Manager of Platform Engineering & Developer Experience will lead the software development teams responsible for designing, building, and operating core platform software, internal developer tooling, and modern capabilities that enable engineering teams across our global retail operation. This crucial leadership role is focused on driving engineering velocity, reducing friction for feature teams, and building scalable shared services that simplify delivery across the enterprise. The manager will be tasked with establishing modern software engineering practices, accelerating platform adoption, embedding innovative tools (including AI-driven capabilities) into developer workflows, and fostering a culture of continuous delivery, automation, and engineering excellence. Success in this role requires a balanced blend of strategic vision, deep technical expertise in platform and software engineering, and proven leadership in developing world-class software development talent.

As the primary conduit between your employees and upper leadership, your role in communicating and modeling the values and guiding principles of our company culture is of vital importance. All members of IT Management should strive to consciously and consistently foster a culture of engagement, trust, and “open door” communication.

If you want to be a part of one of the worldwide BEST companies “to work for”, simply apply and let your career be reimagined.

ROLE

  • INTEGRITY: When achieving benchmarks and goals, use methods/strategies that are consistent with the Code of Ethics and the Standard of Ethics for Managers and Supervisors. Always leads by example. Appropriately handles employee concerns and follows through to resolution.

  • MEMBER SERVICE: Provides and ensures staff provides an exceptional member experience.

  • ADMINISTRATION: Ensures proper department coverage (writing schedule and break aids if needed). Understands department budget, able to research and explain budget variances.

  • MANAGING PERFORMANCE: Coaches and mentors’ employees to provide support and guidance. Has regular open and honest conversations with employees to discuss work performance and career development. Identifies learning opportunities to strengthen employee knowledge, skill and ability.

  • COMMUNICATION: Regularly shares information with employees via meetings and one-on-one conversations. Successfully navigates difficult conversations with employees, members, and suppliers. Listens, expresses empathy and adapts to get points across. Addresses issues immediately to ensure a timely resolution and to avoid escalating the situation. Consistently demonstrates business knowledge during interactions with senior management.

  • SELF-MANAGEMENT: Demonstrates sound judgment, taking a partner when necessary.

  • INCLUSION: Encourages different approaches and ideas to work and to accomplish goals. Seeks employee input. Takes the time to get to know or reach out to candidates who show potential that may not come forward on their own.

  • COMPLIANCE AND SAFETY: Takes measures to ensure employee and member information is kept confidential and adheres to IS security policy.

  • Oversees the technical teams that build and develop services, tools, and frameworks for our global enterprise.

  • Provides leadership, mentoring, coaching, and career development planning for team members.

  • Collaborates with team and peers to define and maintain software development standards, best practices, and departmental service level agreements (SLAs).

  • Drives all assigned projects, leveraging the project execution framework.

  • Participates in architecture, design, and code review sessions as a coordinator, owner, reader or observer.

  • Keeps current on new technology and makes recommendations to the development team on future directions.

  • Builds roadmaps and lead prioritization; balance the right amount of structure and planning for a fast-paced engineering team with many stakeholders

  • Develops, employs and increases adoption of automated internal and external tools that help improve quality, improve performance, increase deploy frequency and enhance the overall platform experience.

  • Influences others and represents technical insight about customer experience to engineers.

  • Maintains and fosters a sense of urgency within the team and the department.

  • This is a full-time management/leadership position (45+ hours per week).

REQUIRED

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or software management role overseeing platform engineering, developer enablement, or core shared services in a large-scale enterprise environment.

  • Proven experience building and operating internal developer platforms, developer tooling, or enterprise-scale shared microservices and integration platforms.

  • Demonstrated experience evaluating and integrating modern software development practices, continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and modern developer tooling (such as AI-assisted coding tools or automated development workflows).

  • Strong background in backend programming languages (e.g., Java, Go, Python, C#) and modern cloud-native architectures (microservices, containerization, distributed systems).

  • Expertise in leading software teams through modern Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and building clear product roadmaps for platform engineering capabilities.

  • Experience establishing developer experience metrics (e.g., deployment frequency, lead time for changes, platform adoption rates) to measure efficiency gains.

  • Computer Science, Business, or related degree and/or professional certification(s) or equivalent work experience.

  • Must be detail-oriented and thorough, with the ability to think "big picture" and understand key trends driving retail and enterprise modernization.

  • Extremely responsive, with a strong sense of urgency.

  • Scheduling flexibility to meet the needs of the business, including support for global platform availability.

  • HIPAA Training and Supervisors Orientation (within 30 days of hire); Leadership Development 101 (within one year); Costco Pay Policies (within 90 days of promotion).

Recommended

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Sciences, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.

  • Proficient in Google Workspace applications, including Sheets, Docs, Slides, and Gmail.

Required Documents

● Resume

title: CMA - Family
description:
Title: Clinical Medical Assistant (CMA)

Reports to: Nurse Manager

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
Personnel Supervised: None


POSITION SUMMARY:

The Clinical Medical Assistant is responsible for providing direct and indirect patient care in the clinic under the direction and supervision of the Nurse Manager. The CMA is expected to work well with every member of the clinical team in order to ensure optimal outcomes for patients’ health. This position requires strong teamwork and communication skills.

MINIMAL QUALIFICATIONS:

Graduate of a Medical Assistant Program from an accredited school

Certification: Clinical Medical Assistants must be Certified or Registered through of the below accrediting bodies and must maintain current certification throughout employment:

American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA) - CMA

American Medical Technologists (AMT) - RMA

American Medical Certification Association (AMCA) – CMAC

National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT) – NCMA

National Healthcareer Association (NHA) - CCMA

BLS Certification

Experience preferred

Computer literacy



RESPONSIBILTIES AND PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS include, but are not limited to, the following:

Be familiar with CFHC’s program philosophies, goals and objectives. Be cognizant of and comply with all CFHC’s policies and procedures, as well as state and federal regulations.

Be competent in performing the duties of a medical assistant.

Understand the requirements of CFHC’s Exposure Control Plan. Personally, utilize universal precautions when practicing in a clinical setting.

Participate in staff outreach and off-site health care programs as requested by the CCO or CEO. Represent CFHC in the community.

Report as needed to CMO any pertinent information or situations that impact on patient care or CFHC liability.

Attend and participate in mandatory CFHC meetings (Center Specific meetings, Corporate meetings, and other meetings as designated by the CMO or CEO).

Demonstrate ability to work cooperatively with other members of the clinical team. Be supportive of coworkers.

Always maintain a neat and professional appearance.

Carry out any other activities deemed appropriate by the CMO or CEO.

Knowledge of the information and techniques needed to diagnose and treat human injuries, diseases, and deformities including symptoms, treatment alternatives, drug properties and interactions, and preventive health measures.

Knowledge of medical recording and reporting techniques (SOAP)

Knowledge of assisting with diagnostic and treatment procedures (example, colposcopy, LEEP, ultrasound)

Knowledge of patient teaching and education (example, self-breast examination, prenatal instruction, self-blood pressure taking, nutrition instruction, infant care instruction, diabetes self-care instruction)

Knowledge of patient examination procedure

Knowledge of general patient care and treatment procedures, equipment, rules, regulations, and ethics

Knowledge of making observations of general physical condition and needs of patients and when to confer with the physician about the emotional or physical condition of a patient.

Knowledge of the principles of aseptic and sterile techniques and infection control techniques

Knowledge of the techniques of administration of common medications, including immunizations, inoculations, and allergy injections using sterile technique, and knowledge of the side effects of these medications

Ability to function with a high degree of independence and collaboration with other health care providers.

Commitment to service, quality, and departmental core values

Screen patients according to CFHC’s protocols (example, obtaining height, weight, vital signs, vision/hearing testing) and perform any other procedures directed by the supervising Clinician, Clinical Administrator, or Nurse Manager

Accurately obtain patient’s medical history

Perform accurate charting in patient’s medical record in accordance with CFHC’s policies and procedures.

Perform phlebotomy/finger stick as permitted by training.

Perform waived lab analysis and phlebotomy (example, urinalysis, pregnancy test, Hemocue)

Administer injections according to position requirements (example, subcutaneous, intramuscular, and intradermal injections)

Prepare and administer medications as directed by provider.

Perform procedures, as ordered (example, EKGs, nebulizer treatments, ear lavage)

Counsel patients per treatment plan (example, diet, exercise, medication)

Understand all emergency protocols and respond accordingly.

Maintain exam rooms and work areas (example, keeping rooms well-stocked, orderly and clean, to include disinfecting exam tables between patients as per infection control policy)

Maintain strict infection control (example, sterilizing instruments, performing procedures, needle disposal)

Accurately make/cancel/reschedule appointments in the computer appointment system. Follow-up on appointment to determine patient compliance and contact patients to reschedule (no-show policy)

Understand and assist in the referral process of patients to outside services or providers, follow-up on patient referrals.

Complete all duties, responsibilities, and competencies in a manner that is appropriate to the age groups to whom care/services are being provided.



PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Requires 80% or more time spent standing/walking.

Independently mobile.

Ability to lift weight equivalents that would be required with occasionally assisting and positioning patients, repositioning equipment, and lifting supplies.

Ability to adapt and function in varying environments of workload, patient acuity, worksites, and work shifts.

title: Sikkerhedsmedarbejder til G4S Security Services – Roskilde, Slagelse og Vordingborg
description:
Om stillingen
Til vores kunder, som er psykiatriske akutmodtagelser, søger vi et antal nye kollegaer til et fast team af sikkerhedsmedarbejdere. Der er tale om krævende stillinger med vagter på skiftende tidspunkter døgnet rundt, alle ugens dage og hele året.
Du indgår i et tæt samarbejde med personalet på stedet og indtræder i en assisterende funktion, hvor du er med til at opretholde et sikkert og trygt miljø for både patienter og personale.

Personprofil
Det er af afgørende betydning, at du er rummelig og fordomsfri, har en god situationsfornemmelse og viser en oprigtig interesse i andre mennesker. Da patienternes situationer er meget forskellige, er det vigtigt, at du er vant til at kommunikere situationsbestemt.

Som menneske hviler du godt i dig selv, er empatisk, moden og venlig. Med din rolige autoritet falder du naturligt ind i akutmodtagelsens hverdag, hvor din tilstedeværelse og opmærksomhed er afgørende. På grund af jobindholdet kræver det, at du er i god fysisk form og besidder stor psykisk robusthed.

Arbejdsopgaver
Som sikkerhedsmedarbejder er din opgave at assistere det faste personale med blandt andet konflikthåndtering, for at sikre en høj grad af tryghed og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

I den assisterende funktion på afsnittet bistår du det faste personale med enkelte daglige opgaver af ikke-behandlingmæssig karakter, samtidig med at du holder øje med sikkerheden. Assistance til naboafdelinger ved alarm indgår også i stillingsbeskrivelsen. For at sikre en god dynamik i opgaveløsningen kan der også være forskellige aktiviteter med patienterne.

Faglige kompetencer
Der er flere indgangsvinkler til stillingen, men optimalt set har du erfaring fra jobs i konfliktfyldte miljøer. Måske har du erfaring fra andre stillinger i psykiatrien, institutioner eller bosteder inden for specialområdet. Det er helt afgørende, at du ønsker at arbejde med mennesker.

Du skal have gennemført det obligatoriske AMU-grundkursus for vagtfunktionærer for at kunne komme i betragtning til stillingerne – ansøgere uden dette kommer ikke i betragtning. Desuden er det et krav, at du kan godkendes af politiet jf. lov om vagtvirksomhed, og at du har en anmærkningsfri børneattest.

Vi tilbyder
Et spændende og udfordrende job med gode udviklingsmuligheder. For at sikre, at du er klædt bedst muligt på til opgaverne, får du en særligt tilrettelagt uddannelse.

Du skal være indstillet på skiftende arbejdstider (dag, aften og nat) samt vagter i weekender og på udvalgte helligdage.

Du ansættes efter gældende overenskomst.

Er du interesseret
Har du spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder John A. Olsen på telefon 2323 4569 på hverdage mellem kl. 9.00 og 15.00.

Ansøgning og frister
Ansøgninger behandles løbende, og stillingerne forventes besat med tiltrædelse 1. marts 2027.

Der foretages baggrundstjek på sociale medier fra tid til anden, og der indhentes altid referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgivere.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at G4S udelukkende benytter elektronisk rekruttering, og det er således kun muligt at søge stillingen online via nedenstående link. Ansøgninger sendt via mail eller post kommer ikke i betragtning.

title: Senior Business Analyst, Voice of Customer Insights
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst, VoC Insights who will own the business strategy, implementation, and enablement of Lightspeed's customer health score program. You sit at the intersection of customer data, CX operations, and commercial decision-making, turning customer health signals into an accurate, robust and consistent view of account risk, retention opportunity, and expansion potential.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the strategy and implementation Lightspeed’s customer health score program, from scoring component improvements to segmentation, thresholds, and the playbooks tied to each score state. This includes leading the implementation of health score changes in our CX platform ChurnZero, partnering with key stakeholders on configuration and underlying data models.
  • Build the enablement layer for health scores across GTM, CX Ops, and leadership, including documentation, training, dashboards, and the operating cadence for how scores get reviewed and acted on. Expand the usefulness of health scoring to focus on growth and on enterprise impact beyond GTM (P&T, Finance, etc.)
  • Validate health score/sentiment performance against actual customer outcomes (renewals, churn, expansion, NPS movement) and recalibrate the model as the business evolves.
  • Translate health score/sentiment patterns into business recommendations for leadership across GTM, P&T and Finance stakeholders, with a clear point of view on where to intervene and why.
  • Lead impact analysis on CX initiatives that close customer account health gaps (customer adoption, retention, growth). You lead the analysis to provide definitive, data-backed answers on whether specific operational changes or workflows successfully moved the needle on customer behavior, retention, and LTV.
  • Supporting QBRs and executive readouts with health-score-driven account narratives, and running ad hoc deep dives when leadership needs a fast, defensible read on a cohort, segment, or risk pattern.

And a little bit of…

  • Health Score Data Accuracy: Statistical correlation between health score states and actual renewal, churn, and expansion outcomes
  • Enablement & Internal Adoption: % of GTM reps actively using health scores in their account planning, measured through ChurnZero usage
  • Customer Experience Impact: Ability to influence positive changes in customer health, retention and LTV (e.g., % of CX operational pivots, plays, or workflow changes directly attributed to health score insights surfaced)
  • System Utility: The successful "Operationalization" of ChurnZero, measured by the depth and frequency of dashboard usage by CX leadership
  • Time-to-Insight: Leadership analysis requests delivered timely and thoroughly

What You Need To Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, CX Strategy, or Ops in a high-growth SaaS environment.
  • Account Health Ownership: Direct experience designing or owning a customer health score program, including input selection, weighting, validation, and rollout
  • Mastery of ChurnZero (or equivalent CS platform): Extensive experience extracting insights from health scores, segments, and adoption models.
  • Analytical Toolset: High proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or Sigma) to supplement native system reporting.
  • Proven Strategic Impact: A track record of turning complex data into clear, executive-level narratives that lead to measurable business outcomes.
  • Collaborative DNA: Experience enabling cross-functional teams, including building documentation, training, and operating rhythms that get adopted.
  • The "Internal Consultant": You are comfortable being handed a vague business problem and returning with a data-driven solution and a suggested plan of action.
  • The Pattern Recognizer: You have a "sixth sense" for the story in the numbers—you can identify feature decay or engagement spikes before they become broader trends.
  • Strong Communicator: You translate technical system metrics into clear, actionable bullet points that a VP or Director can act on immediately.
  • Proactive Problem Solver: You don't just report on the data; you identify where workflows are failing to capture the right data and partner with the team to fix it.
  • Operator's mindset: You care as much about whether the health score or sentiment analysis gets used as whether it is technically correct.
  • Influencer / Trust Builder: GTM agents and executives rely on your numbers because you have shown your work and earned the credibility.

Be a changemaker

You’ll Enjoy

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work
  • A culture that celebrates performance
  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard
  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Equity options, because this is your company too
  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community
  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

title: Night Shift Automated Welding Operator
description:

title: Senior Data & AI Analyst
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.

Position Overview

The Senior Data & AI Lead for Resilience Assurance is a forward‑looking role designed to embed real‑time analytics and agentic AI into the organization’s assurance framework. This leader will pioneer the shift from traditional compliance monitoring to continuous, intelligent validation of policies and standards, ensuring resilience is not just maintained but dynamically strengthened in the face of evolving risks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Real‑time policy validation: Architect AI‑driven systems that continuously monitor and validate adherence to policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.

  • Predictive analytics for resilience: Develop models that forecast compliance risks, resiliency gaps, and emerging vulnerabilities before they materialize.

  • Agentic AI enablement: Deploy autonomous AI agents to simulate resiliency scenarios, monitor controls, and recommend corrective actions in real time.

  • AI‑augmented audits: Transform compliance audits into continuous, data‑driven processes with anomaly detection, automated reporting, and predictive insights.

  • Dynamic maturity assessments: Use AI‑powered benchmarking to track organizational resiliency maturity and project future readiness.

  • Architecture intelligence: Apply AI tools to evaluate system architectures for resiliency, scalability, and compliance alignment.

  • Automated control testing: Implement AI frameworks that validate control effectiveness instantly, reducing manual overhead and increasing accuracy.

  • Strategic advisory: Translate complex analytics and AI insights into actionable strategies for executives, regulators, and operational leaders.

  • Innovation roadmap: Drive a 3–5 year vision for embedding AI into assurance, ensuring the organization remains at the forefront of intelligent compliance.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Data analytics mastery: Expertise in big data platforms, machine learning, and visualization tools (Python, Spark, Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake).

  • LLM Models: Strong understanding of current LLM models, integrations, prompt engineering, and use for example: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini.

  • AI leadership: Proven experience deploying agentic AI, autonomous monitoring systems, and AI‑driven compliance solutions.

  • Resilience & compliance knowledge: An understanding in frameworks such as ISO 22301, ISO 27001, and regulatory standards is nice to have.

  • Technical depth: Understanding of IT architecture, cloud environments, and resiliency engineering.

  • Executive presence: Ability to influence senior stakeholders with clear, data‑driven narratives.

  • Certifications: Advanced AI/ML certifications are highly desirable.

Desired Attributes

  • Visionary innovator who sees AI as a catalyst for transforming assurance.

  • Strategic futurist with the ability to anticipate compliance challenges and design proactive solutions.

  • Collaborative influencer who builds trust across technical, business, and regulatory domains.

  • Continuous learner who stays ahead of emerging AI, analytics, and resiliency technologies.

Future Vision

  • Autonomous audits: AI agents will conduct continuous audits, reducing reliance on scheduled manual reviews.

  • Self‑healing controls: Automated systems will detect and remediate compliance deviations instantly, minimizing downtime and risk exposure.

  • AI‑driven regulatory reporting: Compliance reports will be generated in real time, tailored to evolving regulatory requirements.

  • Resiliency simulations: Agentic AI will run predictive simulations of disruptions (cyber, operational, environmental) to validate organizational readiness.

  • Adaptive assurance frameworks: Policies and standards will evolve dynamically, guided by AI insights and global compliance trends.

  • Human‑AI collaboration: Assurance teams will shift from manual validation to strategic oversight, focusing on interpreting AI‑generated insights and shaping organizational resilience strategy.

Impact of the Role

This role redefines Resilience Assurance as a real‑time, AI‑augmented discipline. By embedding analytics and agentic AI into compliance monitoring, the Senior Data & AI Lead ensures the organization evolves from reactive compliance to predictive, adaptive resilience — positioning the enterprise as a global leader in intelligent assurance over the next decade.

Job Purpose

As an Assistant Finance Officer within Exchequer Services, you will provide proactive financial and debt recovery support, managing a substantial portfolio of accounts and ensuring effective collection of outstanding debts.

You will be responsible for managing Housing Benefit Overpayments and Adult Social Care debt cases, applying relevant legislation and recovery procedures while delivering a professional, customer-focused service. You will work closely with customers, internal departments and external organisations to resolve financial issues and achieve positive recovery outcomes.

  • Independently manage Housing Benefit Overpayment cases, prioritising workloads and taking appropriate recovery action.

  • Manage Adult Social Care debt portfolios, including care charges, financial assessment charges and deferred payment agreements.

  • Apply relevant Housing Benefit legislation, recovery regulations and departmental procedures when determining appropriate recovery action.

  • Progress debt recovery using methods such as Payment Direct from Earnings (PDE/PDP), Direct Earnings Attachments (DEA) and deductions from benefits, where applicable.

  • Analyse customer circumstances and determine suitable recovery solutions in accordance with legislation and organisational policies.

  • Liaise with customers, the Department for Work and Pensions, enforcement agents and internal stakeholders to resolve complex debt cases.

  • Handle sensitive conversations professionally, including working with vulnerable customers and their representatives.

  • Provide financial advice and administrative support to service areas, customers and suppliers.

  • Investigate and resolve financial queries, taking ownership of issues and ensuring timely outcomes.

  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions have a clear audit trail.

  • Use computerised financial systems to process transactions, run reports, extract and analyse data, and complete reconciliations.

  • Prepare spreadsheets, management information and financial reports to support service performance.

  • Monitor income collection, debt management and recovery performance against agreed targets.

  • Maintain accurate and confidential financial information, ensuring compliance with financial controls and relevant procedures.

  • Identify opportunities to improve financial systems, processes and operational efficiency.

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues and other departments to deliver an effective, customer-focused exchequer service.

Essential Experience Required

  • Minimum of three years' recent experience in debt collection or credit control within a Local Authority.

  • Proven experience managing a substantial portfolio of debt accounts, ideally 900–1,000 accounts.

  • Experience independently managing Housing Benefit Overpayment recovery cases.

  • Experience managing Adult Social Care debt portfolios and recovering outstanding care charges.

  • Knowledge of Housing Benefit Overpayment recovery legislation, regulations and procedures.

  • Understanding of recovery methods, including PDE/PDP, DEA and benefit deductions.

  • Experience applying relevant legislation and policies to determine appropriate debt recovery action.

  • Experience dealing with customers, the Department for Work and Pensions, enforcement agents and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience working with vulnerable customers and handling sensitive financial situations.

  • Strong communication, negotiation and customer service skills.

  • Ability to analyse financial information and make informed decisions.

  • Proactive approach, with the ability to take ownership of responsibilities and work effectively as part of a team.

Essa pessoa trabalhará de forma integrada com as equipes de SOC, Blue Team, Resposta a Incidentes, Fraude, Infraestrutura e Segurança Ofensiva, apoiando a análise de ameaças e eventos de segurança e contribuindo para transformar informações de inteligência em ações que fortaleçam a proteção do ambiente.

Esse cargo será responsável por:

  • Monitorar, analisar e acompanhar ameaças cibernéticas, grupos de ameaças, APTs, campanhas maliciosas, ransomware e novos TTPs, avaliando possíveis impactos para o ambiente e para o negócio;
  • Produzir análises e informações de Cyber Threat Intelligence, apoiando a identificação de riscos, tendências e ameaças relevantes;
  • Mapear ameaças e técnicas de ataque utilizando o MITRE ATT&CK, correlacionando TTPs e indicadores identificados durante análises e investigações;
  • Apoiar e executar atividades de Threat Hunting, contribuindo para a identificação de comportamentos e atividades suspeitas no ambiente;
  • Analisar e correlacionar IOCs, IOAs, IOBs, logs e eventos de segurança, auxiliando na identificação e investigação de possíveis ameaças;
  • Apoiar investigações e atividades de resposta a incidentes de segurança, contribuindo para análise de evidências, identificação de causa e avaliação de impacto;
  • Contribuir para a criação e melhoria contínua de regras e mecanismos de detecção em ferramentas SIEM, EDR, XDR e SOAR;
  • Realizar análise de malwares e artefatos suspeitos, quando necessário, como apoio às investigações;
  • Utilizar e integrar informações provenientes de fontes de Threat Intelligence comerciais, governamentais e open source;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e executivos, apresentando tendências, riscos e ameaças relevantes de forma adequada aos diferentes públicos;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Purple Team, Red Team e validação de controles defensivos, contribuindo com a visão de inteligência e defesa;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e atuar como referência técnica no dia a dia para profissionais plenos e juniores do time.

Para dar #match, essa vaga necessita que atenda alguns requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência de aproximadamente 5 anos ou mais em Segurança da Informação, com atuação compatível com uma posição sênior;
  • Vivência em Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) e operações ou interação próxima com SOC;
  • Experiência com Threat Hunting, análise de ameaças e resposta a incidentes;
  • Conhecimento de MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, Diamond Model e Intelligence Lifecycle;
  • Conhecimento de IOCs, IOAs e TTPs e sua utilização em análises e investigações de segurança;
  • Experiência com soluções de SIEM, como Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, Elastic ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de soluções EDR/XDR, como Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Trend Micro, SentinelOne ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de KQL, SPL ou outras linguagens de consulta utilizadas para análise de eventos de segurança;
  • Experiência com análise e correlação de logs e eventos de segurança;
  • Conhecimentos de Windows, Linux e Active Directory;
  • Conhecimentos de redes e protocolos, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S e protocolos de autenticação;
  • Conhecimentos de OSINT, Threat Intelligence Platforms e feeds de Threat Intelligence;
  • Conhecimentos de investigação digital e análise forense básica;
  • Capacidade de analisar informações técnicas, correlacionar evidências e comunicar riscos e recomendações de forma clara;
  • Ensino Superior completo.

Será considerado um diferencial, mas caso não tenha essa experiência ou conhecimento não te desabona a participar:

  • Experiência com OpenCTI e MISP;
  • Conhecimento ou utilização de VirusTotal, Shodan e GreyNoise;
  • Experiência com plataformas como Recorded Future ou CrowdStrike Intelligence;
  • Vivência com SOAR e automação de processos de segurança;
  • Conhecimentos mais aprofundados em análise de malware;
  • Participação em iniciativas de Purple Team ou Red Team;
  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol a partir do intermediário.

description:
Perform a combination of equipment operations, preventive maintenance, and manual labor tasks related to roadway maintenance. Perform a combination of skilled equipment operations, preventive maintenance and manual labor tasks in roadway maintenance. Perform emergency roadway operations as an essential employee.

How you will contribute:
  • Emergency Operations: Operate and maintain light and medium-duty equipment to perform maintenance and construction related work tasks.
  • Emergency Operations: Prepare and operate equipment for snow and ice removal or other types of emergency operations. Clear roadways of snow, ice and debris, and clean up after accidents. Provide traffic control.
  • Equipment Operations: Operate and maintain light, medium and heavy-duty highway equipment and vehicles to perform maintenance and construction related work tasks.
  • Job Safety: Determine and demonstrate proper work site protection techniques. Identify workplace safety hazards and make suggestions for improvement. Wear proper personal protection equipment. Develop and maintain knowledge of current safety rules, regulations, laws and procedures (OSHA, VOSHA, etc.). Use equipment properly and safely. Apply MUTCD for detours, lane closures, work zones, etc. Maintain clean, orderly and safe work environment. Follow VDOT safety regulations and practices.
  • Job Safety: Determine and demonstrate proper work site protection techniques. Identify workplace safety hazards and make suggestions for improvement. Wear proper personal protection equipment. Maintain current knowledge of safety rules, regulations, laws and procedures (OSHA and VOSHA, etc.). Use equipment properly and safely. Apply MUTCD for detours, lane closures, work zones, etc. Maintain clean, orderly, and safe work environment. Follow VDOT safety regulations and practices.
  • Manual Labor: Participate as a working member of the crew to complete projects and accomplish objectives. Perform manual labor and other maintenance tasks as needed for project completion.
  • Manual Labor: Participate as a working member of the crew to complete projects and accomplish objectives. Perform manual labor and other maintenance tasks to complete assigned work. Use a variety of hand and power tools to completed assigned tasks.
  • Preventative Maintenance: Perform maintenance repair, replacement and preventive maintenance. Complete pre-trip inspections for any vehicle or equipment operated.
  • Traffic Control Devices: Install, maintain and remove traffic control devices for work zones, detours, lane closures, etc., in assigned areas using the MUTCD. Assist in tracking inventory and maintaining records.


What will make you successful:
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing.
  • Ability to follow oral and written instructions, read and interpret work plans and specifications, and complete accurate work documentation.
  • Ability to maintain inventory records and complete simple paperwork.
  • Ability to obtain valid CDL and DOT medical card within 11 months of employment and maintain thereafter. Must comply with DOT and VDOT policies and standards when operating CDL equipment.
  • Ability to operate and maintain hand and power tools.
  • Ability to operate and maintain light and medium duty equipment used for highway maintenance and repair.
  • Ability to perform heavy manual labor.
  • Ability to read and follow oral and written instructions.
  • Ability to read and interpret plans and sketches.
  • Ability to work on a team to complete work assignments.
  • Knowledge and application of work zone safety, traffic controls and flagging operations to include the Manual of Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD).
  • Knowledge of federal and state regulations regarding traffic control devices.
  • Knowledge of highway maintenance equipment, materials, methods, and procedures.
  • Skill in the operation and maintenance of hand and power tools.
  • Skill in the operation and maintenance of light, medium, and heavy duty equipment used for highway maintenance and repair.
  • Skills related to materials, methods, and procedures for performing highway maintenance and operating equipment.
  • Working knowledge of work zone traffic control standards and techniques.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing.
  • Ability to obtain CDL and DOT medical card within 11 months of employment and maintain thereafter. Must comply with DOT and VDOT policies and standards when operating CDL equipment.
  • Ability to perform heavy manual labor.
  • Ability to read and follow oral and written instructions.
  • Knowledge of highway maintenance equipment, materials, methods, and procedures.
  • Safety shoes required.
  • Skill in the operation and maintenance of hand and power tools.
  • Skill in the operation and maintenance of light, medium, and heavy duty equipment used for highway maintenance and repair.

Additional Considerations:
  • A combination of training, experience, or education in Maintenance, Vehicle Operations or related field desired.
  • Experience in emergency operations to include snow removal, storms and accident clean-up.
  • Experience in roadway maintenance and construction.
  • Experience performing preventive maintenance and minor equipment repairs.
  • Valid Commercial Drivers License with appropriate endorsements.

title: Retail Shift Supervisor
description:
Job Title: Retail Shift Supervisor

Employment Type: Full-Time / Hourly

Goodwill Southwest Florida is seeking a Retail Shift Supervisor to support the management team in the daily operation of the store. This position assists with achieving sales, expense, profit, production, merchandising, customer service, and mission-related goals while ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. The Shift Supervisor provides leadership, training, and operational support to create a safe, productive, and customer-focused environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Safety

  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized store environment through adherence to Kaizen principles, PPE requirements, safety procedures, facility inspections, incident reporting, and monthly safety meetings.
  • Ensure all required store equipment is maintained in safe operating condition and support compliance with all safety standards and requirements.

Financial Results

  • Assist in achieving store sales, expense, profit, customer transaction, and Ecommerce revenue goals.
  • Support efforts to increase customer count, average sales per customer, and sales per square foot in accordance with store objectives.
  • Comply with all recycling and salvage procedures to maximize donation value and reduce disposal expenses.

Customer & Mission Services

  • Ensure staff maintain positive relationships with customers and donors and resolve guest concerns in a timely and satisfactory manner.
  • Help educate customers, donors, and the community about Goodwill programs and mission services.

Production & Merchandising

  • Sort and grade merchandise, hang and price items according to established guidelines, and meet daily production goals.
  • Maintain attractive merchandise displays, proper signage, inventory rotation, and compliance with all pricing, merchandising, and Good, Better, Best guidelines.
  • Ensure all mission-related signage is properly displayed throughout the store.

Administrative

  • Prepare and submit accurate reports, control store expenses, and ensure compliance with loss prevention policies.
  • Complete required documentation, including DSRs, bank deposits, Kaizen inspections, facility checklists, meeting records, and other organizational reporting requirements.

Store Maintenance

  • Assist with the physical operation of the store and premises.
  • Submit maintenance requests according to company policy and maintain cleanliness of the sales floor, backroom, and exterior areas.

Staffing & Leadership

  • Foster effective communication with employees through store meetings and ongoing interaction.
  • Supervise, train, and support employees to ensure achievement of production, pricing, recycling, salvage, and quality control standards.
  • Facilitate and participate in weekly staff training and educational sessions designed to improve knowledge, motivation, and performance.
  • Establish and reinforce individual performance standards in alignment with organizational expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures.
  • Work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed to support store operations.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • One year of retail sales experience preferred.
  • Ability to learn and operate point-of-sale systems, donation systems, office computers, and telephones.
  • Ability to supervise and train employees in production, merchandising, checkout, and customer service functions.
  • Ability to work effectively under stressful conditions while demonstrating good judgment, patience, and understanding.
  • Ability to understand and follow oral and written instructions.
  • Ability to read, write, speak, hear, and perform business-related mathematical calculations.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to bend, stoop, reach, twist, lift, push, pull, and move items weighing up to 40 pounds.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to occasionally work outdoors in varying temperatures and weather conditions.

Why Goodwill?

  • Mission-driven nonprofit organization
  • Collaborative leadership team
  • Opportunity to impact and change lives across Southwest Florida

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 403(b) retirement plan
  • Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee discounts
  • Tuition reimbursement

title: HR-forretningspartner med stærk HR-faglighed og blik for forretningen
description:
Kan du omsætte HR-faglighed, organisationsforståelse og data til rådgivning, der gør en forskel for ledere og deres opgaveløsning? Motiveres du af at være en opsøgende sparringspartner, der understøtter både ledere og ledelsesteams i at skabe resultater og udvikle organisationen? Så er du måske vores nye HR-forretningspartner i Miljøstyrelsen.

Miljøstyrelsen gennemgår væsentlige organisatoriske forandringer, og med vores strategi En handlekraftig Miljøstyrelse har vi høje ambitioner for ledelse, effektivitet og udvikling af organisationen. Strategien skal omsættes til konkrete mål, prioriteringer og forbedringer i den daglige opgaveløsning.

HR spiller en vigtig rolle i at understøtte den udvikling. Vi skal hjælpe ledere og ledelsesteams med at skabe sammenhæng mellem strategi, opgaver, medarbejdere og resultater. Det kræver en HR-funktion, der forstår forretningen, arbejder proaktivt og bruger faglighed og data til at kvalificere ledernes overvejelser og beslutninger.

Vi søger derfor en erfaren HR-forretningspartner, der kan kombinere solid HR-faglighed med en god forståelse for organisationens opgaver, udfordringer og strategiske mål.

Du bliver en tæt sparringspartner for ledere og ledelsesteams
Som HR-forretningspartner får du selvstændigt ansvar for HR-understøttelsen af ledere og chefer i et eller flere fagområder i Miljøstyrelsen. Du bliver fast sparringspartner for kontorchefer, teamledere og funktionsledere og skal opbygge et kendskab til deres opgaver, mål og ledelsesmæssige udfordringer.

Vi forventer, at du er tæt på forretningen, tager initiativ til dialogen og hjælper lederne med HR-relaterede udfordringer og muligheder. Det kan handle om rekruttering, sygefravær, kompetenceudvikling, samarbejde og organisatoriske forandringer.

Du får også en vigtig rolle i at understøtte ledelsesteams i deres fælles ledelsesopgave. Du bidrager med HR-faglige perspektiver og sparring om, hvordan kontorets mål og strategiske prioriteringer hænger sammen med ledelse, organisering, samarbejde og udvikling af medarbejdere og kompetencer.

Du skal kunne stille gode spørgsmål, udfordre vante perspektiver og bidrage med viden og forslag, der hjælper lederne med at træffe kvalificerede beslutninger.

Du får ansvar for at understøtte egne fagområder, som kan være fordelt på flere af Miljøstyrelsens lokationer. Det er derfor en vigtig del af jobbet, at du er synlig og fysisk til stede hos de ledere og lederteams, du samarbejder med. Du skal trives med at arbejde på tværs af fagområder og geografiske afstande og være god til at opbygge stærke samarbejdsrelationer.

Du arbejder med både HR-rådgivning og strategisk ledelsesunderstøttelse
Du får en varieret opgaveportefølje, hvor den daglige HR-rådgivning og den mere langsigtede understøttelse af ledelse og organisationsudvikling går hånd i hånd.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver:

  • Du understøtter lederne i blandt andet rekruttering, lønforhandlinger, sygefravær, fastholdelse, medarbejderudvikling og øvrige HR-spørgsmål. Du bidrager med faglig rådgivning og sparring om handlemuligheder og understøtter lederne i deres personaleledelse. Du arbejder tæt med vores personalejurist og det øvrige team.
  • Du sparrer med ledere og ledelsesteams om, hvordan strategiske mål og prioriteringer har betydning for deres ledelsesopgave. Du bidrager med HR-faglige perspektiver på blandt andet organisering, samarbejde og kompetencer.
  • Du bruger data om eksempelvis sygefravær og opsparet frihed til at skabe indsigt og kvalificere dialogen med lederne. Du hjælper med at identificere relevante opmærksomhedspunkter og mulige indsatser, som lederne kan inddrage i deres prioriteringer og beslutninger.
  • Du er sparringspartner for ledere og ledelsesteams i forbindelse med organisatoriske forandringer. Du bidrager til, at de HR-mæssige perspektiver tænkes ind i arbejdet med både udvikling og stabil drift.
  • Du opfanger behov og erfaringer på tværs af dine områder, bringer viden og perspektiver tilbage til HR og bidrager til at udvikle fælles løsninger, processer og en sammenhængende HR-understøttelse.

Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med vores HR-supportteam, der understøtter de administrative processer, og med kolleger inden for blandt andet personalejura, personaleadministration samt ledelses- og organisationsudvikling.

Vi har en ambition om, at HR-forretningspartnerne bruger en væsentlig del af deres tid på direkte lederdialog, rådgivning og sparring. Derfor arbejder vi også på at skabe en tydelig arbejdsdeling og effektive administrative processer, så vores samlede HR-ressourcer anvendes bedst muligt.

Du har stærk HR-faglighed og forstår ledernes virkelighed
Vi søger en erfaren HR-profil med et solidt fagligt fundament og flere års erfaring med HR-rådgivning til ledere, gerne fra staten eller en anden politisk ledet organisation.

Du har et bredt kendskab til HR-området og kan omsætte din faglige viden til konkrete og anvendelige løsninger. Samtidig er du nysgerrig på forretningen og interesserer dig for, hvordan HR kan understøtte organisationens mål og resultater.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • Har bred erfaring med HR-rådgivning og et godt kendskab til centrale HR-processer og personaleområdet.
  • Kan sætte dig ind i forskellige fagområders opgaver og udfordringer og omsætte den forståelse til relevant ledelsessparring.
  • Har erfaring med at understøtte ledere og gerne ledelsesteams i arbejdet med ledelse, samarbejde og organisatorisk udvikling.
  • Har blik for sammenhængen mellem strategi, mål, kompetencer og organisatorisk udvikling.
  • Kan anvende HR-data og ledelsesinformation til at skabe indsigt og kvalificere dialogen med lederne.
  • Er opsøgende, initiativrig og god til at skabe tillidsfulde relationer, samtidig med at du tør stille udfordrende spørgsmål og bidrage med nye perspektiver.
  • Arbejder struktureret, prioriterer dine opgaver og tager ansvar for kvalitet og fremdrift i dine egne leverancer og i partnerteamet som helhed.

Du skal kunne bevæge dig naturligt mellem konkrete HR-sager og mere udviklingsorienterede opgaver. Du er god til at lytte, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og finde løsninger, der både er fagligt holdbare og fungerer i praksis.

Vi forventer ikke, at du er specialist i personalejura, alle HR-discipliner eller digitale analyseværktøjer. Til gengæld skal du have et solidt HR-fagligt fundament, kunne bruge tilgængelig ledelsesinformation og vide, hvornår der er behov for at inddrage specialister.

Du har en relevant akademisk kandidatuddannelse, eksempelvis cand.merc. med fokus på HR eller organisation, cand.soc. i Human Resource Management, cand.scient.adm., cand.psych. eller en anden relevant kandidatuddannelse.

Du bliver en del af en HR-funktion med høje ambitioner
HR er en del af Miljøstyrelsens stab og understøtter styrelsens ledere og organisation med HR-rådgivning, personaleadministration, ledelsesudvikling og organisatorisk udvikling.

Du bliver en del af vores HR-partnerteam med fire HR-forretningspartnere og tre medarbejdere i HR-supportteamet. Du refererer til vores kommende teamleder for HR-partnerteamet.

Vi er i gang med at udvikle vores HR-partnermodel, og du får gode muligheder for at præge, hvordan vi arbejder med forretningsnær HR-rådgivning, data og ledelsesunderstøttelse.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt HR-miljø, hvor vi samarbejder på tværs af funktioner og har ambitioner om at udvikle en mere sammenhængende, effektiv og proaktiv HR-understøttelse.

Du får en selvstændig rolle med stort ansvar, mulighed for faglig udvikling og tæt kontakt til ledere i en organisation med vigtige samfundsopgaver.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række Akademiker-organisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademiker-overenskomsten).

Ansættelsesområdet er Miljøministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.

Tjenestestedet er i Odense, Lerchesgade 35. Stillingen indebærer regelmæssig tilstedeværelse på Miljøstyrelsens øvrige lokationer.

Tiltrædelse: 1. februar 2027.

Ansøgningsfrist er den 29. november 2026.

Vi forventer at gennemføre førstesamtalerunde den 2. december 2026 og anden samtalerunde den 11. december 2026. Der vil være testforløb mellem de to samtalerunder.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR-chef Trine Lumbye på tlf.

title: Senior Agentic Transformation Coach
description:
Mission Overview:


Keystone Solutions is seeking a Senior Agentic Transformation Coach for a consultancy mission at a client site. In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team working on the Outbound Release Platform (ORP), which connects customs, shipping agents, terminals, and logistics partners for the release of goods. This project involves transitioning to agentic engineering, marking a significant shift in the client's approach.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Contribute to the team's backlog from the first week: tackle stories, review pull requests, and participate in all ceremonies.
  • Train, coach, and guide colleagues in working agentically with GitHub Copilot on their own tasks.
  • Collaborate with the team to build a playbook of skills, agents, and agreements, developed from the existing codebase and domain.
  • Ensure quality is maintained so that speed does not compromise maintainability and security.
  • Gradually reduce your involvement as the team becomes self-sufficient.
  • Shape and guide the implementation of agentic engineering within the team, ensuring learning continues while delivering results.
  • Engage all roles in the transformation: developers, product owner, analyst, tester, and leadership.

Requirements:


  • At least 5+ years of experience as a software engineer, full stack with .NET and TypeScript.
  • Practical experience with agentic engineering in GitHub Copilot within a professional development team, including defining and guiding agents.
  • Experience in mentoring and coaching colleagues in a new working methodology.
  • Experience with integrations with external parties.
  • Experience with automated testing and quality assurance.
  • Fluent in Dutch.
  • At least two projects where you guided software teams towards AI-supported or agentic software development within an ongoing delivery.
  • At least 5+ years of experience as a software architect or in a similar technical leadership role.

  • Experience in requirements engineering or translating business needs into testable stories.

title: Business Unit Leader, General Assembly
description:
The Business Unit Leader is responsible for managing work teams in a fast paced, high volume, unionized, manufacturing environment. The Business Unit Leader is responsible for ensuring safety, quality, cost, delivery, and morale during the shift. The selected candidate will be required to build functional teams, train, and allocate manpower according to need, ensure team morale and drive continuous improvement solutions to improve product quality and reach production and cost targets. The Business Unit Leader’s responsibilities will include but are not limited to coordinating all activities to achieve business metrics and implementing Stellantis Industrial System (SIS) processes and initiatives.

Additional responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following:

  • Ensure production targets are achieved
  • Manage daily build schedule and model mix to meet schedule and maximize production efficiency
  • Drive continuous improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee morale
  • Lead production team in daily activities, including quality and through-put improvement initiatives
  • Drive implementation of Stellantis Industrial System (SIS) standards and processes
  • Ensure safety regulation compliance and provide a safe working environment for employees
  • Conduct routine audits to confirm adherence to manufacturing processes and procedures
  • Ensure quality systems are implemented and functioning per standards; re-establish standards as needed
  • Plan for scheduled maintenance while maintaining quality and throughput levels
  • Meet with production team to provide and obtain performance feedback
  • Work with Supervisors and Team Leaders to develop plans for absenteeism management
  • Facilitate communication between departments, lines, support functions, and internal suppliers
  • Teach, cultivate, and promote teamwork and problem solving in a positive, proactive work environment
