title: Vil du være med til at præge økonomistyringen hos Udlændingestyrelsen? (171602)
description:
Har du flair for økonomistyring, og motiveres du af at skabe overblik og sikre et solidt grundlag for prioritering og beslutninger? Så har vi en ledig fuldmægtigstilling i Kontoret for Økonomi og Ressourcestyring.

Stillingen har særligt fokus på budgetlægning og løbende økonomiopfølgning på styrelsens driftsområde. Du får en central rolle i den løbende styring af området og kommer til at samarbejde tæt med kolleger i økonomifunktionen og i fagkontorer og med ledere på tværs af styrelsen.

Sådan bliver din nye hverdag
Dine primære opgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • budgetlægning og løbende opfølgning på styrelsens driftsøkonomi
  • udarbejde budget- og regnskabsanalyser mhp. at væsentlige afvigelser og risici
  • udarbejde økonomisk ledelsesinformation og bidrage til den løbende afrapportering
  • rådgive og sparre med styrelsens budgetansvarlige og ledelsen om budgetter, forbrug og økonomiske prioriteringer
  • videreudvikle økonomistyring, processer og rapportering
  • udføre controlling og følge op på konteringer

Du får en bred kontaktflade og en hverdag, hvor du både skal kunne arbejde grundigt med tallene og formidle konklusionerne klart til kolleger og ledelse. Stillingen kræver derfor overblik, struktur, systematik og gode samarbejdsevner.

Vi benytter statens it-systemer som Navision, LDV og SBS, og du får mulighed for at arbejde i et stærkt fagligt miljø.

Om dig
Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant akademisk uddannelse, fx inden for økonomi, samfundsvidenskab eller lignende. Det er en fordel, hvis du allerede har erfaring med budgetlægning, økonomiopfølgning eller controlling – gerne fra staten – men det vigtigste er, at du har interesse for økonomistyring og lyst til at udvikle dig på området.

Vi lægger særlig vægt på, at du:

  • har gode analytiske evner og flair for tal
  • arbejder struktureret, grundigt og selvstændigt
  • har gennemslagskraft og kan håndtere dialog med ledere og medarbejdere med forskellige faglige baggrunde
  • kan skabe overblik over økonomiske data og omsætte dem til klare budskaber
  • tager ansvar for dine opgaver og følger dem til dørs
  • trives med mange samarbejdsflader og kan kommunikere økonomi til forskellige målgrupper
  • har gode Excel-kompetencer.

Nysgerrig?

Du ansættes efter overenskomst for akademikere i staten og vil blive indplaceret som fuldmægtig på baggrund af dine kvalifikationer og erfaring. Der er mulighed for at forhandle tillæg, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

Ansættelsesområdet er Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet med tilhørende institutioner, og arbejdsstedet er Udlændingestyrelsen, Farimagsvej 51A, 4700 Næstved.

Stillingen er en fast stilling på fuldtid med gennemsnitligt 37 timer om ugen.

Du skal være sikkerhedsgodkendt til ”TJENESTEBRUG” for at arbejde i denne stilling og kunne opretholde denne under hele din ansættelse. Du kan læse om, hvordan vi behandler dine persondata her.

Ligestilling i alle dens aspekter er vigtig. Derfor opfordres alle interesserede uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, køn, alder og lign. til at søge stillingen. Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet er medlem af Foreningen Lige Adgang.

title: Er du den leder, der gør dygtige fagfolk endnu dygtigere? Danmarks Fængsler søger en enhedsleder til Fodlænken København.
description:
Vi leder efter dig, der kan skabe faglig udvikling gennem sparring, feedback og tydelig ledelse.

Du kan allerede kende Danmarks Fængsler indefra og have erfaring fra vores område, eller du kan komme med erfaring fra en kommune, region, styrelse eller anden organisation med fokus på myndighedsarbejde, socialfaglige indsatser eller komplekse regelsæt.

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at stå i spidsen for et stærkt fagligt miljø, skabe retning for medarbejderne og sikre høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen.

Din vigtigste opgave
Som enhedsleder skal du skabe retning for den faglige kvalitet, understøtte medarbejdernes udvikling og bidrage til, at lovgivning, faglige metoder og organisatoriske mål omsættes til god praksis i hverdagen.

Du bliver leder for engagerede og fagligt stærke medarbejdere, og du får en central rolle i at sikre kvaliteten i afdelingens opgaver og afgørelser.

Om Fodlænken København
I Fodlænken arbejder vi med elektronisk overvågning som afsoningsform. Her bidrager medarbejderne til, at mennesker kan afsone deres straf i eget hjem under faste rammer og kontrol.

Arbejdet kræver høj faglig kvalitet, sikker drift og et stærkt blik for både mennesker og regler.

Som enhedsleder bliver du en del af den daglige ledelse og får en vigtig rolle i at understøtte medarbejderne og sikre en effektiv og ensartet opgaveløsning.

Dine opgaver
Som enhedsleder skal du blandt andet:

  • Sikre høj faglig kvalitet i opgaveløsningen
  • Understøtte medarbejdernes faglige udvikling gennem sparring, feedback og læring
  • Omsætte lovgivning, retningslinjer og faglige metoder til praksis
  • Bidrage til ensartethed og kvalitet i sagsbehandling og afgørelse.
  • Skabe retning og sammenhæng i hverdagen
  • Understøtte et godt arbejdsmiljø og høj trivsel
  • Samarbejde tæt med enhedschefen, lederkolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Hvem er du?
Du er nysgerrig på faglig udvikling og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem andre.

Du har erfaring med myndighedsarbejde eller lyst og evne til hurtigt at sætte dig ind i et juridisk og regelstyret område.
Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med ledelse eller faglig koordinering
  • Trives med at give feedback og udfordre faglige perspektiver
  • Kan omsætte komplekse regler og krav til forståelig praksis
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og skaber tillid
  • Har blik for både kvalitet, mennesker og resultater
  • Arbejder struktureret og følger op på aftaler og mål.

Vi er mindre optagede af, hvor du kommer fra, og mere optagede af, hvad du kan bidrage med.

Derfor skal du vælge os
Hos Danmarks Fængsler får du mulighed for at:

  • Stå i spidsen for et vigtigt fagligt område
  • Udvikle medarbejdere og faglige miljøer
  • Få sparring og muligheder for egen ledelsesudvikling
  • Blive en del af et stærkt lederfællesskab.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er en fast stilling uden højeste arbejdstid. Som udgangspunkt er din gennemsnitlige ugentlige arbejdstid 37 timer.
Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. januar 2026 eller snarest muligt derefter

Ansættelse og aflønning fastsættes i henhold til relevant gældende overenskomst afhængig af din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund sammenholdt med stillingsindholdet.

Hvis du i forvejen er tjenestemandsansat i staten, vil der være mulighed for at bevare din tjenestemandsansættelse.

Ansættelsesområdet er Danmarks Fængsler.
Arbejdsstedet er Fodlænken København, Æbeløgade 5, 2100 København Ø.

Ansøgning
Stillingen søges elektronisk via linket ”Søg stillingen”.

Ansøgning, CV og dokumentation for uddannelse samt andet relevant materiale skal være modtaget i rekrutteringssystemet senest den 20. november 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende.

Hvis du indkaldes til samtale, skal du til samtalen medbringe identifikation f.eks. pas eller kørekort.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du i forbindelse med samtalen giver dit samtykke til, at Danmarks Fængsler må indhente og vurdere oplysninger om dig i det Centrale Kriminalregister.

Sikkerhedsgodkendelse er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, ligesom at du skal kunne opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen gennem din ansættelse.

Danmarks Fængsler ser mangfoldighed som en styrke, og opfordrer alle interesserede kandidater uanset personlig baggrund til at søge.

Vil du vide mere?
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fungerende enhedschef Torben Svanhede på telefon 72 55 22 35 eller mail torben.svanhede@dkf.dk.

Om Danmarks Fængsler, Fængselskreds Øst
Fængselskreds Øst består af et kredskontor, åbne og lukkede fængsler, arresthuse og tilsyn, samt fodlænkeafdelinger, transport og bevogtning, udrejsecenter og udlændingecenter fordelt på hele Sjælland, Bornholm og Færøerne.

I alt ca. 2300 ansatte.

For yderligere information om Danmarks Fængsler henvises til hjemmesiden www.danmarksfængsler.dk

title: Concrete Group Leader
company: Carga de puesto de Wagman, Inc.
description:
Job Info

Title: Concrete Laborer Group Leader

Travel: open to regional travel; primary location Long Bridge Project

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Concrete Laborer Group Leader to join our Long Bridge Project. Must be a team player, motivated to work hard, and develop in our Heavy Civil team. The ideal candidate will have experience in finishing concrete on Heavy Highway and bridge projects using a variety of tools including but not limited to walk behind trowels, bull floats, screeds and more. Excellent leadership abilities and communication skills are important, as are the ability to be hands on daily with the crew carrying out the work.

This is a safety sensitive position requiring work on construction sites with various safety hazards inherent in heavy construction.

This position is subject to drug testing and compliance policies associated with our status as a Federal Contractor.

Wagman is a multi-faceted construction firm with major operations in heavy civil, general construction and geotechnical construction services. Wagman is a fourth generation, family-owned company with offices in Pennsylvania and Virginia and is headquartered in York, PA. Founded in 1902, Wagman is a nationally recognized leader in the industry. Core competencies include: design-build, infrastructure, marine construction, modified concrete, grooving and grinding, and geotechnical construction services.

Qualifications:

  • HS Diploma or GED
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in finishing concrete on Heavy Highway and bridge jobs.
  • Familiar with concrete surfaces, hand and power tools, bridge construction, and all other highway construction scopes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong prioritization and organizational skills; detail-oriented

Essential Functions:

  • Supervises and directs labor crew carrying out various tasks including concrete work such as smoothing and finishing surfaces of poured concrete (floors, walks, sidewalks, walls, footings, roads, or curbs); preparing materials, equipment and tools for optimal output.
  • Help with cleaning and preparing job sites, dig trenches, set braces to support form work, erect scaffolding, clean up rubble and debris, and tear out concrete.
  • May assist in developing a weekly schedule and in carrying out sequence of activities for the concrete crews and finishing operations.
  • Maintains all records required concerning production, safety, attendance, time worked by crew members, personnel matters, etc.

  • Responsible for the safety of those on the crew and will conduct all operations according to all applicable company and government safety rules. Will develop and maintain a proper crew attitude by conducting weekly Planning Meetings and displaying a positive safety attitude toward all daily operation performed.

Physical Requirements of the Essential Functions:

  • Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds from ground level to waist level
  • Continuous standing and walking required throughout a scheduled work shift
  • Must be able to climb ladders.
  • Must be able to work at heights up to 150 feet
  • Must be able to bend, squat, kneel and crawl occasionally throughout a scheduled work shift.
  • Must be able to perform simple grasping and fine manipulation tasks with both hands
  • Must have the ability to reach, lift and perform work above shoulder height - and the ability to work on uneven surfaces and in confined spaces
  • Required to have acceptable corrected vision (in both eyes) and acceptable corrected hearing.
  • Must be able to work outdoors in wet, muddy, cold, hot and humid weather.

Job Benefits:

Wagman wants to keep employees and their families happy and healthy and offers a comprehensive benefits package to all full-time employees that includes:

  • Medical/Vision/Dental Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts for Healthcare and Dependent Care
  • Disability and Life Insurance
  • Wellness Programs that include Orthopedic Care
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Matching Contribution
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 8 paid holidays
  • Paid Time Off

Our Values

Wagman’s Core Values of integrity, mutual respect, safety, innovation, sense of urgency, and community are an integral part of every decision and every plan made at Wagman and these values have laid the foundation for our success and longevity for our past, present, and future.
Consistently being recognized with national and regional awards for projects, safety and community is a testament of our commitment to these values. Beyond the buildings and bridges which connect and improve our communities, Wagman has community engagement programs and initiatives which help to build better, for our people.

Wagman Culture
Wagman is committed to cultivating a workforce and preserving a culture built on our core values. Our people are our most valuable assets. We value the diverse identities, experiences, perspectives, backgrounds capabilities and talents that our people bring to Wagman.

From hiring to training, development, and promotions to special events, Wagman is committed to providing equal and equitable opportunities and rewarding experiences. As a family business providing a safe and healthy work environment in accordance with our mission, we foster diverse and inclusive work experiences and a sense of belonging.

Wagman is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. We recognize and value our diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Wagman is proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V.

title: Bliv Camp Manager i Østgrønland!
description:
We are seeking a driven, positive, detail-oriented Camp Manager to join our Base Camp Greenland Field Team from June 2027.

The Camp Manager oversees the full scope of camp operations and staff, ensuring an exceptional and safe experience for our guests in one of the most spectacular, and remote corners of the planet. This is a hands-on leadership role, and the Camp Manager is expected to actively participate in daily camp operations and guest service in addition to managing the team.


SCHEDULING & LOCATION

This is a field-based, seasonal contract position from mid-June to mid-September. Base Camp Greenland is located on a remote island with no independent travel options.

While your hours will vary from day to day, it is certain that you will need to work long hours every day (including some very early mornings and late evenings) in order to accomplish our goal of ultimate customer service.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and support all Base Camp staff, including the Facilities Manager, Chef, Camp Assistant, and local boat drivers.
  • Facilitate team meetings, address staffing needs, clarify role responsibilities, and foster a positive, communicative work environment for all.
  • Provide performance feedback and participate in end-of-season evaluations.

Safety & Risk Management

  • Oversee all daily camp operations to maintain a safe, clean, and comfortable environment for our guests.
  • Make informed decisions in Arctic conditions, coordinating with Expedition Leaders when available.
  • Coordinate safety training and ensure all on-site staff are familiar with and follow established safety procedures, including polar bear safety, first aid, and emergency response protocols.
  • Manage and respond to wildlife encounters, including polar bear safety protocols.

Guest Experience

  • Welcome guests on arrival and provide camp orientations.
  • Assist with guest needs, questions, and concerns, working closely with Expedition Leaders to deliver an exceptional experience.
  • Organize and schedule kayaking demonstrations with a local when available.
  • Take initiative in hospitality management and help create a warm, attentive guest experience, for example by presenting refreshments and snacks during happy hour.
  • Oversee guest and activity gear readiness, coordinating cleaning, organization, maintenance, and preparation with the Facilities Manager and Expedition Leaders as appropriate.

Logistics & Administration

  • Coordinate arrivals, departures, boat and helicopter movements, and daily camp logistics.
  • Work closely with Field Operations Specialists in Tasiilaq and Iceland to ensure timely delivery of supplies and equipment.
  • Track transport of luggage, laundry, waste, and recycling.
  • Manage expense tracking, scheduling of local staff, and payments to local boat drivers.
  • Oversee shipments and distribution of all pre-season and in-season supplies.
  • Assist with hands-on operational tasks, including
    cleaning, dishwashing and lifting/carrying luggage and supplies.
  • Lead end-of-season breakdown, inventory, and documentation for future seasons.

REQUIREMENTS

Experience & Skills

  • Fluent in spoken and written English;
    ability to communicate in Danish considered an asset.
  • Managerial experience in remote camp environments, with a strong record of leading teams.
  • Experience living and working in remote areas for extended periods; Arctic experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated excellence in decision-making, communication, and interpersonal leadership. Must be proactive and reliable in communicating with both the on-site team and remote office staff.
  • Customer service experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Ability to lift up to 100 pounds
    and comfortably perform physical tasks such as standing, walking, and bending throughout the day.
  • Ability to provide an elevated, community-minded guest experience with a focus on sustainability.

Technical & Safety Skills

  • Experience driving Zodiacs near icebergs and in intertidal zones strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated competency and comfort with firearms; significant experience in polar bear country strongly preferred.
  • Required certifications: Wilderness First Aid (WFR preferred), CPR, Food Handler’s, and Firearms License.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation is commensurate with experience and paid on a daily basis, plus gratuities. Work hours and requirements may vary based on operational needs.

Housing and meals, round-trip transportation to/from Greenland, branded gear, and any necessary work permits will be provided.

Additional benefits include gear and travel discounts.

**Please submit all application materials in English only***

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Our Commitment to You

At Consumer Cellular, recruiting is human. Every application is reviewed by a real member of our Talent Acquisition team because we believe the people behind the résumé matter just as much as what's on it.

All official communication from Consumer Cellular will come from a @consumercellular.com email address or through our verified texting platform, which will only be used to schedule interviews. We will never ask for personal and financial information during the recruiting process. If you receive outreach that doesn't match these criteria, please do not engage and feel free to verify directly at talentacquisition@consumercellular.com.

While this role is remote, you will still need to reside within 50 miles of one of our call centers. Starting wage for this role is $19.00/hour + commission.

Job Summary
At Consumer Cellular, we believe every conversation is an opportunity to strengthen a relationship.

As a Customer Retention Specialist , you'll serve as a trusted advisor to customers who are considering leaving Consumer Cellular. Through meaningful conversations, active listening, empathy, and expert problem-solving, you'll uncover what's most important to each customer and deliver personalized solutions that create long-term loyalty

This role blends relationship building, customer advocacy, and consultative sales. You'll balance the needs of our customers with the needs of our business by delivering solutions that make sound business sense while creating experiences that delight customers for life.

Successful Customer Retention Specialists don't simply save accounts; they build trust, create lifelong advocates, and leave every customer feeling heard, valued, and appreciated.

Key Responsibilities

Build Meaningful Customer Relationships

  • Build genuine rapport with customers by creating positive, engaging conversations rooted in empathy and trust.
  • Practice active listening to understand each customer's unique needs, concerns, and goals.

Deliver Customer-Focused Solutions

  • Serve as a retention expert by identifying the root cause behind a customer's desire to cancel service.
  • Recommend personalized solutions that balance customer needs with sound business decisions by educating customers on products, services, and solutions that best fit their needs.
  • Confidently overcome objections by demonstrating the value of remaining a Consumer Cellular customer.

Drive Customer Retention

  • Consistently achieve retention and sales performance goals by demonstrating ownership of every interaction.
  • Increase customer lifetime value through exceptional service and thoughtful recommendations.
  • Resolve customer concerns the first time (First Call Resolution), minimizing repeat contacts and escalations.

Deliver Operational Excellence

  • Maintain expert knowledge of Consumer Cellular products, services, systems, promotions, and wireless industry trends.
  • Meet established performance expectations, including\:
    • Save Ratio
    • Average Call Waiting (ACW)
    • First Call Resolution (FCR) %
    • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
    • Quality Assurance (QA)
    • Schedule Adherence and Attendance
  • Accurately document customer interactions.
  • Protect customer information by complying with CPNI, PCI, and company privacy standards.

What is in it for YOU –

  1. Flexibility in Schedule – We offer full-time, part-time, and split-shift options.
  2. Competitive Wage and Savings – ($19/hour) with an opportunity to earn shift differentials for evening and weekend hours worked. You will also be able to save on gas and lunches out!
  3. Career Growth – You are in charge of your career at Consumer Cellular and have the freedom to grow. Yes, you read that correctly – you have the freedom to self-promote through meeting and maintaining your metrics.
  4. Paid Training – Full-time, 5-week training that is 100% paid!
  5. Dynamite Benefits – Benefits to cover all your needs and at affordable rates (how does $25/paycheck sound?)

ob Summary

We are seeking an experienced Manager to lead the design, development, and deployment of agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions for enterprise clients. title: Mocap Shoot Supervisor
description:
The Mocap Shoot Supervisor is responsible for the preparation, supervision and successful execution of motion capture shoots.

As a Modcap Shoot Supervisor, you are responsible for sequences, layout, props and other shoot requirements that are properly prepared in advance, and that recording is conducted to achieve consistently high-quality data. Working closely with the Global Motion Capture Producer, Production and the technical Mocap team, the Supervisor helps optimise shoot planning and sequencing while minimising downstream issues.

Candidates may be based in the UK, North America or Europe but must be willing and able to travel to India and work on set and with the wider team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for clear shoot planning and effective coordination across Production, creative and technical teams.
  • Prepare motion capture shoots and ensure sequences, layout, props, characters and required assets are ready for the session.

  • Work with the Global Motion Capture Producer and Production to improve shoot sequencing and maintain clear recording plans.
  • Coordinate with the Mocap TDs on technical requirements, capture quality and troubleshooting.
  • Ensure captured performances meet agreed production and technical requirements before completion of the session. To reduce the need for reshoots or avoidable downstream corrections.
  • Proactively identify and communicate shoot-related risks, changes and challenges, ensuring relevant stakeholders remain informed and aligned throughout the production process.

Must have

  • Extensive professional experience working as a Mocap Shoot Supervisor, with a proven track record of overseeing successful mocap shoots.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to Mumbai and work on set during the shoot, with the schedule to be confirmed.
  • Expert technical knowledge and extensive hands-on experience with Vicon (setup, capture and processing), Xsens, head-mounted camera systems and MotionBuilder.
  • Strong understanding of the animation production pipeline, from initial shoot preparation and motion capture through to final shot delivery.

About you

  • An effective and confident communicator, able to collaborate seamlessly across departments and engage with stakeholders at all levels.
  • A proactive and resourceful problem-solver, with the ability to approach technical and creative challenges with practical, innovative solutions.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, consistently maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.
  • Calm, composed and adaptable under pressure, with the ability to respond quickly and effectively to changing priorities and situations.
  • Highly organised, thoughtful and pragmatic, with a structured approach to planning, decision-making and delivering results.

title: Senior Data Analyst KYC Consultant
description:
Mission Overview:

Keystone Solutions is looking for a Senior Data Analyst with strong KYC expertise for a consultancy mission in Brussels. You will be hired by Keystone Solutions and represent us while working on a client project under our consultancy model. The mission combines 50% on-site work with 50% homeworking.

As a Data Analyst, you will play a critical role in designing, delivering, and maintaining high-quality data solutions across the KYC lifecycle, covering customer onboarding, periodic reviews, and event-driven updates. You will support compliance, operational efficiency, and scalability by making customer identification, due diligence, risk assessment, and KYC process data reliable and usable. You will act as a bridge between data providers such as IT, Data Services, AI, and Operations and data consumers such as KYC Operations, Front Office, Compliance teams, and regulators, aligning technical solutions with business needs while upholding strict data governance and quality standards.


Core Responsibilities:

These responsibilities will be carried out as a Keystone Solutions consultant within the client environment.

  • Stakeholder Alignment and Communication: Coordinate input from IT, Data Services, Compliance (CPL), KYC Operations, and Front Office, ensuring alignment on KYC data needs through structured documentation, workshops, and clear communication.
  • Translate KYC business requirements for onboarding, reviews, customer due diligence, and risk assessment into actionable data solutions, balancing technical feasibility with regulatory and operational needs.
  • Data Governance and Quality: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, including role definitions, quality rules, and access protocols, in collaboration with data providers and consumers.
  • Monitor, refine, and escalate data quality issues proactively, ensuring long-term integrity of KYC datasets, including customer identification, legal entity and beneficial ownership information, related parties, risk classifications, and due diligence records.
  • Define and document business and technical rules for KYC data integration, including source-to-target mappings, data lineage, and reconciliation controls, ensuring traceability and compliance.
  • Data Analysis and Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve discrepancies across customer reference data, KYC applications, and mainframe-based data points. A willingness to explore raw data is essential.
  • Write and run SQL queries to extract, join, validate, and analyze KYC data across source systems, uncovering trends, data quality issues, and actionable insights.
  • Analyze KYC customer, risk, screening, and process data to identify missing or inconsistent information, coverage gaps, and operational bottlenecks across onboarding and reviews.
  • Solution Design and Industrialization: Design logical and physical data models, such as data warehouses and datamarts, optimized for KYC reporting and analytics, linking customers, legal entities, beneficial owners, related parties, risk assessments, and process history.
  • Develop and industrialize data pipelines, ensuring reliable flows between KYC source systems, shared data platforms, and reporting solutions, with appropriate accessibility across the enterprise.
  • Build and maintain interactive dashboards to visualize KYC data and KPIs, including onboarding and review volumes, risk distribution, cycle times, waiting times, and handovers, preferably using Power BI. Translate findings into actionable insights to support business decisions and process improvements.
  • Prototype KYC data solutions and dashboards to validate business requirements and refine designs based on feedback.
  • Process Optimization: Streamline KYC data workflows to maximize reusability and efficiency, reducing duplicate data collection and manual checks. Use process history to measure cycle times, waiting times, handovers, and rework, and identify opportunities for process improvement.
  • Advocate for best practices in data security, architecture, and compliance, aligning with IT and risk management standards.

Language Requirements:

  • Strong written and spoken communication skills in Dutch or French.
  • Strong written and spoken communication skills in English.
  • Excellent communication skills, with fluency in Dutch, French, and English, to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as statistics, mathematics, or engineering.
  • Candidates with other academic backgrounds and substantial knowledge of analytics are also encouraged to apply.

Required Experience and Technical Knowledge:

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics.
  • Mandatory: 2–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, with a focus on KYC, customer due diligence, or financial crime prevention.
  • Mandatory: Proficiency in SQL, including writing and running queries to extract, join, validate, and analyze data, and proficiency with data modeling tools such as PowerDesigner or equivalent.
  • Mandatory: Hands-on experience with reporting and dashboard tools such as Tableau, BO, or SAS to visualize data, monitor KPIs, and generate actionable business insights.
  • Preferable: Hands-on experience building interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI is highly appreciated but not mandatory.
  • Preferable: Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools such as JIRA and Agile Central.

Business Experience:

  • Deep understanding of banking and KYC data, particularly customer identification, legal entity structures, beneficial ownership, related parties, customer risk assessments, screening outcomes, and onboarding and review workflows.
  • Proven ability to capture, document, and manage functional and non-functional requirements for data solutions.
  • Knowledge of data security, IT architecture, and financial services operations.
  • Hands-on experience with data quality frameworks, including rule definition, monitoring, and issue escalation.
  • Ability to coordinate input from multiple stakeholders, including IT, Data Services, Compliance (CPL), KYC Operations, and Front Office, through structured documentation, workshops, and clear communication, requiring project management skills.

Soft Skills:

  • Proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to drive initiatives independently while collaborating across teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a quality-focused approach.
  • Excellent communication skills to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Adaptability and eagerness to learn, with the ability to connect strategic goals to operational execution.

Why Join Keystone Solutions:

This is a consultancy opportunity where you will build your identity as a Keystone Solutions consultant while delivering meaningful results within a client environment. On-site collaboration gives you direct exposure to complex technical, operational, regulatory, and strategic challenges.

  • Dynamic Projects: Develop your consulting expertise by addressing diverse challenges across client environments and business contexts.
  • Turbo-Charged Learning: Broaden your technical, business, and stakeholder-management capabilities through intensive professional development and varied consulting experiences.
  • Skyrocketing Ambition: Grow your career within a consultancy framework designed to support increasing responsibility, expertise, and ambition.
  • Be a K-Stone: Bring Keystone Solutions' core values to every engagement and represent our consultant identity through collaboration, initiative, quality, and commitment to client outcomes.

Apply Now:

If you are ready to tackle technical and strategic challenges in a dynamic consultancy environment, apply today at Keystone Solutions Career Portal.

Det jobbes for tiden med en rekke initiativ innenfor Helsesamhandling hvor behovet for en vel definert informasjonsmodell står sentralt. I tillegg har Helse og Omsorgsdepartementet kommet med et oppdragsdokument med tillegg som omfatter en del ny funksjonalitet for innbygger, hvor HSØ har prioritert arbeidet med «Mitt Timevalg – Endring av tildelt time på Helsenorge»

For å realisere gode løsninger og oppnå suksess står samhandling mellom en rekke fagsystemer sentralt, hvor områder som standardisering og harmonisering av terminologier, semantikk og etablering av konsistente kodeverk er sentralt.

For Mitt Timevalg tar utviklingen utgangspunkt i løsningen Mine Timeavtaler/Timer 2.0 og vil bli en nasjonal løsning for spesialisthelsetjenesten.

Konsulentens oppgaver

Standardisering av begreper, informasjonsmodeller og informasjonsstrukturer på regionalt nivå og opp mot nasjonale aktører. Rollen skal sikre at faglige, semantiske og tekniske krav omsettes til konsistente og gjenbrukbare informasjonsstrukturer som kan benyttes i anskaffelser, utvikling og forvaltning av digitale helseløsninger.

Hovedoppgaver:

•Utvikle, beskrive og vedlikeholde felles begrepsmodeller, informasjonsmodeller og informasjonsstrukturer for helseområdet med hovedfokus på samhandling

•Sikre harmonisering av begrepsapparat på tvers av fagområder, løsninger og organisatoriske nivåer.

•Bidra til etablering og forvaltning av nasjonale og regionale informasjonsstandarder og arkitekturprinsipper som omfattes av oppdraget.

•Utarbeide og kvalitetssikre krav til leverandører knyttet til informasjonsstruktur, semantikk, kodeverk, terminologi og interoperabilitet.

•Samarbeide med fagmiljøer, arkitekter, produkteiere, klinikere og leverandører for å sikre at informasjonsbehov blir korrekt representert og standardisert.

•Delta i vurdering og bruk av relevante standarder, kodeverk og terminologier, eksempelvis SNOMED CT, ICD, NCMP, NCSP og HL7 FHIR med særlig fokus på HL7 FHIR.

title: Programme Officer (Infrastructure) (P)
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from first- and second-tier candidates, particularly qualified female candidates as well as applications from the non-represented member countries of IOM. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process.

For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates:

  1. Internal candidates
  2. Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Cabo Verde, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Tuvalu, Vanuatu

Second tier candidates include:
All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM.

Organizational Context and Scope

The International Organization for Migration (IOM) office in Lebanon is responding to changing border management needs in a complex operational and humanitarian setting, particularly at land borders. Mixed migration flows and increased mobility influenced by regional dynamics highlight the need for enhanced operational capacity to ensure safe, orderly, and effective border operations. In this context, IOM Lebanon supports national border management authorities to strengthen border infrastructure and operational readiness. This includes interventions supporting the rehabilitation, upgrade or full reconstruction of key border crossing points across the country.

Under the overall supervision of the Head of Programmes, under the direct supervision of the Immigration and Border Governance (IBG) Programme Manager, and in coordination with relevant Programme Managers (PMs), the Regional Office (RO) for the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) and relevant units at Headquarters (HQ), the Programme Officer (Infrastructure) will be responsible and accountable for the technical coordination, management, and oversight of assigned infrastructure projects within IOM Lebanon’s IBG portfolio.

1. Coordinate the implementation of assigned engineering and infrastructure projects, monitor timelines, budget utilization, and compliance with IOM regulations, operational requirements, and technical standards, to enable timely and cost-effective delivery of project results.
2. Supervise the assigned engineering staff, consultants, and contractors, and monitor performance, compliance with safety and environmental standards, and proper validation of technical documentation.
3. Provide technical guidance on the design, rehabilitation, and construction of infrastructure projects, including border facilities, public buildings, and civil works, applying established engineering standards to achieve sound, feasible, and sustainable infrastructure solutions.
4. Review tender documents, including detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and multidisciplinary designs (architectural, civil, electrical, and mechanical), verifying accuracy, feasibility, and compliance with relevant codes and standards to support transparent procurement.
5. Monitor the implementation of infrastructure projects through remote follow-up and regular visits to the areas of operation, assessing adherence with contractual requirements, approved designs, specifications, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
6. Coordinate contract administration with service providers and contractors, reviewing requests for modifications, close-out procedures and interim/final payments to the contractors in coordination with IOM Supply Chain and Finance Units, to safeguard contractual compliance and sound financial control.
7. Contribute to establishing infrastructure priorities, technical standards, quality-assurance arrangements and resource requirements for IOM Lebanon, providing technical analysis and inputs to inform programme planning decisions of the supervisor.
8. Contribute to the development of new engineering and infrastructure project proposals, analyzing technical, cost and operational requirements to ensure alignment with national priorities, donor interests, and emerging operational needs.
9. Liaise at the technical level with relevant government authorities, implementing entities, engineering consultants, and other project stakeholders, preparing and participating in technical steering committees and tracking agreed actions to facilitate timely approvals and technical decisions.
10. Review infrastructure designs and implementation for the integration of sustainability principles, accessibility for people with disabilities, and gender considerations, advising project teams to promote inclusive and environmentally responsible infrastructure.
11. Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Project Management, or Construction Management, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or,
  • University degree in the above fields with seven years of relevant professional experience

Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.

Experience

  • Progressive professional experience in the management and supervision of large-scale international civil engineering and infrastructure development projects;
  • Demonstrated experience in the design, rehabilitation, and construction of public infrastructure and institutional facilities, including preparation and review of technical documentation such as drawings, BOQs, technical specifications, and cost estimates;
  • Experience in contract management of construction works, including preparation of technical specifications, bid evaluation, and contract administration;
  • Experience working with governmental authorities, UN agencies, donors, and other stakeholders in a multi-partner environment, including familiarity with UN and bilateral donor programming, reporting requirements, and compliance standards;
  • Experience in border infrastructure projects, including the design, construction, and rehabilitation of border crossing points, is a strong advantage; and,
  • Experience working in the Middle East and North Africa regions is an advantage.

Skills

  • Excellent leadership, coordination, and information management skills;
  • Proven ability to establish and maintain strong working relations with relevant Government counterparts, international organizations, and private sector entities;
  • Excellent organizational skills: ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines in a fast-paced and detail-oriented team environment;
  • Demonstrated technical knowledge of civil, electrical, mechanical engineering, and construction management principles;
  • Proficient use of AutoCAD, Revit, and other relevant Engineering and Project Management software;
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel); and,
  • Knowledge of the UN System, NGOs, and other international organizations/institutions.

Languages

For this position, fluency in English and Arabic is required (oral and written).

Working knowledge of another official UN language (Chinese, French, Russian and Spanish) is an advantage.

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2

  • Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential.
  • Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential.
  • Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty.
  • Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction.
  • Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings.

Notes

Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months.

Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security as well as accreditation, any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and any forms of discrimination. IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children.

IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times.

IOM does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for application, interview, processing, training, or otherwise—and does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM WAVE system (for internal candidates link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

title: Disrepair Coordinator
description:
Our Repairs and Maintenance teams play an important role in delivering our vision of providing great homes and great service. They offer vital support, ensuring that our homes are safe, warm, and dry, and where everything works; places where our residents are proud to live.

Guinness Property has a new opportunity for a Disrepair Coordinator to join our team on a full-time, permanent basis. The role is based in Oldham and offers a hybrid working arrangement, combining office-based working with home working to provide flexibility and work-life balance.

About the role
As a Disrepair Coordinator you will be responsible for coordinating and supporting the effective management of disrepair cases from initial claim through to resolution. You will plan and manage surveyor diaries, coordinate inspections and repair appointments, and work closely with residents, contractors and internal teams to ensure repairs are delivered within agreed timescales, legal requirements and service standards. Maintaining accurate case records, scheduling information and communication updates will be key to ensuring a smooth customer journey and effective case progression.

You will also support the legal and financial administration of disrepair cases by processing new claims, preparing high-quality court and disclosure bundles, maintaining settlement and compensation records, and ensuring compliance with pre-action protocols and GDPR requirements. In addition, you will promote safe working practices, adhere to Health & Safety standards, and support safeguarding responsibilities by identifying and escalating any concerns relating to customer wellbeing throughout the disrepair process.

You will be able to demonstrate these essential skills:

  • Experience of working in a customer-focused environment.

  • Experience of working within agreed performance targets.

  • Excellent oral and written communications.

  • Proven ability to work methodically, follow agreed procedures and accurately record data and information.

  • Microsoft Office including Word and Excel.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and under pressure.

  • Experience of working with databases.

  • Evidence of competency in a relevant trade.

  • Demonstrate the Guinness Behaviours.

Essential qualifications:

  • Educated to NVQ Level 3 or equivalent A levels.

If you are interested in joining us and would like to apply for this role, please review the role profile to view all of the key responsibilities and to ensure you meet the essential criteria.
