title: Health & Wellness Coordinator - Part Time | Walnut Creek Family YMCA
description:
There's nothing like working at the Y!


At the Y, strengthening community is our cause. Our staff members are people who drive this cause – it is because of our drive, our passion, our belief in others, and our belief in the strength of our mission that we are able to make a difference.

EVERY position positively impacts others at the Y - JOIN US, WE MAKE A DIFFERENCE!

JOB LOCATION: Walnut Creek Family YMCA
SCHEDULE: Part Time Position (15-20 hours a week) - Flexible but variable hours
PAY RANGE: $16.00-$19.00/hour
CLOSING DATE FOR APPLICATIONS: November 26, 2026; Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis

POSITION SUMMARY:
This position is a key part of the leadership team and is responsible for creating and delivering systems that support a positive, member-focused culture. This is carried out through role modeling, establishing expectations, communicating and making decisions that are consistent with this culture. This position is also responsible for planning, management and supervision of staff and budget for Healthy Living programs, which may include our Wellness Center and Group Exercise.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Create a work environment that exemplifies the Y’s culture and how we show up and supports ownership and accountability for staff members.
  2. Serve as a key role model and connection point for relationship building, general information, and customer service.
  3. Promote member engagement by encouraging involvement in related Y programs and small communities.
  4. Provide leadership, management and direction to staff.
  5. Hire, train, supervise, and evaluate staff team members to ensure satisfactory job performance.
  6. Conduct regular trainings and staff meetings to support open communication and ongoing staff development and ensure access to development opportunities.
  7. Manage assigned Healthy Living program areas and activities, ensuring programs comply with all applicable operation standards; evaluate and review programs to ensure quality and safety.
  8. Conduct marketing and promotion for healthy living programs, coordinating with association office staff to ensure all marketing meets association and brand requirements.
  9. Manage planned budget and information for Healthy Living programs to ensure revenue and expenses are consistent with approved budget plan.
  10. Know emergency procedures and be able to demonstrate them to others.
  11. Attend department, branch and association staff meetings as required.
  12. Perform additional duties as assigned by supervisor or designated staff person.
  13. Demonstrate and support the objectives of the Association as embodied in the mission statement and values.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  1. Ability to read, write, and perform simple mathematical functions
  2. Must be at least 21 years of age
  3. One to three years supervisory experience and/or team leadership
  4. One to three years customer service experience
  5. A minimum 6 months of Healthy Living related experience preferably in program development and/or program management.
  6. Efficiency with all Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office products
  7. Current Red Cross CPR/First Aid/AED Certification OR equivalent – prior to starting.
  8. Child Abuse Prevention Training- prior to starting if hired.
  9. Additional training to be assigned and completed within 30 days and maintained afterwards.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the responsibilities of this position, the employee is:

  • Required to talk and hear.
  • Regularly required to use a computer for extended periods of time and be able to communicate using a computer and phone/smart device.
  • Often required to stand, walk and use their hands and fingers, to handle or feel.
  • Occasionally required to sit, reach with arms and hands, and lift up to ten pounds of weight.
  • Vision abilities required by this job includes close and distance vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate. This position usually works in an office and fitness center oriented environment, but the mission of the organization may sometimes take them to non-standard workplaces. This position may need to occasionally work evening, weekend, and additional hours to ensure facility coverage and accommodate activities such as special events and representing the organization at community events.

title: Part-Time Manager
description:
Part-Time Manager Opportunity

Join the team. Drive Sales. Be the Most You!

At Claire’s, we’re all about self-expression, creativity, and bringing the latest trends to life for our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced retail environment, love engaging with customers, and have a passion for driving sales, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Responsibilities

  • Own the Sales Game: Crush sales goals by delivering next-level customer experiences, upselling must-have accessories, and hyping up promos to drive revenue.
  • Piercing Excellence: Join the ranks of our piercing experts through comprehensive training. Become a trusted guide for customers - conducting piercings, educating on aftercare, maintaining a sterile environment, addressing questions and concerns throughout the process.
  • Keep It Fresh: Maintain an Insta-worthy store with perfect displays, organized inventory, and easy-to-shop layouts that make browsing fun and effortless.
  • Team Collaboration: Support your Store Manager by motivating the team, sharing sales tips, and creating a positive, high-energy vibe that customers (and coworkers) love.
  • Brand Representation: Showcase Claire's products and services. Stay plugged into the latest fashion and social media trends to help customers find their perfect style. Use your knowledge to suggest products and boost sales.
  • Store Operations: Keep the heartbeat of our store strong by overseeing operations with efficiency and flair. From managing inventory and handling cash transactions to visual merchandising and coordinating promotional activities. You ensure that every aspect of store operations reflects the fun and joy that defines Claire's.
  • Create Shareable Moments: Encourage customers to show off their new accessories and piercings on social media, turning their Claire’s haul into the next viral moment.

About You

  • Sales-Obsessed Energy: You love the thrill of making a sale, hitting goals, and turning browsers into buyers.
  • Social & Digital Savvy: You know what’s trending, what’s viral, and how to translate that into an amazing customer experience.
  • Customer-First Mentality: You get people, and you love making them feel confident and empowered.
  • Retail & Leadership Skills: At least one year of retail experience, ideally with some leadership or sales-driving responsibility.
  • Ready to Hustle: You’re organized, self-motivated, and always looking for ways to level up.

Job Requirements

  • You can conduct piercings and demonstrate patience and empathy, particularly with young or anxious customers.
  • You are proficient in operating a POS system to facilitate transactions and manage sales efficiently, contributing to smooth store operations.
  • You have completed some high school and have at least one year of retail management experience.
  • You can stand during scheduled shifts and maneuver 11-35kg (25-75lbs).
  • You can bend, stoop, extended reaching, and climb ladders or step stools while placing merchandise throughout the store and assisting customers.
  • You are passionate about providing our customers with opportunities to express themselves freely every day.
  • You are energized by interacting with customers and stive to provide excellent service throughout their visit.
  • You are inspired by our values of teamwork, compassion, integrity, customer delight, diversity, and self-expression.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with customers, employees, and management.
  • You possess a strong grasp of mathematics, essential for tasks such as inventory management, sales analysis, and cash handling.
  • You are a driven team player with a positive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • You’re self-motivated and organized, as some of our stores may require you to work alone at times.
  • You show a passion for fashion and stay up to date with the latest trends, which can contribute to enhancing the customer experience and driving sales.
  • You can create a curated fashion look with product during your shift.

Perks and Benefits

  • Epic Employee Discount: Score the latest accessories at an amazing discount!
  • Career Glow-Up: Real opportunities for promotions and career growth.
  • Fun, Fast-Paced Vibes: Work in an upbeat, inclusive, and supportive environment where your personality shines.

Candidate Journey

  • Upon submitting your application, you can expect an update within 5 days. If the hiring manager wants to proceed with your application, the process will involve a face-to-face interview in one of our stores. This will provide you with the opportunity to showcase your passion for customer service, teamwork, and self-expression, while also giving us a chance to get to know you better.

PART-TIME STORE ASSISTANT MANAGER

WHO WE ARE

Claire’s has safely pierced over 110 million ears worldwide and operates under a structured, step-by-step clinical piercing approach that prioritizes safety, sterility, and informed guest education at every stage of the service.

Our Piercing Specialists complete structured certification and ongoing skill validation to ensure every piercing is delivered with precision, consistency, and confidence — especially for first-time and pediatric guests.

As a global fashion brand rooted in self-expression, creativity, and fun, we bring the latest trends in accessories and professional piercing services to life through engaging retail experiences that empower customers to be their most authentic selves.

OVERVIEW

As a Part-Time Store Assistant Manager, you are a sales-driven leader and certified Piercing Specialist who plays a critical role in delivering safe, professional piercing services while driving store performance during key shifts. You lead by example on the sales floor, uphold Claire’s Clinical Piercing Standards, and ensure piercing services are executed with precision, consistency, and care.

You reinforce selling behaviors, elevate piercing and retail performance, and support operational excellence while fostering a positive, accountable team environment. Through confident coaching and strong execution, you help your team deliver exceptional guest experiences — from informed piercing consultations to trend-driven styling moments.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Piercing Excellence | Clinical Standards

· Deliver professional ear-piercing services in accordance with Claire’s Clinical Piercing Standards and safety protocols.

· Follow all sterilization, hygiene, and infection-prevention procedures with precision and consistency before, during, and after every service.

· Educate guests and guardians through informed consent, eligibility screening, and clear aftercare instructions.

· Maintain certification requirements and complete ongoing piercing skill development training.

Customer Experience | Brand Ambassador

  • Inspire customers and teammates through confident brand storytelling.

  • Consistently deliver friendly, engaging services that keep customers coming back and build loyalty to the brand.

  • Lead by example on the sales floor, demonstrating strong selling behaviors and styling expertise.

  • Address customer concerns with empathy and escalate appropriately when needed.

  • Contribute to meeting and/or exceeding all KPI goals and objectives for the store by providing best-in-class service.

Sales Performance | Results

  • Drive shift-level piercing and retail conversion, ensuring strong product attachment and consistent service execution across the team.

  • Coach associates in real time to improve consultation quality, attachment behaviors, and overall selling effectiveness.

  • Support execution of promotions, campaigns, and sales-driving initiatives.

  • Use product knowledge and trend awareness to influence purchasing decisions.

  • Consistently meet or exceed all store sales, piercing, and conversion goals.

People | Team Leadership

  • Build strong relationships with peers and contribute to a positive, inclusive, and high-energy team culture.

  • Reinforce selling standards, service expectations, and brand behaviors.

  • Support the coaching and motivation of Sales Associates through real-time feedback.

  • Act as a role model for reliability, professionalism, and accountability.

Operations | Shift Leadership

  • Open and close the store and manage cash handling accurately.

  • Maintain visual merchandising standards and ensure stock areas are organized.

  • Support shipment processing, inventory accuracy, and adherence to safety and loss prevention practices.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store that reflects Claire’s brand standards and creates a great shopping experience.

  • Execute operational tasks and company initiatives as directed by store leadership.

ABOUT YOU

  • Sales-Driven Mindset | Personal Responsibility: You thrive on meeting and exceeding sales targets, always looking for ways to maximize opportunities – and you take full ownership of results without excuses.

  • Customer-Centric Approach | Integrity: You’re passionate about providing exceptional service and creating memorable shopping experiences, and you lead with integrity by consistently following through on your commitments to both customers and your team.

  • Retail & Leadership Experience | Decision Making: At least one year of retail management experience preferred, with a proven ability to make timely, thoughtful decisions that drive sales and support team success.

  • Confidence in Piercing Services | Growth Mindset: You’re willing to become a trained piercing specialist and provide expert guidance to customers, with a curiosity and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

  • Strong Communication & Selling Skills | Intentional Communication: You know how to engage customers, build relationships, and close the sale by communicating with clarity and purpose to move the business forward.

  • Team-Oriented Leader | Collaboration & Teamwork: You actively build trust, foster an inclusive team culture, and know that winning and losing happen together.

  • Ability to Work Independently | Decision Making: You’re self-motivated, organized, and can make timely, confident decisions even when information is incomplete.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Experience & Skills

  • Previous retail experience, with exposure to sales or leadership responsibilities preferred.

  • Strong customer service and selling skills.

  • Ability to provide feedback and guidance to peers in a supportive way.

  • Comfort operating POS systems and handling cash accurately.

Operational & Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and move throughout the store for extended periods.

  • Ability to lift, carry, and move merchandise (up to 25–75 lbs as required).

  • Ability to bend, reach, stoop, and use ladders or step stools safely.

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Additional Requirements

· Must become a certified Claire’s Piercing Specialist and perform piercings in strict accordance with documented clinical, safety, and hygiene standards.

  • Demonstrate controlled, standardized piercing technique with precision and adherence to placement, sanitation, and safety protocols, maintaining professional composure with pediatric and first-time guests.

  • Strong verbal communication skills and a positive, team-oriented attitude.

  • Commitment to upholding brand values, policies, and safety standards.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

· Full-Time employees will be eligible for benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program, Life Insurance, HSA).

· Generous employee discount on Claire's products.

· Opportunities for advancement and career development.

· Fun and inclusive work environment with supportive teammates.

CANDIDATE JOURNEY

Upon submitting your application, you can expect an update within 5 days. If the hiring manager wants to proceed with your application, the process will involve a face-to-face interview in one of our stores. This will provide you with the opportunity to showcase your passion for customer service, teamwork, and self-expression, while also giving us a chance to get to know you better.

Claire's is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity and inclusion and we encourage applications from members of all underrepresented groups, including those with disabilities. We will accommodate applicants' needs, upon request, throughout all the stages of the recruitment process. Please inform us of the accommodation(s) that you may require.

title: Faglig velfunderet teamleder til tværgående team med bred faglighed
description:
Har du erfaring med at lede medarbejdere i en politisk ledet organisation? Vil du være med til at sikre gennemførelse af den grønne trepartsaftale gennem jordfordeling? Har du orden i pennalhuset og sørger for, at det forbliver sådan? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter, som teamleder for vores Team udvikling og support i Tønder.

Teamet
Teamet er tværgående for den samlede enhed på ca. 100 medarbejdere og er i alt bestående af 13 medarbejdere. Teamet består af en bred vifte af fagligheder. En del af teamet sørger for ledelsesoverblik, koordinering og samarbejde på tværs af styrelsen ift. implementering af den grønne trepart. En anden del af teamet udfører den juridiske understøttelse af styrelsens opkøb, udarbejder lovændring på jordfordelingsloven og sikrer det juridiske grundlag i kontrakter. Den sidste del af teamet er enhedens GIS eksperter i forhold til jordfordelingsløsninger og dataopbygning.

Hvad forventer vi af dig?
Du vil gerne arbejde med mennesker og ser værdi i at skabe løsninger på tværs af flere fagligheder. Du kan blive leder af teamet, hvis du:

  • Er ambitiøs: Du har interesse for implementering og styring af større politiske aftaler. Du finder, inden for rammerne for god forvaltning, løsninger på komplekse problemstillinger i krydsfeltet mellem landbrugs-, miljø- og klimainteresser. Og du har nemt ved at sætte dig ind i nye problemstillinger.
  • Har solide ledelsesmæssige kompetencer: Du har styr på det ledelsesmæssige håndværk, og ved hvordan du skaber resultater gennem andre. Du har lyst til ledelse og til at udvikle dine ledelsesmæssige kompetencer. Du er god til at udtrykke dig klart og forståeligt, både i skrift og tale, uanset om det handler om komplekse faglige problemstillinger eller trivsel og performance.
  • Er engageret: Du viser lyst til at løse dine opgaver, i rette tid, med rette kvalitet og tilpas inddragelse af andre. Du er optaget af, at andre synes godt om dine løsninger. Du har et skarpt blik for detaljerne, kan finde løsninger, der virker i praksis og sikrer samspil på tværs af enheden og styrelsen.
  • Kan samarbejde: Du er i stand til at planlægge komplekse arbejdsopgaver i samarbejde med teamlederkolleger. Du tænker den samlede enhed, før du tænker på dit eget team, men du sørger selvfølgelig for, at teamet kommer i mål med sine egne opgaver.
  • Du har forståelse for arbejdet i en politisk ledet organisation med fokus på landbrugs- og miljøområdet og har en god forvaltningsforståelse gerne fra en styrelse.

Hvad kommer du til at lave?
Du bliver teamleder for et team af højt kvalificerede og engagerede medarbejdere med forskellig uddannelsesmæssig baggrund. Du skal ikke være den faglige specialist på alle områder, men du skal have interesse for at forstå teamets opgaver og kunne understøtte medarbejderne i deres arbejde. Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe retning, fremdrift og sammenhæng i en travl hverdag med mange forskelligartede opgaver.

Du kommer til at stifte bekendtskab med en stor del af styrelsen, da vi lægger vægt på det gode samarbejde og koordinering på tværs af hele organisationen – men først og fremmest bliver du bindeleddet i enheden for øvrige teams ønsker til besvarelse af politiske bestillinger, udviklingsopgaver, juridisk understøttelse og GIS support.

Hvem er vi?
Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø arbejder med implementering af Grøn Treparts-aftalen om omlægning af det danske areal og den grønne omstilling af landbruget.

Enheden Natur- & Landbrugsudvikling, hvor teamet er placeret, arbejder med jordfordeling til fremme af miljø, natur samt biodiversitet ved at sikre grundlaget for omlægning af landbrugsarealer til klima- og vådområder.

Der er 13 medarbejdere i teamet. Vi har mange forskellige baggrunde, som for eksempel forstkandidat, landinspektør, jurist, skov- og landskabsingeniør m.fl. Vi går op i, at vi løser vores opgaver med højt humør og i tæt dialog med hinanden og andre i huset.

I Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø har vi flekstid, sund kantine, personaleforening og meget mere til at få dig til at føle på rette plads. Vi elsker at se folk på kontoret, men der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale. Vi har fokus på den enkelte medarbejders trivsel og faglige udvikling. Vi tilbyder derfor løbende kompetenceudvikling.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og relevant organisation. Hvis du er AC’er, sker ansættelsen som chefkonsulent, og der vil være mulighed for at forhandle tillæg.

Ansættelsesområdet er Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd med tilhørende institutioner. Tjenestestedet er Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø, Pionér Allé 9, 6270 Tønder

Du vil få personaleophæng i enheden Natur- & Landbrugsudvikling.

Stillingen ønskes besat 1. januar 2027.

Har du spørgsmål?
Vil du vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Mette Klintebjerg Fuglsang på telefon 93 59 77 58 eller mekfug@sgav.dk.

Sådan ansøger du
Du søger stillingen ved at sende en motiveret ansøgning med CV og dokumentation for uddannelse/beståede eksamener og eventuelle referencer online i vores rekrutteringssystem senest fredag den 20. november 2026.

Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning.

Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler i uge 48. Du skal være indstillet på at gennemføre test i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen.

title: Vil du gøre en forskel? Vi søger en special- eller chefkonsulent til ressourcestyring i Udlændingestyrelsen
description:
Vil du være med til at sætte retning for udviklingen af vores nyetablerede ressourcestyringskoncept? Og vil du kombinere stærke analytiske og økonomistyringskompetencer med evnen til at tænke på tværs og styrke grundlaget for ledelsesmæssig og proaktiv prioritering i organisationen?

Så er det dig, som vi leder efter.

Vi søger en konsulent, der vil være med til at styrke og videreudvikle Udlændingestyrelsens lønsums- og ressourcestyring og dermed være med til at sikre sammenhæng mellem økonomi, bemanding, kapacitet og opgaveløsning i vores store og komplekse styrelse.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan omsætte data, analyser og prognoser til en dybere indsigt, som ikke blot beskriver udviklingen, men som også gør os i stand til at forstå sammenhænge, vurdere konkrete handlemuligheder og prioritere fremadrettet.

Du trives med at gå i dybden med data, beregninger og modeller, men kan også løfte blikket fra tallene og formidle komplekse problemstillinger klart og præcist og indgå i dialog med ledelsen om, hvad resultaterne betyder for styrelsens drift og prioriteringer.

Om arbejdspladsen
Hos os arbejder nogle af landets skarpeste faglige hoveder med komplekse problemstillinger i et område med stor offentlig og politisk bevågenhed. Vi er ca. 700 medarbejdere fordelt på flere centre, hvor styring og prioritering spiller en central rolle i opgaveløsningen.

Du kan læse mere om os her.

Velkommen til dit nye team
Du bliver ansat i et kontor med ca. 25 medarbejdere, og du bliver en del af et team, der arbejder med både økonomi-, aktivitets- løn-, og ressourcestyring.

Kontoret arbejder med bevillinger til styrelsens almindelige virksomhed, it-området og asylindkvarteringsområdet. Du får derfor indblik i flere dele af organisationen og kommer til at samarbejde med både ledere og medarbejdere på tværs af styrelsen.

Vi arbejder desuden tæt sammen med vores søsterkontor, Kontoret for Forretningsudvikling, blandt andet om sammenhængen mellem data, ressourcestyring og procesoptimering.

Hos os er der plads til faglige diskussioner, forskellige perspektiver og godt humør. Vi hjælper hinanden, når opgaverne kræver det, og lægger vægt på, at der også er balance mellem arbejde og fritid.

Din nye rolle
Du får en vigtig rolle i den løbende lønsums- og ressourcestyring og i arbejdet med at videreudvikle vores eksisterende modeller og styringsværktøjer.

Du får tæt kontakt til ledelsen, hvor du skal omsætte, præsentere og drøfte vores analyser og bidrage med selvstændige faglige vurderinger og handlemuligheder.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • opdatere og videreudvikle lønsumsprognoser og - styring
  • omsætte data og analyser til konkrete prioriteringer
  • bidrage til kapacitets- og aktivitetsprognoser
  • identificere udfordringer i driften og bringe dem ind i styringen
  • udvikle nøgletal og styringsværktøjer
  • planlægge og gennemføre drifts- og opfølgningsmøder med ledere og kontorer
  • sikre fremdrift og følge op på aftaler og indsatser
  • understøtte projektøkonomi på relevante områder, herunder it

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til de statslige økonomisystemer.

Om dig
Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for fx samfundsvidenskab, økonomi, forvaltning eller lignende områder, hvor du har arbejdet med analyse, styring eller data.
Du er analytisk stærk og har lyst til at arbejde med komplekse økonomiske og organisatoriske problemstillinger. Du kan lide at fordybe dig i data og modeller, men er samtidig nysgerrig på, hvad der ligger bag tallene, og hvordan resultaterne hænger sammen med den daglige drift.

Vi søger en kollega, der kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for sine opgaver, men som også trives i et miljø, hvor løsninger udvikles gennem samarbejde og faglig sparring.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • har stærke analytiske og tekniske kompetencer og er fortrolig med Excel og gerne Power BI
  • har erfaring med styring, drift eller implementering – gerne fra en offentlig organisation
  • arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar og kan skabe fremdrift i en kompleks organisation
  • kan tænke på tværs og se sammenhænge mellem økonomi, kapacitet og drift
  • er en stærk formidler, både skriftligt og mundtligt, og kan kommunikere klart og præcist på ledelsesniveau
  • har gennemslagskraft og trives med samarbejde og dialog med ledere på forskellige niveauer

Det får du hos os
Hos os får du en stilling med stor mulighed for at præge udviklingen af et vigtigt styringsområde.

Vi tilbyder:

  • fagligt udfordrende og varierede opgaver
  • mulighed for at udvikle og forbedre vores styringsmetoder og værktøjer
  • gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • sparring og videndeling med erfarne kolleger

Nysgerrig?
Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Rebecca Markussen på e-mail rbcc@us.dk eller telefon 2117 1621.

Er du vores nye kollega?
Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis mv. senest den 26. november 2026.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge i 50.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Du ansættes efter overenskomst for akademikere i staten og vil blive indplaceret som specialkonsulent eller chefkonsulent på baggrund af dine kvalifikationer og erfaring. Der er mulighed for at forhandle tillæg, der matcher dine kvalifikationer

Ansættelsesområdet er Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet med tilhørende institutioner, og arbejdsstedet er Udlændingestyrelsen, Farimagsvej 51A, 4700 Næstved.

Stillingen er en fast stilling på fuldtid med gennemsnitligt 37 timer om ugen.

Du skal være sikkerhedsgodkendt til ”TJENESTEBRUG” for at arbejde i denne stilling og kunne opretholde denne under hele din ansættelse.

Du kan læse om, hvordan vi behandler dine persondata her.

Ligestilling i alle dens aspekter er vigtig. Derfor opfordres alle interesserede uanset etnisktilhørsforhold, religion, køn, alder og lign. til at søge stillingen. Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet er medlem af Foreningen Lige Adgang.

title: Akademisk medarbejder til EU-projekt om antibiotikaresistens og infektionshygiejne
description:
Har du erfaring med internationale projekter, epidemiologi og samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder og landegrænser? Og vil du være med til at styrke forebyggelsen af infektioner med antibiotikaresistente bakterier i Europa? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Central Enhed for Infektionshygiejne.

Vi søger en akademisk medarbejder til en spændende projektansættelse, hvor du får mulighed for at bidrage til et internationalt samarbejde om en af de væsentlige udfordringer for folkesundheden.

Jobbets hovedindhold
Du bliver en vigtig del af arbejdet med EU-projektet EU-JAMRAI 2, som er et internationalt samarbejde om at bekæmpe antibiotikaresistens og forebygge infektioner fra antibiotikaresistente bakterier. Projektet løber frem til juni 2028 og involverer samarbejdspartnere fra en række europæiske lande.

Du får en central rolle i koordineringen og gennemførelsen af projektets aktiviteter med særligt fokus på udvikling af metoder og værktøjer til at styrke infektionshygiejnen i sundhedssektoren.

En af dine væsentligste opgaver bliver at bidrage til udviklingen af et peer-to-peer-program, der skal understøtte sundhedsinstitutioner i at vurdere og videreudvikle deres infektionshygiejniske kompetencer. Du vil desuden medvirke til udvikling af faglige og tekniske værktøjer, der kan understøtte dette arbejde.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Koordinering, planlægning og opfølgning på projektaktiviteter i tæt samarbejde med nationale og internationale partnere.
  • Bidrage til metodeudvikling og udvikling af faglige værktøjer inden for infektionshygiejne.
  • Deltagelse i internationale arbejdsgrupper, projektmøder og faglige drøftelser.
  • Analyse, dokumentation og formidling af projektets resultater, herunder udarbejdelse af rapporter, videnskabelige artikler og indhold til hjemmesider.
  • Understøtte den daglige projektledelse, herunder koordinering af leverancer og faglig afrapportering til EU.

Stillingen er en tidsbegrænset projektansættelse med ansættelse per 1. januar 2027 frem til og med den 30. juni 2028.

Din uddannelse, erfaring og personlige kvalifikationer
Du har en relevant akademisk uddannelse som fx kandidatgrad inden for global sundhed folkesundhedsvidenskab eller tilsvarende.

Herudover forventer vi, at du:

  • har erfaring med internationale projekter og samarbejde med internationale institutioner
  • har kendskab til sundhedssektoren
  • har erfaring med epidemiologiske metoder og epidemiologisk forskning, herunder registerbaserede forskningsprojekter
  • har praktisk kendskab til overvågning af smitsomme sygdomme
  • har erfaring i at organisere og prioritere arbejdsopgaver på tværs af teams i en travl hverdag
  • har initiativ og arbejder selvstændig, ansvarligt og målrettet
  • har gode kommunikative kompetencer i både dansk og engelsk såvel i skrift som i tale.

Erfaring med infektionshygiejne vil være en fordel.

Om os
Vi er en tværfaglig afdeling bestående af ca. 60 medarbejdere fordelt på læger, sygeplejersker, statistikere, biologer, folkesundhedsvidenskabskandidater, dyrlæger m.fl. Vi overvåger, analyserer og rådgiver om smitsomme sygdomme og deltager i det operationelle beredskab ved sygdomsudbrud.

CEI udgør en selvstændig sektion med 11 medarbejdere bestående af speciallæger i klinisk mikrobiologi og samfundsmedicin, hygiejnesygeplejersker samt specialkonsulenter. CEI varetager den centrale koordinering af det infektionshygiejniske arbejde gennem rådgivning og vejledning af primær og sekundær sundhedssektor, diverse ministerier og styrelser.

Vi er en fagligt og socialt velfungerende afdeling med stor ekspertise inden for smitsomme sygdomme og fokus på medarbejdernes trivsel.

Vi tilbyder
SSI er en arbejdsplads, der er internationalt anerkendt for at løse nationale og globale sundhedsopgaver. Du bliver en del af en organisation med ca. 850 medarbejdere, der løfter meningsfulde opgaver, som styrker menneskers og dyrs sundhed gennem forskning og beredskab.

Vores hverdag er præget af mange forskelligartede opgaver, åbne døre og et bredt samarbejde med engagerede og dygtige kolleger.

Du får mulighed for en fleksibel hverdag med en god balance mellem arbejde og fritid, da SSI er en arbejdsplads med en 37-timers arbejdsuge inkl. frokostpause, flekstidsaftale samt mulighed for en ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag afhængigt af arbejdsopgaver og fleksibel arbejdstidstilrettelæggelse.

På SSI har vi en aktiv personale- og idrætsforening (IK-SERA) med holdtræning og motionslokaler, gratis kaffe/te og frugtordning, fredagsbar og forskellige sociale arrangementer – og vores Campus rummer endda både tennisbane og egen børneinstitution.

SSI er placeret centralt i København med grønne arealer og gode offentlige transportmuligheder (bus og metro) og har fri parkering på området.

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?
Send os dit CV og ansøgning, også selvom du ikke opfylder alle vores forventninger til kriterier eller erfaring. Vi beder dig om ikke at indsætte et foto i dit CV, da vi bestræber os for en inkluderende og biasbevidst rekrutteringsproces med lige muligheder for alle vores jobansøgere.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte JAMRAI projektleder Asja Kunøe, tlf. 32685189.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 48.

Dine ansættelsesvilkår
Du bliver ansat som akademisk medarbejder i henhold til gældende fællesoverenskomst mellem Skatteministeriet og Akademikernes Centralorganisation med en ugentlig arbejdstid på 37 timer.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Director of Information Technology
description:
Counterpart International is a global development organization that empowers people and communities to implement innovative and enduring solutions to social, economic, and environmental challenges. For over 55 years, Counterpart has been forging partnerships with communities in need to address complex problems related to economic development, food security and nutrition, and building effective governance and institutions.

Summary


The Director of Information Technology owns Counterpart's technology strategy, budget, vendor portfolio and risk posture, and leads the IT team. The Sr. Director is accountable for the IT operating budget and its monthly reconciliation to the general ledger, for competitive procurement and contract lifecycle management across the vendor portfolio, for the security, privacy and compliance posture of a hybrid Microsoft environment spanning headquarters and five project offices, for delivery of enterprise system programs serving Finance, HR, MEL and Programs, and for serving as the business partner who converts departmental needs into working systems.


This is a working leadership role. It is approximately 40 % strategy, governance and executive advisory, and 60 % hands-on technical and financial execution. This is a full-time position based in Arlington, VA, and will report to the Chief Operations Officer.


Duties and Responsibilities

Technology strategy and organizational alignment

  • Develop and regularly maintain a multi-year technology roadmap tied directly to Counterpart's organizational goals.
  • Own the build vs. buy vs. outsource posture across the portfolio, and revisit it as organizational size, funding and program mix change.
  • Manage technical debt deliberately, including the legacy footprint, remaining SQL Server and Active Directory dependencies, Azure Cloud and storage cost profile.
  • Plan and lead the technology side of organizational transitions, including growth or contraction, office relocations, and international project office startups and closeouts, so that systems, connectivity, equipment, and data are ready when they are needed and are retired securely when they are not.
  • Advise the executive team on technology cost, risk and opportunity, ensuring technology assumptions are considered before organizational commitments are made.

Financial management and budget ownership

  • Build and own the annual IT operating and capital budget, including consulting with HR, Finance, Communications, MEL, New Business, Corporate and Foundations and Programs on overhead departmental budget.
  • Reconcile spend to the general ledger monthly, by GL account and by vendor, and explain variance to Finance and the executive team.
  • Review general ledger coding accuracy for IT expenditures, including reclassification recommendations, allocation between overhead and project funds, and monthly corporate card reconciliation.
  • Actively manage licensing costs, including Microsoft licensing and enrollment, Azure consumption, Fabric capacity, and AI-related usage billing. Cloud cost management has produced material savings and requires continuous attention rather than periodic review.
  • Identify and pursue nonprofit pricing, discount and grant programs (Microsoft nonprofit pricing and charity accelerator programs) as a direct offset to budget.

Vendor management, procurement and contracts

  • In cooperation with Procurement, structure and run competitive evaluations for all software, hardware or IT service procurements including requirements definition, vendor comparison, reference checking and participating in the evaluation committee.
  • Review and negotiate contracts, statements of work, service level commitments and data protection agreements, with attention to renewal terms, integration costs and exit provisions.
  • Maintain the renewal calendar and contracts tracker and ensure agreements do not auto-renew without deliberate review.
  • Identify downstream and linked costs before commitment, including integration costs across connected systems that would otherwise surface after signature.
  • Hold vendors and external technical consultants account for scope, schedule and deliverables.
  • Formulate and implement long-term strategic and operational plans, including business requirements, project planning, organizing and negotiating the allocation of resources for acquiring and enabling efficient and cost-effective information processing and communication technologies.

Enterprise systems and data platform

  • Own the architecture and roadmap for the Microsoft environment: Microsoft 365, Entra ID and hybrid identity, SharePoint structure and permissions, Azure infrastructure, and SQL platforms.
  • Direct the Power BI and Microsoft Fabric environment, including capacity sizing and cost management, workspace governance and access control, row-level security, data source lineage, and backup and recovery strategy.
  • Oversee the finance and HR system portfolio, including Business Central/Sylogist Mission ERP, QuickBooks Online, expense management, e-signature and payroll and HRIS platforms, and the data integrations between them.
  • Ensure reporting and data flows serving Finance, HR, MEL and Programs are accurate, documented and supportable.

Technical project management

  • Serve as the project manager for enterprise system implementations and migrations.
  • Convert strategy into sequenced, resourced plans with milestones, owners, dependencies and defined completion criteria.
  • Maintain delivery cadence with vendors and staff, and report status, upcoming milestones, blockers and executive asks on a regular reporting rhythm.
  • Produce reports and communicate with stakeholders and management team on project statuses.

AI strategy and governance

  • Own Counterpart's AI Standard: what tools are sanctioned, what data may be used with them, what is prohibited, and what requires review. Keep it current as the technology and the vendor landscape change.
  • Approve AI tool requests, evaluating each on data handling, contractual terms, integration risk and duplication of capability already licensed.
  • Review AI terms and conditions embedded in third-party platforms, including future CRM and program systems, where vendor AI features may carry data privacy concerns that conflict with our commitments to staff, donors and program participants.
  • Forecast and monitor AI-related consumption costs, which behave differently from traditional licensing and are expected to become more volatile as agent-based tools mature.
  • Drive deliberate adoption where AI produces genuine efficiency for headquarters and international staff, including training and enablement, and be equally clear about where AI is not the right answer.
  • Work with the Global Partners and Solution, Programs and Corporate and Foundations departments to advise on technology and AI in international development, connecting it to donor expectations, while recognizing that deep program application may require supplemental external expertise.

Security, risk and compliance

  • Determine the security controls Counterpart requires, and ensure they are implemented, verified and documented.
  • Respond to IT and risk management questionnaires, audit requests, cyber insurance applications and donor compliance inquiries, and be accountable for the accuracy of those representations.
  • Update and maintain IT-related policies including acceptable use, AI, record retention, website privacy, and country-specific personal data processing requirements.
  • Review third-party data access and vendor security posture before granting access to Counterpart systems or data.
  • Maintain backup, recovery and business continuity capability, and verify it rather than assume it.
  • Reduce shadow IT by ensuring departments and projects have a supported path to meet legitimate technology needs, and by identifying unsanctioned systems that create data exposure or provide an unmanaged path into Counterpart's environment.

Cross-functional partnership and requirements definition

  • Partner with organizational departments to understand business needs and provide them with guidance and assistance to translate needs into system requirements.
  • Partner with departments to ensure that purchased solutions are sized to the organization and do not create long-term storage costs, customization debt or licensing we cannot use.
  • Maintain an intake and prioritization process for technology and reporting requests.
  • Represent IT to the executive leadership team in business terms and proactively advise the CFO and COO so that technology implications are weighed before decisions are made.

Team leadership and development

  • Supervise, develop and evaluate IT staff, including goal setting and performance accountability.
  • Define and protect the boundary between operational and strategic work so that operational demand does not consume all available capacity.
  • Coach staff through technical and process decisions in a way that builds independent.
  • Maintain thorough documentation and cross-train staff so that institutional knowledge does not depend on any one person.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible IT experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role with direct budget accountability.
  • Demonstrated Direct experience managing the IT budget cycle starting with building the budget, communicating coding and allocation methodology, conducting variance analysis, and being accountable for the outcome.
  • Ability to partner with Finance on cost allocation methodology for shared technology costs is strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience structuring competitive procurements, negotiating and reviewing contracts and statements of work, and managing vendor performance.
  • Direct experience delivering enterprise system implementations and migrations as the accountable project owner.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks, data privacy obligations and audit or compliance response.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate technology cost, risk and tradeoffs to non-technical executives in business terms.
  • Supervisory experience with demonstrated staff development results.
  • Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Technical qualifications

Required:

  • Microsoft 365 and Azure administration, identity and access management including Entra ID and hybrid Active Directory, and SharePoint architecture and permissions.
  • Practical understanding of Azure cloud cost management, capacity sizing and consumption billing.
  • Familiarity with finance and HR system landscapes, integrations and data flows.

Preferred:

  • Power BI. Ability to read and evaluate data models, measures and report designs, understand row-level security, and assess whether a reporting solution is well constructed or will become unsupportable. Counterpart relies on Power BI for financial, level-of-effort and program reporting.
  • Microsoft Fabric. Familiarity with capacity management, workspace governance, transformations and pipeline concepts, and the cost behavior of Fabric capacity. Counterpart is actively transitioning to Fabric, and this environment will require ongoing architectural and cost decisions.
  • PowerShell. Ability to write and review scripts for administration, reporting, auditing and automation across Microsoft 365, Entra and Azure.
  • Python. Working proficiency for data extraction, transformation, API integration and analysis. Counterpart's system integrations frequently require pulling data from vendor APIs and reshaping it for reporting and finance use.
  • Experience with REST APIs, MCPs and integration testing tools.

title: Bliv turistguide i Østgrønland!
description:
We are seeking a passionate, knowledgeable and dependable Guide to join our Greenland Base Camp Field Team featured on our beginning in June 2027.

The Guide plays an important role in creating safe, meaningful and memorable experiences for our guests. Working alongside Expedition Leaders and other Field Staff, they share their expertise in East Greenland's landscapes, wildlife, history, culture and communities while supporting the day-to-day operation of our small-group adventures.

SCHEDULING & LOCATION

This is a field-based, seasonal contract position from mid-June to mid-September. Assignments may include guiding at our remote Base Camp Greenland in the Sermilik Fjord, supporting excursions in and around Tasiilaq and Kulusuk, or a combination of both. Work may include weekends, early mornings, evenings, and multiple consecutive days in the field.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Interpretation & Education

  • Share engaging and accurate information about East Greenland's wildlife, natural history, geography, culture, traditions and contemporary life, using storytelling and personal perspectives to deepen guests' understanding of the region.
  • Lead or assist with guided hikes, village walks, cultural visits and other excursions appropriate to experience and qualifications.
  • Facilitate meaningful and respectful interactions between guests and local communities.

Guest Experience

  • Provide attentive, personalized guest service while creating a welcoming and inclusive environment.
  • Work closely with Expedition Leaders to ensure guests have safe, enjoyable and enriching experiences.

Operations & Teamwork

  • Work collaboratively with Expedition Leaders, Field Team members, and local partners to support safe, seamless trip operations and clear communication.
  • Assist with excursions, guest transfers, equipment preparation, luggage handling, and daily logistics.

Safety, Problem Solving & Stewardship

  • Prioritize guest safety through sound judgment, awareness of local conditions and proactive risk management.
  • Monitor weather, terrain, wildlife and other environmental hazards, communicating concerns to Expedition Leaders and the operations team.
  • Follow all safety procedures and applicable local guiding regulations.
  • Assist with emergency situations and evacuations as appropriate to training and responsibilities.

REQUIREMENTS

Experience & Skills

  • Fluent in spoken English; Greenlandic language skills preferred.
  • At least one year of professional guiding experience.
  • Strong firsthand knowledge of East Greenland, particularly the Tasiilaq, Kulusuk and/or Sermilik Fjord regions.
  • Previous experience in outdoor guiding, tourism, hospitality or related work preferred.
  • Experience in polar bear country and polar bear safety strongly preferred.

Required Credentials & Certifications

  • First aid and CPR training preferred, with any mandatory activity-specific safety training required before guiding independently.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to work long or irregular hours outdoors in variable Arctic weather conditions.
  • Comfortable hiking on uneven terrain, assisting guests during outdoor activities and boat transfers, and carrying guiding equipment or luggage as needed.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation is commensurate with experience and paid on a daily basis, plus gratuities. Work hours and requirements may vary based on operational needs.

Transportation, meals and accommodations may be provided when assignments require working away from the Local Guide's home community. Specific arrangements will be communicated before assignments are confirmed.

**Please submit all application materials in English only***

Dit drive, erfaringer og ambitioner er afgørende for at fastholde væksten.

title: Erfaren udviklingskonsulent til HR i Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd
description:
Kan du udvikle og drive organisations- og forandringsprocesser, og har du solid erfaring med at arbejde helt tæt på en direktion og omsætte deres tanker og ønsker for organisationens udvikling, så læs med her:

Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd søger en erfaren og ambitiøs HR-udviklingskonsulent, der i tæt samarbejde med HR-chefen og direktionen kan sætte retning for de organisations- og ledelsesudviklingsinitiativer, der skal understøtte den videre udvikling af departementet som en attraktiv arbejdsplads. Vi sætter faglighed højt, men vores opgaver er komplekse og kræver, at alle tager ansvar ikke bare for egen del, men også for sammenhængen. Det kræver, at vi løbende arbejder med at udvikle vores relationelle kompetencer og dygtiggøre os i at prioritere, kommunikere og lede skarpe processer.

Dine opgaver
I stillingen som HR-udviklingskonsulent får du stor selvstændighed, bred berøringsflade og mulighed for at arbejde med opgaver, der har værdi for hele organisationen. Du refererer direkte til HR-chefen og bliver samtidig en væsentlig sparringspartner for direktionen og vigtig drivkraft i at omsætte strategiske direktionsbeslutninger til konkrete handlinger og forandringer i organisationen, der kan understøtte udviklingen af departementets ledelse, organisation og kultur. Du får en central rolle som et vigtigt bindeled både internt i ministeriet og i samarbejdet med tillidsrepræsentanterne og samarbejdsudvalget.

Konkret vil du få ansvaret for en bred vifte af opgaver, herunder:

  • Udvikle, drive og følge op på tværgående processer for PULS (udviklingssamtaler), trivsels- og ledermålinger, APV, onboarding m.v.
  • Udarbejde oplæg til direktionen, der kan danne grundlag for drøftelser ift. udvikling af departementet som organisation, vores kultur og vores ledelsestilgang.
  • Identificere behov for udviklingstiltag målrettet ledelsen og indholdstilrettelægge fx lederseminarer for både direktion og chefgruppe.
  • Sekretariatsbetjene Samarbejds- og Arbejdsmiljøudvalget og følge op på beslutninger og afledte opgaver.
  • Udarbejde og analysere ledelsesinformation om fx sygefravær, personaleomsætning mv. med henblik på iværksættelse af initiativer i organisationen.
  • Tilrettelægge tværgående kompetenceudviklingstiltag på medarbejderniveau og facilitere pipeline for ledertalenter.

Opgaveporteføljen vil løbende udvikle sig i takt med organisationens behov og prioriteringer.

Om dig
Du har en relevant akademisk uddannelse og solid erfaring med HR-udviklingsarbejde. Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • kan udvikle og drive tværgående udviklings- og forandringsprojekter.
  • kan udarbejde analyser, ledelsesinformation, præsentationer og beslutningsoplæg til direktion og chefgruppe.
  • har stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.
  • kan navigere sikkert i en politisk styret organisation.
  • kan arbejde analytisk og omsætte HR-data til brugbar ledelsesinformation og konkrete initiativer.
  • kan arbejde struktureret og håndtere en stor og varieret opgaveportefølje.
  • trives i et miljø, hvor rammer og opgaver løbende udvikler sig.

Hvem er vi?
Du bliver en del af HR-teamet i kontoret for Jura og HR i departementet. Kontoret ledes af to kontorchefer og har 18 medarbejdere, hvoraf seks arbejder med HR. HR-teamet varetager en bred vifte af opgaver, der spænder fra personalejura, administration og rekruttering til organisations- og ledelsesudvikling. Vi har et højt ambitionsniveau, bruger hinanden som sparringspartnere og lader os inspirere af de bedste inden for vores felt.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelsen er på fuld tid, og aflønning sker som special- eller chefkonsulent i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Der vil afhængig af kvalifikationer være mulighed for at forhandle kvalifikationstillæg.

Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. januar 2027.

Ansættelsesområdet er Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd med tilhørende institutioner.

Tjenestestedet er Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd, departementet, Holmens Kanal 22, 1060 København K.

Stillingen kan stille krav om, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelse under hele din ansættelse.

Vil du vide mere
Har du lyst til at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR-chef Dorte Bajda Appel på tlf. 23 99 62 10 eller afdelingschef Lars Bødker Madsen på tlf. 21 24 27 92.

Du søger stillingen ved at sende din ansøgning, CV og uddannelsesbevis senest fredag den 20. november 2026 kl. 12.00.

It will provide hands-on security input into integration patterns, API design, authentication, data flows, secrets management and the implementation of appropriate security controls.

Beyond securing integration-specific components, a key part of this role is enabling the developers who build and manage integrations to do so securely — embedding security by design and secure development practices throughout.

Candidates should have experience supporting regulatory compliance initiatives, operational resilience programs, IT/ICT risk management, governance activities, risk assessments, and remediation programs within banking, capital markets, insurance, asset management, or consulting environments.
