title: Vurderingssagkyndig – Landbrug
description:
Den grønne omstilling af landbruget er i fuld gang, og der er et stort fokus på at finde de rette løsninger. Jordfordeling og opkøb af arealer spiller en central rolle i omlægningen af landbrugsjorden for at skabe optimale løsninger for lodsejerne. Vil du være med til at skabe forandring i det danske landskab? Så tilbyder vi dig en nøglerolle i en spændende proces.

Enheden - Natur- & Landbrugsudvikling
Der er pres på at få udtaget landbrugsjord ad frivillighedens vej, og der er et stort behov for opkøb af ejendomme, som kan anvendes til erstatningsjord. For at imødekomme denne vækst og styrke vores kapacitet søger vi nu tre nye kolleger til vores team af specialister. Teamet besidder allerede stor plantefaglig viden og stærke kompetencer inden for ejendomshandel, og du vil blive en del af et hold, der understøtter udtagningsprocessen med vurdering, dialog, forhandling og køb

Hvis du trives med et arbejde, hvor du er i tæt dialog med landmænd og lodsejere generelt, og hvis du nyder dage i marken med støvlerne på, så er dette job absolut noget for dig. Du får en spændende og afvekslende hverdag med et stærkt hold omkring dig, og med stor indflydelse på planlægning af din egen hverdag.

Teamets opgaver består både af vurdering og opkøb af enkelte ejendomme og gennemførsel af vurderingsforretninger. En vurderingsforretning gennemføres forud for en jordfordeling, og består af en fysisk gennemgang og taksering af alle de arealer, der er berørt af det enkelte udtagningsprojekt. Vurderingsforretningen gennemføres i fællesskab med lodsejerne og en ekstern vurderingssagkyndig.

Dine primære ansvarsområder:

  • Gennemføre vurderingsforretninger i jordfordelinger
  • Forestå vurdering af jord og la
  • Sparring og assistance til jordfordelingspndbrugsejendomme med henblik på opkøb
  • Samarbejde med Naturstyrelsen om vurderingsopgaverlanlæggere og ejendomskonsulenter i forbindelse med konkrete køb af landbrugsejendomme og vurdering af arealer

Du vil få en hverdag, hvor der bliver sat stor pris på din faglighed, din selvstændighed og din evne til at understøtte opgaven med vurdering og værdisætning af arealer og ejendomme. Du kommer både til at skulle arbejde i dybden med opgaveløsningen i tæt dialog med ledere og kolleger, og du forventes at kunne bidrage med et fagligt fundament omkring vurderingsopgaven.

Du bliver en del af et engageret og resultatorienteret team, som sætter faglighed, sparring og samarbejde højt.

Din arbejdsplads: Fra Tønder til hele landet
Selvom vores administrative base ligger i Tønder, foregår dine projekter og opgaver i hele landet. Det betyder, at du får en høj grad af geografisk frihed: Du får en hjemmearbejdsplads, og du vil i høj grad kunne køre direkte fra din bopæl til dine opgavesteder.

Du skal være indstillet på betydelig rejseaktivitet i forbindelse med møder og samarbejde på tværs af landet, herunder på kontor i Tønder. Kørsel til projekter sker i egen bil, og der ydes kørselsgodtgørelse i henhold til statens gældende regler og takster.

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du er fleksibel, faglig velfunderet og med stor interesse for vurdering og værdifastsættelse.

Du har en relevant uddannelse som jordbrugsakademiker, jordbrugsteknolog, ejendomsmægler eller lignende, gerne med nogle års erfaring med kontakt til lodsejere. Gode forhandlingsevner, bred viden om planteproduktion og solidt kendskab til de faktorer, der påvirker værdisætning af landbrugsjord, er vigtige kompetencer i jobbet. Du har desuden gode digitale færdigheder og evner til hurtigt at sætte dig ind i nye systemer. Kortforståelse vil være en fordel.

Velkommen til Natur- & Landbrugsudvikling – din nye arbejdsplads
Natur- & Landbrugsudvikling er en enhed med 105 fagligt dygtige og engagerede kolleger, der arbejder i 9 teams.

I enheden praktiserer vi en åben og ærlig ledelsesstil, lægger vægt på at kunne tilbyde gode udviklingsmuligheder, og vi har fokus på, at det skal være sjovt og givende at gå på arbejde. Hos os er der ingen, der står alene med opgaverne. Der er altid en kollega, der vil være parat til at sparre eller give en hånd med.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Du vil blive ansat efter relevant gældende overenskomst i staten.

For kandidater under Akademikeroverenskomsten og med den rette erfaring vil der være mulighed for indplacering som specialkonsulent.

Ansættelsesområdet er Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd med tilhørende institutioner. Tjenestestedet er Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø, Pionér Allé 9, 6270 Tønder.

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling, som ønskes besat pr. 1. februar 2027.

Kontakt
Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Jesper Blaabjerg på telefon 22 68 96 41.

Du kan læse mere om os på vores hjemmeside www.SGAV.dk.

Ansøgning
Søg stillingen ved at sende en ansøgning inkl. CV, eksamensbevis og evt. referencer online i vores rekrutteringssystem (tryk på ”Søg stilling”) senest søndag den 22. november 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler i Kolding torsdag den 26. november 2026.

title: Purchasing Analyst
description:
Purchasing Analyst
Overview
SUMMARY:
The Purchasing Analyst reports to the VP, Logistics & Operations and is responsible for day to day purchasing and inventory management for Consumer-Packaged Goods. The Purchasing Analyst will be jointly responsible along with several team members, for purchasing approximately $100M in spend on consumer package goods that are sold to our customers in conjunction with coffee and tea. Royal Cup refers to these materials as “Allied Goods,” which include but are not limited to disposables (e.g. cups, paper products, straws, etc.) single-serve coffees, creamers, foods / snacks & drinks, condiments, beverages (ready-to-drink teas, sodas, juices), and more.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • None.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Independently determine what products, how many products, and which vendors to purchase from based on warehouse inventory levels and forecasted / historical demand.
  • Issue POs to selected vendor relationships.
  • Ensure products are delivered on time to warehouses and follow up / expedite as necessary.
  • Ensure products are purchased at pre-negotiated, established prices.
  • Ensure POs are issued accurately and on time.
  • Approve and or challenge vendor invoices to verify cost accuracy in the system, and maintain accurate cost information from vendors
  • Work collaboratively with Sales & others as drop-in demand arises.
  • Monitor, evaluate, and work to improve the performance (e.g. quality, delivery, service levels) of suppliers.
  • Perform ongoing supplier base research and analysis and maintain & update the assigned portfolio of supply options & sourcing trends.
  • Remain current on supply market trends, supplier economics, and best practice sourcing.
  • All other duties as assigned.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Minimum of a High School Diploma (or an equivalent such as a GED)
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in purchasing/buyer role.
  • Sound understanding of purchasing practices, general business financials, and negation strategies.
  • Prior ERP system experience.
  • Advanced understanding of the inventory management and control functions associated with purchasing products and services.
  • Proven ability to take necessary actions to rectify problems and improve situations.
  • Proven strong analytical skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written & verbal communication skills, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to work under strict time constraints.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft suite and systems.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain management, or another related field.
  • Prior SAP Experience.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Some physical requirements may include:
    • Frequent sitting, standing, walking, reaching, typing, reading, talking, and hearing.
    • The ability to lift up to 10 pounds with or without assistance.
  • The ability to successfully complete the pre-employment process.
COMPANY PROFILE:
Royal Cup, Inc. is the proven leader in sourcing, roasting, blending, and distributing high-quality coffees and fine teas since 1896 and is the chosen partner for restaurants, hotels, offices, and commuters across the country. We are a family-owned business rooted in a longstanding tradition of coffee roasting excellence that takes pride in our unparalleled dedication to customer care.

We are a large, privately held national importer, roaster, and distributor of coffees, teas, and related products that have been in business for more than 125 years. Royal Cup, Inc. currently provides products, equipment, and service to restaurants, hotels, convenience stores, businesses, and individuals throughout the United States, and we are growing.

At Royal Cup, Inc. having a customer-centric focus is not simply a motto; our employees believe we each have a responsibility to provide outstanding service to our customers. Our customer-centric focus results in actions we live by that not only retain our current customer base but grow our presence with new, high-impact accounts across the country based on exceptional products and service.

We believe serving our customers well, serves us well. We are results-oriented and strive to not only retain our current customer base but grow our presence with new, high-impact accounts across the country by offering exceptional products and service.

Royal Cup Coffee and Tea strives to be sustainably minded and a good corporate steward in all business endeavors. It is also what others expect of us – our employees, our customers and vendors, our local communities, and the coffee and tea industry we help represent. This mindset permeates the actions we take today for tomorrow.

BENEFITS:
Royal Cup Coffee offers a competitive compensation plan and a comprehensive benefits program. On top of being a part of a well-caffeinated team, the benefits program includes healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k), company-paid life and disability insurance, Flexible Spending Account plan, select tuition reimbursement, paid parental leave, remote work opportunities, paid holidays, and vacation time. Royal Cup is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or another legally protected status. title: Bygningsmedarbejder til Naturstyrelsen - vil du være med til at tage ansvar for bygherreopgaver, drift og udvikling af Naturstyrelsens bygninger?
description:
Naturstyrelsen ejer ca. 1.900 bygninger, der bliver anvendt til en lang række forskellige formål. Har du forstand på at lede, planlægge og afslutte mindre renoveringer og byggeopgaver? Kunne du tænke dig at arbejde med mange forskellige opgaver, og vil du have et stort selvstændigt ansvar? Har du eventuelt erfaring fra kloakeringsprojekter? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Naturstyrelsens bygninger er placeret over hele landet og er meget forskellige med hensyn til anvendelse, størrelse og tilstand – groft sagt fra hønsehus til slot – men primært små til mellemstore boliger, kontorer, maskinhuse mm. Bygningsteamets overordnede opgave er at sikre en passende og tidssvarende bygningsmasse, så den på en gang understøtter en effektiv drift og opfylder de lokale behov. Dette nås bl.a. gennem frasalg, nedrivning, renovering og løbende gennemgang af bygningerne.

Teamets hovedopgaver omfatter bygherreopgaver, herunder planlægning, gennemførelse og afvikling af renoveringer og byggeopgaver, projektorienteret byggesagsbehandling med tidsmæssigt og økonomisk ansvar samt udarbejdelse af udbudsmateriale og kontrakter. Derudover vil der være koordinering af drifts- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver – herunder bygningssyn i samarbejde med kollegaer rundt om i landet.

Opgaver og organisering
I Bygningsteamet søger vi en ny kollega, der skal arbejde med teamets generelle opgaver, samt som bygherrerådgiver medvirke til, at styrelsens kolonihaver bliver kloakeret.

Du vil komme til at indgå i et team på 6 personer på vores hovedkontor i Randbøl ved Vejle.

Dine kerneopgaver vil være:

  • Intern rådgivning om vedligeholdelse af styrelsens bygninger
  • Større men især mindre byggeopgaver (udbud, ledelse og koordinering)
  • Sparring med forskellige interessenter – f.eks. styrelsens lokale enheder, entreprenører, konsulenter o.l. for at finde de gode løsninger inden for de givne økonomiske rammer
  • Deltagelse i kloakeringsopgaven – herunder udbud og projektstyring i.f.t. rådgiver
  • Deltagelse i teamets øvrige interne tværfaglige opgaver – f.eks. nedrivning, energispare-planer, bæredygtighed, fællesudbud samt ledelsesservicering knyttet hertil

Der vil være en del skriftlighed i din hverdag med f.eks. udbudsskrivning, notatskrivning, medvirken ved direktionsforelæggelser og anden dokumentation samt afledt journalisering.

Organisatorisk er Bygningsteamet placeret i Økonomi, hvor du får cirka 35 kolleger. Bygningsteamet ledes af en teamleder.

Din profil
Som vores nye bygningsmedarbejder har du en relevant videregående uddannelse som fx bygningskonstruktør, ingeniør eller anden relevant erfaring.

Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du har en bred erfaring med drift og vedligehold af en større bygningsportefølje samt har erfaring med udarbejdelse af udbudsmateriale, indhentning af tilbud og opgavestyring. Eventuelt suppleret med erfaring og kompetencer inden for projektledelse, udbud og tilsyn vedrørende anlægsopgaver indenfor kloakering.

Erfaring med og kendskab til offentlig administration er en fordel, og er din uddannelse suppleret med en håndværksmæssig baggrund, er det yderligere et plus. Er du relativt nyuddannet med kun få års erfaring, vil vi dog også meget gerne høre fra dig.

Vi forventer, at du som person:

  • Er i stand til at arbejde selvstændigt og kan være initiativrig, fleksibel og iderig, da du bl.a. skal få økonomi, krav og bygningstilstande til at gå op i en højere enhed
  • Tager initiativ og samtidig følger opgaverne helt til dørs
  • Har gode forhandlingskompetencer, da du vil blive mødt af indspil fra flere forskellige sider
  • Er løsningsorienteret og kan finde kompromisset, hvor der er forskellige interesser
  • Har en veludviklet organisatorisk forståelse og dømmekraft
  • Er en god formidler, der kan udtrykke sig klart både på skrift og i tale
  • Kan bruge IT-værktøjer, herunder Microsoft Office, og evt. også Autocad/Revit som middel til effektivisering, standardisering og/eller automatisering af processer knyttet til bygningsadministration

Vi tilbyder
Du får et stort selvstændigt ansvar for en bred vifte af opgaver. Gennem en bred kontakt til chefer og medarbejdere i styrelsen får du mulighed for at beskæftige dig med mange forskellige opgaver inden for bygningsområdet.

Du får gode muligheder for personlig og faglig kompetenceudvikling i et spændende arbejdsmiljø med en fri, uhøjtidelig og meget humørfyldt omgangstone. Vi har en god kantine på adressen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række Akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademiker-overenskomsten).

Den gennemsnitlige ugentlige arbejdstid er 37 timer.

Ansættelsesområdet er Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd med tilhørende institutioner. Tjenestested er Naturstyrelsen, Gjøddinggård, Førstballevej 2, 7183 Randbøl.

Der må påregnes en vis rejseaktivitet knyttet til besigtigelser m.v. i forskellige egne af landet (ca. 4 dage om måneden), hvorfor gyldigt kørekort til personbil er et krav. Styrelsen har tjenestebiler.

Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. februar 2027.

Yderligere oplysninger
Såfremt du ønsker yderligere oplysninger, er du velkommen til at kontakte Bygningskoordinator og teamleder Bo Holm Kristensen på tlf. 93 58 81 57.

Sådan søger du stillingen
Du søger stillingen online ved at sende din ansøgning, CV, uddannelsesbevis m.m. senest den 29. november 2026.

Der påregnes afholdt 1. samtale den 3. december 2026 og eventuel 2. samtale den 9. december 2026.

title: Counselor Intern - Residential Treatment
description:
Are you passionate about making a difference in others' lives? Then come join the Straight and Narrow team!

Headquartered in Paterson, NJ, Straight and Narrow is the largest program of its kind. We provide innovative and compassionate services to individuals struggling with substance use and co-occurring disorders. We are looking for dedicated, caring and compassionate people to work in our Residential/Outpatient Treatment Facilities and Community Programs.


Location: All Straight & Narrow Programs


Regular Salary: $21.00-23.00/Hr.


Position Specific Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assessing the counseling needs of the clients;
  • Assessing clients using the ASI or using other standardized assessment tool and for adolescents using the CASI or using other evidence-based validated assessment tool and diagnosing clients for substance disorders using the DSM-IV-TR;
  • Determining the appropriate level of care based on ASAM PPC-2R;
  • Obtaining previous records that are relevant to the current treatment episode;
  • Collaborating with the client in order to develop a written treatment plan that is client-centered and recovery-oriented and includes goals and measurable objectives.
  • The director of substance abuse counseling shall develop, monitor and provide clients and the treatment team with written schedules that will be used to update each client treatment plan(s) in order to ensure that each client's treatment needs are addressed;
  • Providing the substance abuse counseling services specified in the client treatment plan;
  • Reviewing clients throughout the treatment episode according to ASAM PPC-2R, to determine the need for continued services or discharge/transfer;
  • Reviewing and, where necessary, revising the substance abuse counseling portion of the client treatment plan to address emerging problems;
  • Developing the client discharge/transfer plans to ensure movement to the appropriate levels of care;
  • Contacting referral sources, providing case consultation, and coordination with referral sources (for example: mental health treatment providers, criminal justice agencies, schools, employers, the Division of Youth and Family Services);
  • Participating as a member of a multidisciplinary team for assigned clients;
  • Providing active case consultation; and
  • Documenting all counseling and education services, assessments, reassessments, referrals and follow-up in the client's clinical record, providing appropriate signatures and dating of such entries, including those made in electronic records.

Additional Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide individual, group, and family counseling: didactics, treatment planning and case management as required per licensing standards (residential or ambulatory according to program) for a caseload of clients
  • Formulate measurable individualized Treatment Plans and Treatment Plan Reviews for each client on caseload
  • Maintain clinical portion of clients’ charts as per Division of Mental Health and Addiction Services (DMHAS) and CARF guidelines, ensuring that all documentation is up to date as per Straight & Narrow’s Policy on Timeframe for Documentation in Clients’ Charts
  • Attend regularly scheduled multidisciplinary team meetings (MDT) and present information for Treatment Plan or Treatment Plan Review for clients on caseload
  • Attend individual and group supervision with Clinical Supervisor as scheduled
  • Provide clients on caseload with referral to other agencies (i.e., health, psychiatric, vocational rehabilitation and public assistance) for concurrent and/or continued care as part of case management as necessary
  • Provide crisis intervention to clients as necessary.
  • Submit documentation to Supervisor daily for any/all sessions held with clients on that day
  • Attend and actively participate in all CQI subcommittee meetings and/or Grievance Committee meetings on which membership is held
  • Prepare monthly reports to overseeing agencies/referral sources (i.e., DCP&P, probation officers, parole officers)
  • If CADC or LCADC has not been obtained, present supervisor with documented progress toward this certification quarterly. Must complete CADC/LCADC within three (3) years from date of hire.
  • Encourage and support clients’ participation in AA/NA/GA
  • Follow all Electronic Health Records (EHR) policies.

Unit-specific duties for this position (if any):

  • Conduct intakes and fully orient new clients to the program
  • Monitor urine specimens, as required
  • Complete all required discharge paperwork
  • Respond to call for guest medication, as required

title: 12621 - Inspector Sr Const
description:
Independently coordinate, schedule and inspect all phases of routine and complex highway construction projects to ensure construction quality in accordance with plans and specifications and provide a quality transportation system for the traveling public.

How you will contribute:
  • Communication: Communicate with VDOT and external support staff. Manage project public relations and respond to public concerns. Proactively notify project support staff and the public of traffic changes, project phase start and finish. Address landowner, business owner, and traveling public concerns regarding project. Coordinate distribution of lane closure notification with Traffic Operations Center, Communications and Residency. Work with contractor to resolve issues.
  • Contract Compliance: Monitor and perform all types of inspections on routine and complex highway projects and provide oversight and guidance to other inspectors. Review the performance of other inspectors and provide direction in support of job growth and development. Ensure construction activities are performed in accordance with contracts, plans and applicable documents to include environmental, erosion and sediment controls, safety, traffic controls, and EEO and DBE guidelines, regulations and permits. Ensure project contract compliance using checklists, spreadsheets, manufacturer recommendations, construction directives, traffic engineering memoranda and materials memoranda to ensure project quality requirements are met. Notify contractor of any non-compliance issues and resolution through documentation. Oversee and perform materials testing to ensure project is constructed to design quality standards. Ensure monthly that all pay items of work performed during that period are paid to the contractor.
  • Project Close-outs: Assist in project close-outs. Maintain as-built drawings.
  • Project Documentation: Track and maintain materials documentation for project. Review and/or prepare detailed DWRs and diaries and correlate to the contractor's scheduled construction activities so VDOT can track individual activities, resources, productivity and efficiencies. Maintain project files. Document daily occurrences, meetings, and communications and correlate to contract documents to provide information on changes in the contractor's scope of work. Issue quarterly CPEs for prime and subcontractors working on project to allow VDOT to evaluate contractor's performance.
  • Project Oversight: Monitor project schedule through progress meetings; notify supervisor when contractors incur schedule variance outside contract allowances. Conduct, document and distribute minutes of project and progress meetings. Review and maintain project budget. Review project item quantities and costs to ensure on-budget project delivery. Project remaining work costs to complete. Ensure all submittals for associated work items have been submitted and approved prior to start of work by reviewing project submittals to verify approval. Determine support equipment needed for project and ensure proper maintenance, use and return.
  • Safety and Environmental Compliance: Ensure work zones are properly established and maintained. Ensure project employees and equipment are performing in compliance with safety practices and directives. Monitor erosion and sediment control measures to ensure compliance and appropriate maintenance. Maintain a clean and organized work environment. Practice safe driving and maintain a clean vehicle interior and exterior.


What will make you successful:
  • Ability to apply mathematical formulas and engineering principles to determine field adjustments to construction plans.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with VDOT and contractor personnel and the general public.
  • Ability to maintain detailed records, prepare reports and maintain project files.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding work in field conditions such as using test equipment, lifting, climbing, stooping, working at heights, in confined spaces and making visual observations.
  • Ability to provide work direction to others on construction projects.
  • Ability to read, interpret and analyze roadway, structure and bridge plans, specifications and contract documents.
  • Ability to work in the vicinity and operate devices utilizing low-level ionizing radiation.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Considerable knowledge of roadway, structure and bridge construction methods, materials, standards and terminology.
  • Considerable knowledge of state and federal safety, environmental, and EEO and DBE guidelines and regulations as they relate to transportation construction.
  • Knowledge of mathematics to include algebra, geometry and trigonometry.
  • Skill in the use of computers and software applications.
  • Skill in the use of engineering and testing equipment.

title: Service Supervisor
description:
At Elmington Living, we don't just manage properties — we build communities people are proud to call home. As the team behind 70+ affordable and market-rate assets across the country, we've earned our reputation through relentless care, sharp execution, and an eye for detail that never quits, guided by People First, Always. Execution with Integrity. Excellence by Design.
POSITION SUMMARY
The Service Supervisor is responsible for leading the maintenance operations of the assigned community, including resident service requests, preventive maintenance, apartment turns, inspections, vendor management, budgeting, and team supervision. This role ensures the community remains safe, functional, well-maintained, and visually appealing while supporting resident satisfaction, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and the long-term preservation of the property.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Maintenance Operations
  • Oversee resident service requests, preventive maintenance programs, apartment turns, inspections, and maintenance projects
  • Establish daily maintenance priorities and assign work based on urgency, team capacity, and operational needs
  • Ensure work orders are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with company service standards
  • Monitor work order completion, apartment turn timelines, recurring maintenance issues, and other maintenance-related performance measures
  • Inspect completed service requests, apartment turns, and maintenance projects to ensure quality and compliance with company standards
  • Conduct routine inspections of buildings, building systems, apartment homes, amenities, equipment, grounds, and mechanical areas
  • Maintain accurate service records, inspection documentation, equipment logs, warranties, and preventive maintenance schedules
  • Ensure maintenance shops, storage areas, tools, equipment, keys, and access devices are properly maintained, organized, and secured
  • Maintain readiness for property emergencies, severe weather events, and after-hours maintenance needs
Team Leadership
  • Participate in the hiring, onboarding, training, scheduling, and supervision of maintenance team members
  • Establish clear performance expectations and hold team members accountable for quality, productivity, safety, and customer service
  • Conduct performance evaluations and provide ongoing coaching, feedback, training, and professional development
  • Ensure maintenance team members maintain required licenses, certifications, and training
  • Monitor team compliance with company policies, safety procedures, personal protective equipment requirements, and established operating standards
  • Promote a team culture centered on safety, accountability, communication, quality workmanship, and resident service
  • Manage on-call schedules and ensure appropriate emergency response coverage
  • Provide hands-on maintenance support when needed based on staffing levels, workload, or property emergencies
Apartment Turns and Property Readiness
  • Monitor maintenance expenses and operate within approved budgets
  • Coordinate apartment turn schedules with the Community Director, vendors, and community team members
  • Assign and monitor turn responsibilities to ensure established deadlines are met
  • Inspect vacant apartment homes and identify required repairs, replacements, and vendor services
  • Communicate turn progress, delays, and additional needs to the Community Director
  • Complete final inspections to confirm apartment homes meet company standards and are fully move-in ready
  • Ensure vacant apartment homes remain clean, secure, and protected throughout the turn process
Budget & Vendor Management
  • Monitor maintenance expenses and operate within approved budgets
  • Participate in the annual budgeting process and provide recommendations for maintenance expenses, equipment, replacements, and capital projects
  • Maintain inventory and purchasing controls for maintenance tools, parts, supplies, and equipment
  • Monitor inventory levels and implement controls to reduce waste, loss, and unnecessary expenses
  • Obtain and review bids, coordinate vendors, and oversee contracted work
  • Review completed vendor work to ensure quality, completion, and contract compliance
Property Preservation & Compliance
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, OSHA requirements, applicable housing regulations, Fair Housing requirements, and established safety standards
  • Maintain the community’s curb appeal, building systems, amenities, grounds, and overall physical condition
  • Identify and communicate major repair needs, equipment replacements, and capital improvement recommendations to the Community Director
  • Support risk-management initiatives, property inspections, and the timely correction of identified deficiencies
  • Maintain required safety documentation and ensure chemicals, hazardous materials, tools, and equipment are properly stored, labeled, handled, and disposed of
  • Ensure appropriate controls are maintained for community keys, access devices, vacant apartment homes, and secured maintenance areas
  • Maintain resident privacy and protect company and resident property during maintenance activities
  • Immediately report incidents, injuries, property damage, safety hazards, and other liability concerns
Resident Service
  • Respond to resident maintenance concerns and escalated service issues professionally and promptly
  • Communicate repair status, expected timelines, delays, and necessary follow-up to residents and community team members
  • Follow up on significant or escalated service requests to confirm completion and resident satisfaction
  • Identify recurring service concerns and implement solutions that improve maintenance performance and the resident experience
  • Partner with the Community Director to support resident satisfaction and retention through responsive, high-quality maintenance service
QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS
  • 3+ years of apartment maintenance or related maintenance experience required
  • Prior supervisory experience required
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance, carpentry, and general building repairs
  • EPA certification required
  • HVAC certification strongly preferred
  • Valid drivers license may be required based on property responsibilities
  • Experience with property management software, mobile devices and electronic work order systems preferred
  • Basic knowledge of maintenance budgeting, purchasing, inventory control, and vendor management
  • Ability to participate in an on-call schedule, including weekends, holidays, and after-hours emergencies
CORE COMPETENCIES
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team-development abilities
  • Excellent troubleshooting, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills
  • Strong customer service and resident-focused mindset
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organization, planning, and time-management abilities
  • Ability to manage budgets, vendors, projects, and competing priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship
WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  • Work is performed throughout apartment homes, buildings, maintenance areas, amenities, grounds, and other areas of the community
  • Regular exposure to indoor and outdoor environments, varying weather conditions, mechanical equipment, chemicals, dust, dirt, and debris
  • Frequent walking, standing, climbing stairs and ladders, bending, reaching, kneeling, crouching, and lifting
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 75 pounds occasionally, with assistance or appropriate equipment when needed
  • Ability to safely use hand tools, power tools, ladders, and maintenance equipment
  • Ability to safely perform physical tasks for extended periods and move throughout the community as needed
WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE: Elmington Living offers competitive compensation that reflects the market and the impact of the role, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being. Medical, dental, and vision coverage begins on the first of the month following your hire date, with no long waiting period. The company also provides life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage. Employees become eligible for the 401(k) plan with company match after 90 days and accrue vacation, sick, and personal time to recharge, in addition to receiving 10 paid holidays each year.
At Elmington Living, we're redefining what property management can look like — and we're looking for leaders ready to help us raise the bar. With 70+ communities across the U.S. and a fast-growing presence rooted in Nashville, our work is driven by heart, hustle, and an unwavering commitment to doing things the right way. If you're ready to bring your experience, energy, and leadership to a company built on People First, Always. Execution with Integrity. Excellence by Design. — we'd love to meet you.

Elmington is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Elmington makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

title: Organization consultant for engagement of consultant for Enumeration of Sentinel Sites in Uttar Pradesh
description:
Engagement of consultant for Enumeration of Sentinel Sites in Uttar Pradesh

1. Background

The project intends to establish/monitor a set of sentinel sites (25 per district) to generate reliable, timely and high-quality field-level data on agricultural practices, crop management, resource use, productivity, technology adoption and other indicators. The sentinel-site approach will facilitate systematic collection of data from selected farmers and fields over the agricultural season and support evidence-based assessment of changes in farming practices and outcomes.

The enumeration will be undertaken in 3 selected districts of Uttar Pradesh (Gonda, Chandauli and Siddharthnagar) and 3 districts in Bihar (Gaya, Rohtas, and Muzaffarpur).

The assignment will be implemented through an survey/field-enumeration agency (hereafter referred to as the “Consultant”) under the technical guidance of the project team at the KVK in consultation with ATARI.

2. Objective of the Assignment

The primary objective of this assignment is to undertake field enumeration and data collection from designated sentinel sites/farmers in 3 districts of Uttar Pradesh and 3 districts of Bihar.

The specific objectives are to:

  1. Enumerate all designated sentinel farmers/sites using the approved survey protocol.
  2. Collect accurate and complete information on agreed agricultural indicators.
  3. Capture data digitally using the prescribed ODK digital data-collection platform.
  4. Ensure timely transmission of complete data to the project team on the server on a real time basis.
  5. Maintain consistency in respondents, sentinel sites and data collection across survey rounds.
  6. Undertake quality control and validation of collected information.
  7. Provide regular progress updates and promptly resolve data-quality issues identified by the project team.

The Consultant should have the capacity to mobilize enumerators across all six districts and ensure adequate field coverage within the agreed timeline.

The work is to be finished in 4 phases

1. Personal Interview- The enumerator will be visiting each farmer and carry a personal interview for all the activities done by the farmer on his farm till September 20th.

2. Telephonic Interview- This survey will be done telephonically for all the activity carried by farmer in between 20th September till 20th October.

3. Telephonic Interview- This survey will be done telephonically for all the activity carried by farmer in between 20th October till 20th November.

4. Personal Interview- The enumerator will be visiting each farmer and carry a personal interview for all the activities done by the farmer on his farm till approx. December 20th (This will include all activities till harvest as the harvest date varies from farmer to farmer this may be done before).

4. Scope of Work

The Consultant will be responsible for the complete field-enumeration process, including mobilization, training, field data collection, supervision, quality assurance, data submission and also hiring of vehicle for the process of enumeration.

5. Digital Data Collection

All data should preferably be collected through ODK which is a digital data-collection platform.

The Consultant shall:

  • Use only the approved digital questionnaire.
  • Ensure that enumerators are trained in the digital application.
  • Capture GPS coordinates where required.
  • Record survey date and time automatically.
  • Use mandatory fields and validation checks.
  • Avoid duplicate records.
  • Synchronize data regularly with the designated server.
  • Maintain appropriate backup of collected data.
  • Ensure that data are not altered or manipulated, only the farmers answered data is to be recorded.

The project team will provide the final digital questionnaire/form.

6. Payment Terms

The assignment will be awarded to the selected Consultant on a lump-sum basis. The total contract value shall cover all costs associated with successful completion of the assignment, including but not limited to:

  • Recruitment and deployment of enumerators and supervisors;
  • Enumerator training and field orientation;
  • Travel, local transportation and accommodation;
  • Any other incidental costs necessary for completion of the assignment.

The Consultant shall submit a single consolidated financial proposal for the complete scope of work covering all six districts.

7. Expected Outcome

At the completion of the assignment, the project will have a complete, high-quality and digitally structured sentinel-site dataset covering 6 districts in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.

The dataset should be sufficiently complete and consistent to support subsequent analysis of agricultural practices, technology adoption, crop productivity, resource use and other agreed project indicators.

8. Eligible Criteria

Experience with conducting in-person and telephone surveys in Hindi speaking areas of India.

Interested firms are invited to apply for this advertisement, submitting complete company details as per the eligibility criteria, along with a detailed budget proposal and the CV of the lead consultant.

title: Backend Engineer (MLAW)
description:
About Us
Established in 2010, Vinova is a passion-driven and award-winning development company for mobile, web, and enterprise applications. Our clients span the globe and cover a wide range of projects including IoT, blockchain, banking, fintech, networking, and ecommerce. Vinova earns respect from customers by being committed to quality, flexibility, and speed. We strive to build great products by working with passion, working closely with our customers, and through open but disciplined collaboration. You will be working in an encouraging and challenging environment, taking advantage of the latest technology to deliver high-impact digital solutions for global clients. You will be engaging clients in both on-site and off-site capacities.

What you will be working on
Our client, a Singapore government agency, operates a Case Management Platform (CAMP) built on OutSystems to support case management applications across the organisation, and is developing and integrating generative AI and agentic AI capabilities into its business applications and workflows.

You will be appointed individually and work with the agency's personnel, application teams, other appointed resources and relevant stakeholders. As the AI MLOps Engineer, you will make sure AI use on the AI Foundation Platform is trusted, controlled and compliant — covering governance, monitoring, evaluation, guardrails and MLOps for both AI models and AI agents.

Key responsibilities

AI governance & compliance

  • Implement and maintain governance controls for AI models and services on the AI Foundation Platform, so AI use is trusted, controlled and compliant.
  • Ensure AI services comply with data security, data classification, privacy (PDPA) and Responsible AI requirements.
  • Maintain compliance evidence for ICT&SS / IM8, the System Security Plan (SSP), PDPA and Responsible AI requirements for agentic AI, and support security reviews and ARB submissions.

Monitoring & observability

  • Implement model monitoring covering accuracy, drift, hallucination, latency, cost and usage across AI applications.
  • Implement audit logging and traceability of model inputs, outputs and usage to support accountability and audit requirements.
  • Implement end-to-end agent observability and audit trails (traces of prompts, reasoning steps, tool calls, outputs and approvals), with dashboards and alerts mapped to SLIs/SLOs and risk thresholds.
  • Develop full-stack monitoring dashboards and reporting tools that give stakeholders visibility of AI performance, risks and compliance status.
  • Set up alerts and incident response procedures for AI service anomalies and degradation.

Evaluation & testing

  • Develop and run accuracy validation and evaluation processes, including test datasets, benchmarking, regression testing and human-in-the-loop review for model and prompt changes.
  • Evaluate agent behaviour, including task success, tool-use correctness, trajectory review, groundedness and regression testing before changes go live.

Guardrails & security

  • Configure and maintain AI security and safety guardrails, such as content filtering, PII detection and redaction, prompt injection protection and Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, in line with the agency's AI security governance.
  • Define and enforce agent-level guardrails and controls: tool allow-lists, permission and action limits, human approval for high-impact actions, limits on loops, steps and spend, and an emergency stop, aligned with the agency's AI security governance.
  • Run red-teaming and security testing for agentic threats, such as prompt injection through tool outputs, excessive agency, data leakage and misuse of tools, and track remediation.
  • Perform security checks and support risk assessments for AI components.

MLOps

  • Build and maintain MLOps pipelines for model and prompt versioning, deployment, rollback and lifecycle management.

Collaboration & documentation

  • Work with the AI Platform Engineer, AI/ML Engineers and DevSecOps Engineers to embed governance controls into the AI development lifecycle.
  • Work under the guidance of the Backend Senior Engineer and Solution Architect on guardrail design, risk decisions and the AI governance standards.
  • Maintain documentation of AI governance standards, model cards, operating procedures and compliance records.

What we are looking for

Education & experience

  • Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or related disciplines.
  • At least 2 years of experience relevant to software engineering, MLOps, DevOps, data engineering or AI operations.

Programming

  • Good programming skills in Python, with working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript for building dashboards or web tools.

AI monitoring & evaluation

  • Experience with model monitoring, evaluation or observability tools such as Amazon CloudWatch, SageMaker Model Monitor, MLflow, Langfuse or equivalent.
  • Understanding of LLM evaluation techniques, such as groundedness and faithfulness metrics, LLM-as-judge and red-teaming.
  • Familiarity with Amazon Bedrock features such as Guardrails, Model Evaluation and model invocation logging.

Agentic AI

  • Understanding of agentic AI risks and controls, such as excessive agency, prompt injection, tool misuse and human-in-the-loop design, and of agent evaluation and tracing tools (e.g. Langfuse, OpenTelemetry).

DevOps

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git.
  • Knowledge of container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Security, privacy & government policy

  • Good understanding of data security, privacy and Responsible AI principles.
  • Understanding of Government ICT&SS management policies (IM8), SSP requirements and observability practices, and has applied them to AI guardrails, audit logging and monitoring.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with Singapore's Model AI Governance Framework, AI Verify, IM8 and PDPA.
  • Experience with Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) or security assessments for government projects.
  • AWS certifications such as Machine Learning Engineer Associate, AI Practitioner or Cloud Practitioner.

Personal attributes

  • Strong attention to detail and a risk-aware, quality-driven mindset.
  • Comfortable with Agile methodologies and working closely with product development teams.
  • Strong on collaboration and communication, including documentation.

What we offer

  • 14 days of annual leave, with up to 6 unused days carried forward.
  • Paid sick leave (14 days) and hospitalisation leave (up to 60 days).
  • Paid public holidays, with off-in-lieu when a holiday falls on a non-working day.
  • Group medical insurance covering outpatient and hospitalisation.
  • Marriage gift, newborn baby gift and bereavement allowance.
  • Work equipment provided.
  • Mentorship and direct coaching from senior management.
  • Skill development through client projects using new technologies, plus workshops and seminars.
  • A clear path to leadership roles in a growing company.
  • Complimentary snacks and drinks in the office.

Job details

  • Location: Singapore (onshore)

title: Facilities Officer
description:
Facilities Officer

Melbourne Grammar School has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Facilities Officer to join our Property Services team. This varied role provides operational, administrative and systems coordination support across the School’s property portfolio, ensuring key facilities systems, compliance records and operational processes are effectively maintained.

The successful candidate will administer facilities and contractor management platforms, coordinate contractor compliance and Essential Safety Measures requirements, maintain accurate property records, and support access control, building management, events and day-to-day Property Services operations. Paramount to this position is strong organisation, attention to detail and the ability to build effective relationships with staff, contractors and service providers.

This position is located at our South Yarra campus but may be required to work at other Melbourne Grammar School locations from time to time. This position may be offered on a part-time basis; however, flexibility to work early morning starts is required.


You will:

  • Act as the primary systems administrator of Property Services platforms, maintaining user access, permissions, workflows, records integrity and system configuration.
  • Administer and coordinate the School's Facilities Management and Work Order System (FixIt/CMMS).
  • Assist with Building Management System (BMS) administration and reporting.
  • Administer access control, electronic security and credential management systems including user permissions, audit reporting and record maintenance.
  • Act as administrator for the School's contractor management platform, including onboarding, induction, compliance monitoring, reporting and user support.
  • Coordinate servicing schedules, inspections, statutory testing and compliance activities associated with the School's Essential Safety Measures (ESM/ESIS) program.
  • Maintain property records, drawings, manuals, warranties and asset documentation.
  • Coordinate facilities requirements, access arrangements and operational support for events.

Must hold, or be willing to obtain, a current Employee Working with Children Clearance.

Our School is a place of extraordinary possibilities.

Melbourne Grammar School is one of Australia's leading independent schools that believes in the holistic education of young people. This role is based at our South Yarra campus where our Senior School welcome around 867 boys in Years 9 – 12 each day and our Wadhurst campus, comprises 406 boys in Years 7 and 8 where they make the transition from primary to secondary education in an environment designed with their needs in mind.

We believe that education can create extraordinary possibilities in the lives of young people and the communities in which they live. We engage talented people and want them to create possibilities for themselves and for others. Teaching and learning at Melbourne Grammar School strikes a balance between the best of traditional approaches and contemporary practice. We are focused on growth and active participation, and our work is supported by expert and dedicated teachers, outstanding resources and learning spaces purpose-built for young learners.

title: Change Manager
description:
About the role – 12-month Fixed Term Contract

Join our Change & Communication team and help people across the bank get ready for changes to the technology they use every day. Working with our Customer Platforms and Enterprise Platforms teams, you’ll shape and lead change activities across platform enhancements, releases and other technology initiatives. You’ll work out what’s changing, who’s affected and what they need—from clear communication to practical learning and support.

Key responsibilities include:

• Shape and lead change activities for platform enhancements, releases and technology initiatives, helping people understand what’s changing and prepare for it.

• Make technology changes clear and relevant. Work out the impacts on people, processes and ways of working, then develop communication, engagement and learning activities that meet those needs.

• Help the business get ready. Assess impacts and readiness, address change risks, and use feedback after implementation to understand where more support is needed.

• Bring the business and people perspective into planning. Work with platform leaders, delivery teams and business stakeholders to highlight impacts, dependencies and readiness concerns early.

• Connect the dots across releases. Identify overlapping changes and competing demands on the business and tailor your approach to the impact and risk involved.

• Help improve how we deliver change. Share knowledge, coach stakeholders and develop reusable approaches, using Jira and Confluence to support collaboration and visibility.

About you:

You’re a hands-on change professional who enjoys working with technology teams and making complex changes understandable for the people affected. You build strong relationships, ask useful questions and turn what you learn into practical change activities. You know when a change needs more support—and when a simpler approach will do.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the following:

• You have demonstrated experience leading the people side of technology-enabled change, particularly ongoing platform enhancements, releases and continuous improvement in complex environments.

• At least five years’ experience in change management, including impact, stakeholder, readiness and adoption assessments.

• You can make complex technical changes easy to understand, translating them into clear business implications and practical communication, engagement and learning approaches.

• You build trusted relationships with senior leaders, platform teams, delivery teams and business stakeholders. You can facilitate conversations, provide practical advice and coaching, and share knowledge to build change capability and improve how we work.

• You have experience partnering with platform, product or delivery teams and integrating change activities into iterative delivery and governance processes. Experience with Jira and Confluence, and within financial services or other regulated environments, will be advantageous.

Location:

This role can be based in Adelaide, Brisbane or Toowoomba.

We are pleased to be able to consider applications from employees within Australia for this role. We also encourage you to put thought into how the work may be undertaken given your location and what support you may require.

Why you’ll love working with us:

People First Bank – our new brand – says exactly what we’re all about: people. We're committed to supporting and growing our team and creating an outstanding work environment.

You’ll have access to financial and lifestyle benefits to support your success and individuality:

• Flexibility and hybrid working arrangements.

• Enhance your salary with discounts on banking, health insurance, and shopping across Australia.

• Advance your career with training, study support, and project opportunities.

• Competitive leave benefits that empower employees to take time for themselves and loved ones.

• Wellbeing support with our Employee Assistance Program, wellbeing leave, mental health app, and mental health ambassadors’ program.

• Make a difference with paid volunteering, Workplace Giving, and diverse community initiatives.

• Be recognised for your contributions through our peer-driven recognition program.

A bit about People First Bank:

In March 2023, People’s Choice and Heritage Bank merged to form Heritage and People’s Choice Limited - Australia's leading mutual bank. We are now on an exciting journey to bring together our products, services, and technology under a single brand - People First Bank.

We have over 700,000 members and 1,900 employees, with dual head offices in Adelaide and Toowoomba, an Australian-based contact centre and branches across five states.

With a vision ‘To deliver positive change through banking’, People First Bank serves members and contributes to the community, while offering an inclusive, flexible work environment. We’re big enough to make an impact; but agile enough to influence and do interesting work.

Apply online now:

If this sounds like you, this could be the next step in your career. Click 'Apply' now and submit your application, including a cover letter and current resume by Sunday 22nd November 2026.

Our diversity makes us stronger

People First Bank acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of Country throughout Australia and pays respect to Elders past and present. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and culturally safe workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to thrive. We welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences. We welcome requests for reasonable adjustments to ensure all candidates can participate fairly and confidently in our selection process.

Let's Talk Flexibility

At People First Bank, we know life looks different for everyone. We trust our people to deliver and support them to build rewarding careers alongside the things that matter to them. We welcome a conversation about what flexibility means to you and how we can make it work for you, your team, and the role. We encourage you to raise this during the recruitment process.

title: Beredskabskoordinator søges til Beredskabsenheden
description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle, koordinere og sikre kvaliteten af det sundhedsfaglige beredskab på Esbjerg og Grindsted Sygehus? Har du blik for både de store linjer og de praktiske detaljer, og motiveres du af at skabe sammenhæng på tværs af organisationen? Så er du måske vores nye beredskabskoordinator.

Vi søger en sundhedsfaglig medarbejder til en 50% stilling som Beredskabskoordinator i Beredskabsenhed - Sundhed. Stillingen kombineres med en 50% ansættelse i en klinisk afdeling på Esbjerg og Grindsted Sygehus.

Som beredskabskoordinator får du en central rolle i at understøtte den daglige drift, kvalitetssikring og videreudvikling af sygehusets beredskab. Du bliver en del af en tværgående funktion, hvor samarbejde, koordinering og formidling er afgørende for, at sygehuset er godt rustet til at håndtere beredskabshændelser.

Om Beredskabsenheden

Beredskabsenheden (linket kræver adgang til Intra) dækker hele Esbjerg og Grindsted Sygehus og arbejder på tværs af alle afdelinger og fagområder med at vedligeholde og udvikle sygehusets beredskab. Vi ønsker nu at styrke enheden med yderligere en medarbejder.
Arbejdet omfatter blandt andet beredskabsplanlægning, koordinering, undervisning, øvelser og løbende udvikling af beredskabet. Vi samarbejder tæt med blandt andre IT- og Teknisk Afdeling. Sygehuset har desuden et Beredskabsråd med repræsentanter fra flere af sygehusets afdelinger.

Om stillingen

Din primære opgave bliver at understøtte og koordinere det sundhedsfaglige beredskab på tværs af Esbjerg og Grindsted Sygehus. Du bidrager til, at beredskabsplaner, instrukser og øvrigt beredskabsmateriale er opdateret og hænger sammen på tværs af organisationen.
Du får en bred kontaktflade og samarbejder med afdelinger, ledere og medarbejdere på tværs af faggrupper. Du skal kunne omsætte overordnede krav og planer til konkret materiale og aktiviteter, der giver mening i medarbejdernes hverdag.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Koordinere og understøtte afdelingernes arbejde med lokale beredskabsplaner og bidrage til, at de hænger sammen med sygehusets overordnede beredskab.
  • Sikre den praktiske håndtering af beredskabsdokumenter i Infonet, herunder oprette dokumenter og sikre systematisk opfølgning på revisioner og opdateringer.
  • Medvirke til planlægning, gennemførelse og evaluering af beredskabsøvelser.
  • Understøtte træning og undervisning af sygehusets personale
  • Udarbejde, udvikle og vedligeholde introduktions- og informationsmateriale om beredskabet.
  • Bidrage til dagsordener for møder i Beredskabsenheden og Beredskabsrådet samt følge op på beslutninger og initiativer.

Opgaverne løses i tæt samarbejde med Beredskabsenhedens øvrige medarbejdere.

Vi tilbyder

Vi tilbyder en spændende mulighed for at få indflydelse på udviklingen af beredskabet på Esbjerg og Grindsted Sygehus.

Du får:

  • En nyoprettet stilling med mulighed for at præge opgaveløsningen.
  • En central rolle i et vigtigt tværgående samarbejde på sygehuset.
  • Et tæt samarbejde med kolleger i Beredskabsenheden.
  • En varieret arbejdsdag med både planlægnings-, koordinerings-, udviklings- og formidlingsopgaver.
  • Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling inden for beredskab.
  • Mulighed for at bringe din kliniske erfaring og organisatoriske forståelse i spil i en ny sammenhæng.

Din arbejdstid i Beredskabsenheden planlægges i tæt samarbejde med den kliniske afdeling, som du ligeledes vil være tilknyttet.
Hvis du ikke allerede har en klinisk stilling på Esbjerg og Grindsted Sygehus, vil vi i fællesskab finde en klinisk stilling på 50 %. Dette sker med udgangspunkt i dine kompetencer og ønsker samt de muligheder, der er på sygehuset.

Din profil

Vi søger en sundhedsfaglig kollega, der har lyst til at tage ansvar for at skabe overblik, sammenhæng og fremdrift i sygehusets beredskabsarbejde.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en sundhedsfaglig uddannelse, gerne med en relevant overbygningsuddannelse.
  • Har erfaring med tværgående planlægningsopgaver og koordinering.
  • Har pædagogiske og faciliterende kompetencer.
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og trives med at arbejde på tværs af faggrupper og afdelinger.
  • Arbejder struktureret og systematisk, og følger opgaver til dørs.
  • Kan formidle planer, procedurer og faglig viden på en måde, der er forståelig og anvendelig for forskellige målgrupper.

Du behøver ikke at have omfattende erfaring med beredskabsarbejde, men du skal have interesse for området.
Se funktionsbeskrivelsen for ansvarsområder og opgaver.

Yderligere oplysninger

Dit fysiske arbejdssted vil være Esbjerg Sygehus.
Som beredskabskoordinator refererer man til sygehusets beredskabsansvarlige sygehusdirektør.

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i henhold til din overenskomst. Udover startlønnen kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængig af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer. Se startløn for stillinger i Region Syddanmark.

Ansøgningsfrist: 22/11-26
Samtaler afholdes: 25/11-26
Forventet tiltrædelse: 1/1-27 eller efter aftale.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Charlotte Mose, beredskabsansvarlig sygehusdirektør, Charlotte.Mose@rsyd.dk, telefon 2063 8784

eller

Susanne Justsen, Beredskabsenheden, Susanne.Justsen@rsyd.dk, telefon 2174 6862

title: Business Relationship Executive
description:
iLabs is a global software product engineering company headquartered in Sri Lanka, with deep roots in the US Silicon Valley. We deliver world-class solutions in Web, eCommerce, Mobile, AI/ML, and Cloud technologies, serving industries such as fintech, edtech, medtech, martech, and hospitality. Guided by our vision “to become a global powerhouse in information technology to push humanity forward” we focus on delivering innovative, impactful solutions that empower businesses and create meaningful change in the world.

With a global talent network, we build agile remote teams for leading tech companies worldwide, including Silicon Valley pioneers. Our in-house ventures include Cloud of Goods, a fast-growing eCommerce rental marketplace, and Xenia, a customizable web platform for modern businesses.

At iLabs, we’re on a mission to advance lifestyles through technology and empower our partners to scale smarter and faster. Our culture is driven by creativity, innovation, ownership, teamwork, and global impact; giving you the opportunity and freedom to challenge the norm, spark change, and make a real difference.

If you’re ready to break boundaries and create your defining moment, we’re here to make it happen. Be part of something bigger. Join iLabs.


About the Role

Partner Onboarding and Enablement

  • Lead the end-to-end onboarding process for new partners, ensuring a smooth and rapid time-to-value.

  • Assist partners with payment setup, inventory management, account configuration, and operational workflows.

  • Design and deliver training sessions for partners on new platform features, tools, and marketplace best practices.

  • Create and maintain partner enablement resources, playbooks, and documentation.

Strategic Relationship Management and Partner Success

  • Collaborate with the Partner Success team to dynamically manage and support the entire network of partners, ensuring shared ownership and consistent, high-quality relationship management.

  • Conduct regular operational and strategic check-ins, such as Monthly or Quarterly Business Reviews, to review performance, address challenges, and align on goals.

  • Monitor and analyze partner KPIs, including order acceptance rates, fulfillment performance, ratings, and service quality.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to help partners scale, such as expanding into new cities, optimizing pricing, or adding new product categories.

  • Act as the Voice of the Partner internally, gathering feedback and collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to drive strategic platform improvements.

  • Develop and execute network-wide retention strategies to ensure high partner satisfaction and minimize churn.

Operations and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate complex operational escalations between partners and internal teams to ensure successful order fulfillment.

  • Partner with the Operations team to identify bottlenecks in the fulfillment process and implement scalable, high-level solutions.

  • Manage partner communications regarding platform updates, policy changes, and marketplace promotions.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the overall partner experience and internal operational procedures.


Shifts: 9-hour shifts roster basis, 5 days a week. Weekend availability is a must. Aligned with USA Time Zones and Calendar.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Partner Success, Business Relationship Management, B2B Account Management, or Operations, preferably within a marketplace, SaaS, or e-commerce environment.

  • Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate with foreign business owners and stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to look at partner data and metrics and prescribe actionable solutions for growth and efficiency.

  • A high level of empathy combined with a strong understanding of what it takes to run and grow a small to medium business.

  • Proven ability to thrive in a team-based, shared-ownership environment where partner management is dynamic rather than siloed into individual portfolios.

  • Experience working with CRM systems, partner portals, ticketing platforms, and internal analytics dashboards.

  • Good understanding of e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, or rental and logistics operations.

  • Knowledge of Stripe or similar payment gateways and payout structures is an advantage.


Preferred

  • Prior experience supporting US-based partners and a solid understanding of US geography and business culture is highly preferred.

  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly growing startup environment.

title: Shipping Associate
description:
Shift: Full-Time
Hours: Monday – Friday 7a - 3:30p
Location: Boonville, MO (onsite)
Department: Shipping
Reports To: Department Head

Job Summary

The Picker / Packer / Shipper is responsible for accurately fulfilling customer orders in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This role ensures that finished goods are picked, inspected, labeled, packed, and shipped according to company standards while maintaining high levels of accuracy, organization, and safety.

This position requires strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to meet deadlines while interacting effectively with multiple departments. The ideal candidate thrives in a high-performance environment and takes pride in delivering accurate shipments that support customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Order Fulfillment & Shipping Accuracy

  • Pick products accurately according to order requirements.
  • Perform quality checks prior to packing and shipping.
  • Label, pack, and prepare finished goods for shipment.
  • Verify product types and quantities against order documentation.
  • Ensure serial numbers match corresponding products.
  • Minimize processing time through organized picking and packing.
  • Physically inspect outgoing shipments for accuracy and condition.
  • Report discrepancies or defects to Department Head immediately.

Quality Control & Compliance

  • Inspect products for visible defects or damage.
  • Verify labeling accuracy and completeness.
  • Ensure compliance with internal quality standards.
  • Replace defective or incorrect items before shipment.
  • Conduct frequent checks to maintain shipment integrity.

Inventory & System Utilization

  • Utilize inventory software to create, track, and reconcile shipments.
  • Maintain accurate shipping documentation.
  • Assist in reconciling discrepancies within inventory systems.
  • Identify and resolve order fulfillment errors proactively.

Operational Efficiency & Workplace Organization

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Handle multiple priorities and urgent orders simultaneously.

title: Radar Modelling & Simulation Engineer
description:
As Radar Modelling & Simulation Engineer, you will build and own the radar modelling capability that underpins a new radar product line. You will define, implement, and maintain a radar digital twin throughout the development lifecycle—using modelling and simulation to inform system design decisions, explore concepts of operations (CONOPS), and derisk critical aspects such as algorithms and processing architectures.

Responsibilities

  • Define the radar digital twin scope, fidelity, interfaces, and validation approach
  • Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end radar models (RF/propagation, signal chain, processing, detection/estimation) across the product development lifecycle
  • Use modelling & simulation to inform system design decisions and trade-offs (e.g., waveform, antenna, processing, compute architecture)
  • Explore CONOPS and wider system implications of radar function, including interactions with platform constraints and mission needs
  • Derisk key design areas—such as algorithms, processing architectures, and performance margins—through targeted simulation studies
  • Develop system-level performance assessments (e.g., coverage, detection metrics, tracking performance) and run sensitivity/what-if analyses
  • Define model verification/validation methods, correlate models to test/measurement data where available, and quantify uncertainty
  • Communicate results clearly to hardware, software, and systems stakeholders; document model assumptions, limitations, and evidence
  • Establish modelling best practices (versioning, reproducibility, test cases) to enable repeatable decision-making and long-term maintainability

Requirements (Necessary)
  • Degree in a STEM subject (typically Electronics, Physics, or similar), or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong grounding in radar theory and core performance drivers
  • Modelling & simulation experience, including defining models, assumptions, and validation approaches
  • Working awareness of radar usage and context (e.g., algorithms, RF physics, and CONOPS considerations)
  • Ability to translate ambiguous system questions into structured simulation studies and clear, actionable outputs

Preferred (Desirable)
  • Deep technical knowledge of radar theory (e.g., waveform design, detection/estimation, clutter, propagation, interference)
  • Experience undertaking and owning model-based projects end-to-end (requirements, implementation, V&V, stakeholder communication)
  • Experience applying digital twin approaches within a technology-development programme
  • Understanding of system-level performance assessment (e.g., coverage analysis, detection metrics, sensitivity analysis and uncertainty quantification)

About Us

We're building low-cost interceptors that defeat these threats, and the surveillance systems to detect and target them – at a cost taxpayers can afford, at the pace the threat demands, and with sovereign supply chains that assure delivery.

We have immense backing from the world's best venture funds, we’re building a company for the scale and urgency of the mission and we’re one of the fastest-growing defence technology companies in history. That demands exceptional people across every discipline—people who combine deep expertise with sound judgement, take ownership of difficult problems and turn ambition into results.

The standards are high. The work is demanding. The impact is real. If you want to build something that matters, join us.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
