title: eCommerce Website QA Lead
description:
iSoftStone, Inc. is Seeking an eCommerce Website QA Lead to Join our Team!

*THIS IS A REMOTE CONTRACT POSITION*

**Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.**

Specialization: Bloomreach and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)

The eCommerce Website QA Lead is responsible for leading quality assurance strategy, planning, execution, and delivery across an enterprise eCommerce platform built on Bloomreach and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris).

This role ensures the quality, reliability, performance, accessibility, and functionality of customer-facing eCommerce websites and their supporting integrations. The QA Lead oversees functional testing, regression testing, test automation, integration testing, and release validation while establishing consistent QA processes and quality standards across onshore and offshore teams.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience testing enterprise retail eCommerce applications, a strong understanding of Bloomreach and SAP Commerce Cloud architectures and capabilities, and proven experience coordinating QA activities across development, product management, business analysis, and business stakeholders.

The QA Lead will drive continuous improvement in testing effectiveness, automation coverage, defect prevention, and release quality while supporting frequent, reliable delivery of eCommerce enhancements.

Responsibilities:

1. QA Leadership and Strategy

  • Define and maintain the overall QA strategy, testing standards, processes, and best practices for the eCommerce platform.
  • Lead functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, automation, performance, accessibility, and cross-browser testing.
  • Establish risk-based testing approaches focused on critical customer journeys, business functionality, and high-impact platform changes.
  • Define testing milestones, entry and exit criteria, release quality gates, and defect severity standards.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and direction to functional QA and test automation engineers.
  • Coordinate QA resources across onshore and offshore teams to ensure consistent execution and timely delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, prevent production defects, and increase automation coverage.

2. Bloomreach Platform Testing

  • Lead QA activities for eCommerce functionality implemented using Bloomreach, including applicable content management, search, discovery, and personalization capabilities.
  • Validate content creation, editing, publishing, scheduling, and delivery workflows.
  • Test content components, page templates, navigation, and content presentation across supported browsers and devices.
  • Validate search functionality, autocomplete, relevance, filtering, sorting, and product discovery where these capabilities are implemented through Bloomreach.
  • Test personalization, recommendations, and targeted experiences against defined business rules and acceptance criteria.
  • Validate content and product data synchronization between Bloomreach and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris).
  • Test APIs, integrations, and data flows between Bloomreach and supporting enterprise systems.
  • Verify that content and product updates are reflected correctly across the website and that publishing or synchronization failures are identified.
  • Partner with development teams to investigate platform-specific defects and integration issues.

3. SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Testing

  • Lead QA activities for eCommerce functionality implemented on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris).
  • Validate core commerce workflows, including:
    • Product catalog and product information management.
    • Product detail pages, product variants, and product attributes.
    • Category navigation, faceted search, filtering, and sorting.
    • Pricing, promotions, discounts, and coupon management.
    • Shopping cart and checkout.
    • Customer registration, authentication, and account management.
    • Payment processing and order submission.
    • Inventory availability and fulfillment options.
    • Shipping, delivery, and order status.
    • Order history and customer service workflows.
  • Validate product catalog synchronization, pricing accuracy, inventory updates, and order processing across integrated systems.
  • Test SAP Commerce Cloud APIs, business services, and integrations with external applications.
  • Validate business rules, exception handling, error messages, and transaction integrity.
  • Ensure regression testing covers critical commerce functionality affected by code changes, configuration updates, and platform enhancements.
  • Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot defects involving commerce services, APIs, configuration, and integration points.

4. End-to-End Integration Testing

  • Develop and execute end-to-end test scenarios spanning Bloomreach, SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), and connected enterprise systems.
  • Validate the complete customer journey from product discovery through checkout and order confirmation.
  • Test integrations involving:
    • Product information management and catalog feeds.
    • Content management and digital asset management.
    • Search and product recommendations.
    • Pricing and promotions.
    • Inventory and order management.
    • Payment gateways.
    • Shipping, delivery, and fulfillment.
    • Customer identity and account management.
    • Analytics and customer experience monitoring.
    • Third-party applications and APIs.
  • Verify data accuracy, synchronization timing, error handling, retries, and recovery behavior across integrations.
  • Coordinate integration testing with development teams, platform vendors, and third-party service providers.
  • Ensure changes to one platform are assessed for downstream impacts on the other platform and the overall customer experience.

5. Test Planning and Execution

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and regression suites.
  • Review business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs to identify gaps before development begins.
  • Ensure test coverage is aligned with business priorities, technical risks, and release scope.
  • Coordinate system integration testing, regression testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production validation.
  • Ensure appropriate test data, environments, access, and dependencies are available before testing begins.
  • Validate functionality across supported desktop and mobile browsers and devices.
  • Track test execution progress, failures, blockers, and outstanding defects.
  • Ensure test evidence and results are documented in accordance with established QA standards.

6. Test Automation and AI-Assisted Testing

  • Develop and maintain a test automation strategy for Bloomreach, SAP Commerce Cloud, and integrated eCommerce workflows.
  • Identify high-value automation opportunities, particularly for critical customer journeys and repetitive regression scenarios.
  • Lead the development and maintenance of automated UI, API, and integration tests.
  • Integrate automated regression tests into CI/CD pipelines where appropriate.
  • Evaluate testing tools and frameworks, such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, and API testing frameworks.
  • Leverage AI-assisted testing tools where appropriate to accelerate test creation, improve coverage, and identify potential defects.
  • Monitor automation execution results, reliability, maintenance effort, and return on investment.
  • Establish measurable goals for automation coverage and testing productivity.

7. Defect and Release Management

  • Establish and enforce defect management processes covering identification, documentation, prioritization, assignment, resolution, retesting, and closure.
  • Lead defect triage meetings with QA, Development, Product Management, and business stakeholders.
  • Ensure defects contain clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, supporting evidence, and appropriate severity and priority.
  • Track defects discovered during development, system testing, UAT, and production support.
  • Analyze recurring defects and production incidents to identify root causes and preventive actions.
  • Coordinate smoke testing, regression testing, and post-deployment validation for each release.
  • Prepare release quality assessments summarizing test results, unresolved defects, outstanding risks, and readiness recommendations.
  • Escalate critical quality risks and recommend corrective actions before production deployment.

8. Performance, Accessibility, and Customer Experience

  • Coordinate performance and load testing for high-traffic eCommerce workflows.
  • Monitor relevant web performance metrics, including Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
  • Validate website responsiveness, usability, and consistent rendering across supported devices and browsers.
  • Coordinate accessibility testing to support applicable WCAG standards and ADA-related requirements.
  • Validate integrations with content delivery networks, image optimization services, analytics platforms, and other third-party applications.
  • Partner with engineering teams to investigate page performance, API response times, caching, content delivery, and rendering issues.
  • Prioritize quality issues that could negatively affect conversion rates, checkout completion, revenue, and customer satisfaction.

9. Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
  • Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Developers, Architects, and business stakeholders.
  • Ensure QA estimates, test dependencies, and testing activities are incorporated into sprint and release plans.
  • Promote a shift-left testing approach by engaging QA early in requirements analysis and solution design.
  • Coordinate testing schedules and resource assignments across multiple workstreams.
  • Maintain clear communication regarding testing progress, blockers, defect trends, and release risks.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance collaboration, predictability, and delivery quality.

10. QA Metrics and Reporting

  • Establish dashboards and reports that provide visibility into testing progress and application quality.
  • Track test execution completion, pass/fail rates, defect trends, automation coverage, and outstanding risks.
  • Monitor production defect leakage, defect reopening rates, escaped defects, and recurring issues.
  • Report release readiness and quality trends to project leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce regression cycle time, improve test coverage, and increase QA productivity.
  • Use metrics to drive measurable improvements in testing effectiveness and overall platform stability.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Seven+ years of software QA and testing experience.
  • Three+ years of QA leadership experience managing testing activities, teams, or complex application delivery initiatives.
  • Strong experience testing enterprise eCommerce websites and transactional web applications.
  • Demonstrated experience with SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and/or Bloomreach in an eCommerce environment.
  • Experience with functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, end-to-end testing, and UAT.
  • Experience developing test strategies, test plans, test cases, and quality standards.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience with defect tracking and documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Understanding of web technologies, REST APIs, browser developer tools, and basic SQL/database validation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience coordinating testing across cross-functional and distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on QA experience with both Bloomreach and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris).
  • Experience validating integrations between Bloomreach and SAP Commerce Cloud.
  • Experience with enterprise retail eCommerce applications and high-volume transactional workflows.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
  • Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or REST Assured.
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or LoadRunner.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, Bitbucket, or similar source control platforms.
  • Knowledge of web performance monitoring and Core Web Vitals.
  • Experience with accessibility testing and WCAG compliance.
  • Experience leading onshore and offshore QA teams.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing, test generation, and quality engineering productivity initiatives.

Pay Range: $71-$76/hour

iSoftStone is a global IT service and consulting company that creates value and drives success through technology solutions, service excellence, and digital innovation. We specialize in web and application development, software testing and support, data and content management, digital experience, accessibility, and data for machine learning and AI. title: Payments Risk Analyst
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for an experienced Payments Risk Analyst II based in Belfast to join our Global Risk team. In this role you will independently manage less-defined and more complex risk work while contributing to team projects and operational improvements. This role builds on Analyst I capability by recognising patterns, expanding findings, suggesting solutions, and applying sound judgement with minimal direction.

What You’ll Be Doing

Reporting to the Risk Operations Lead, you will be responsible for daily monitoring within multiple risk queues along with various operational tasks including but not limited to:

  • Manage complex transaction, merchant, onboarding, fraud, credit, and compliance cases across risk queues, owning end-to-end assessments using merchant,business, account, transaction, and other risk signals.
  • Apply company, partner, supportability, and restricted-product policies to less-defined reviews with minimal direction, weighing competing factors and making sound decisions with imperfect information.
  • Use reports, risk signals, case trends, operational data, and web-service tools to identify emerging threats, high-risk or suspicious activity, and opportunities for proactive mitigation.
  • Balance portfolio protection and chargeback risk by assessing chargeback likelihood alongside the merchant’s capacity to repay.
  • Resolve compliance violations and complex cases, identify material risks, escalate unresolved issues appropriately, and contribute to resolution and follow-up.
  • Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and risk patterns across tools, workflows, queues, policies, and playbooks, and recommend practical improvements.
  • Produce concise case summaries, findings, recommendations, and decision rationale; maintain accurate documentation and contribute to knowledge material, playbooks, and team learning.
  • Lead complex customer communications and collaborate with Support, FS Merchant Services, Product, risk analysts, and other teams to resolve shared problems.
  • Contribute to incidents, complex reviews, trend investigations, projects, process improvements, and team best practices while prioritising competing work effectively.

What You Need To Bring

We are looking for a highly analytical and collaborative professional with experience within a relevant analyst role along with:

  • 2 years of experience in payments, fraud, credit risk, compliance, or financial services operations or related discipline.
  • Exposure to structured workflows, case management, queues, or service-level targets.
  • Experience working with written procedures and maintaining accurate records.
  • Interest in deepening existing knowledge on fraud, credit risk, merchant risk, and payments and suggesting improvements based on said knowledge.
  • Knowledge of Card Scheme rules and regulations
  • Understanding of the full Chargeback flow and process - Understanding chargeback risk timeframes.
  • Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets
  • Good conceptual thinking with proven analytic, problem-solving and effective reporting skills
  • Experience managing structured case work with increasing complexity and limited direction.
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions based on available information
  • Ability to work in a dynamic fast-paced environment with tight deadlines

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

What’s In It For You

Come live the Lightspeed Experience…

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding
  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about Fraud & Risk as you are
  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership
  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact
  • Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year
  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)
  • Flexible Paid Time Off - providing you the freedom to take time off however you like
  • Private Medical Insurance and cash health plan for optical, dental and more.
  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 GBP per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health
  • Mental Health Support through the LifeWorks and Modern Health Apps- whether it is meditation, coaching or counselling you need - each employee gets access to this platform
  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community
  • Transit / parking benefit - for when you need to travel to the Belfast office
  • A variety of drinks & snacks in our offices in Belfast.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who We Are

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

title: Diversion Specialist (Juvenile Probation Department)
description:
• New Hires Hourly Starting Rate -$29.11
  • 35 Hours Per Week

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Diversion Specialist oversees all youth referred to the Summary Diversion and Community Youth Aid Panel programs. This is a specialized position that requires the employee to understand the importance of diversion as it relates to the Juvenile Justice System Enhancement Strategy (JJSES). The employee will be required to have a basic understanding of the processes of the Juvenile Probation Office and the work completed by Juvenile Probation Officers but will not be required to perform such functions. The Diversion Specialist oversees all Summary Diversion and Community Youth Aid Panel processes. This includes oversight of volunteers on Community Youth Aid Panels and youth referred to both the Summary Diversion and the Community Youth Aid Panel programs. The goal of the Diversion Specialist is to facilitate the successful completion of youth involved in the Summary Diversion and Community Youth Aid Panel programs, providing an expeditious alternative to traditional case processing.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

Essential Functions

The duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not necessarily limited to:

  • Oversee the Community Youth Aid Panel process through attendance at all assigned panel meetings, which are generally 9-12 evenings per month.
  • Schedule for non-panel days would be 8:30 am - 4:30 pm.
  • Schedule for panel days would be 1:00 pm – 9:00 pm.
  • Contact juveniles and families for entrance into the Summary Diversion Program, helps facilitate appropriate obligations, and oversees completion of the obligations.
  • Assist intake officers in transferring appropriate cases to the Community Youth Aid Panel.
  • Supervise Community Youth Aid Panel volunteers and assist in maintaining up-to-date clearances.
  • Maintain volunteer records in the volunteer case management system.
  • Contact victims upon receipt of referral. Resolves restitution claims and collaborates with Victim/Witness Coordinators as needed to determine restitution figures.
  • Notify juveniles and families, victims, panelists, and police of scheduled Community Youth Aid Panel meetings and maintain schedule.
  • Maintain the volunteer information line.
  • Assist in development of Summary Diversion, Community Youth Aid Panel and other prevention or diversion programming deemed appropriate.
  • Assist in the recruitment of Community Youth Aid Panel volunteers.
  • Assist in interviewing and checking references for potential volunteers.
  • Assist in training new volunteers and police officers and providing yearly update trainings to existing volunteers and police liaisons.
  • Assist in the planning and implementation of special events, including the Volunteer Recognition Banquet.
  • Create and maintain files of all referred juveniles.
  • Enter all new cases into PaJCMS.
  • Expunge the cases of all juveniles who have successfully completed diversion programming.
  • Collaborate with police departments and community-based providers as needed to increase diversion efforts.
  • Assist in gathering and submitting yearly program outcomes.
  • Attend statewide meetings and other functions as needed.

MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • While an Associate’s degree may be acceptable, a Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice/Social Science is preferred, with at least 18 credits in behavioral and/or social sciences.
  • One year of experience in the criminal justice field, with an emphasis on criminal, court, legal practice, or a social service agency.
  • Prior customer service experience with an emphasis on heavy contact with both the general public and all levels of professionals, both face-to-face and by telephone
  • Any equivalent combination of experience and training that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities.
  • Valid state-issued driver’s license and the ability to use own vehicle for employment purposes.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Some working knowledge of the principles, methods, and practices of investigations, supervision, and reporting in probation as well as the benefits of diversion.
  • The ability to communicate effectively through oral and written expressions in a clear and concise manner.
  • The ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with individuals, agencies, and the public.
  • Knowledge of individual and group behavior as it pertains to delinquency, family dynamics, relationships, peer pressure, and drug and alcohol issues.
  • The ability to analyze facts and exercise sound judgment when acting in the best interest of the youth, victim, and community.
  • Basic skills in the operation of computer software applications.
  • The ability and willingness to work several evenings per week as required by the panel schedules.
  • Public speaking skills.
  • A valid Driver’s License and the ability to use own vehicle for employment purposes.
  • Ability to handle stress.
  • Physical presence in the office is required.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Ability to complete Defensive Tactics as required of an office-bound employee.

Work involves standing, walking, sitting, lifting, carrying, talking, hearing, using hands to handle, feel objects, tools, or controls, and reaching with hands and arms. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds a distance of 15 feet or less.

At times stressful given the workload and nature of the clientele.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT:

Normal cubicles and individual office environment. Work is primarily performed during regular business hours; however, evening or weekend work may be required. The position may require working in moderately noisy to loud environments, including cubicles and communal workspaces, and participating in frequent collaborative team meetings. The work environment may include a fast-paced setting with frequent interruptions, changing priorities, and interactions with employees, the public, and other stakeholders.

Requires travel to meetings with juveniles/volunteers in community-based Community Youth Aid Panel meetings and training locations around Berks County. Occasional travel outside of Berks County for trainings/meetings.

This position description serves as a guideline for communicating the essential functions and other information about the position to the applicant/employee. It is not intended to create a binding employment contract nor cover every detail of the position and may be changed where appropriate.

title: Banedanmark Safety & Interoperability Coordinator – Railway Safety in the Signalling Programme
description:
Be part of something big! Leave your mark on the future climate-friendly and digital railway.

Do you want to navigate at the intersection of compliance, risk management, and technology? Would you like to contribute to making Denmark’s railway safer? Are you able to balance multiple tasks simultaneously and thrive in a cross-disciplinary working environment? Then you might be the S&I Coordinator we are looking for.

At Banedanmark, we are currently replacing the entire railway signalling system with a modern digital system. Denmark is the first country in Europe to roll out digital signalling systems across the entire national railway network, making it the largest IT project in Danish history

You manage risks with confidence and collaborate on CSM and TSI across the organization

As an S&I Coordinator, you will be part of a team of other S&I Coordinators and Safety Managers working with CSM-RA (Common Safety Methods for Risk Assessment) and TSI (Technical Specifications for Interoperability). The experience level in the team ranges from a few years in the industry to more than 20 years of railway safety experience.

Your primary responsibilities will be to:

• Be responsible for preparing and reviewing CSM and TSI documentation
• Ensure delivery of S&I project deliverables
• Assist individual projects and colleagues with the various approval processes related to the implementation of CSM and TSI
• Ensure the necessary professional input into the risk management process
• Participate in hazard workshops where relevant risks for each project are identified

Experience, technical understanding, and collaboration skills.

You have an education in a relevant field and may either have a few years of work experience or be a recent graduate. The most important factor is that you are willing to acquire new knowledge in risk management.

It is an advantage if you are familiar with ETCS, but if not, you have the ability and interest to learn about the system’s technical components and functionality.

Your collaboration skills will be important, as you will work with both internal and external partners. We offer an international working environment, so it is important that you speak and write English fluently and understand cultural differences.

In addition, it is important that you can work proactively and thrive in an environment where there are periods of high workload. During such periods, you must be able to prioritize the most important tasks and work in a structured and organized manner. In other periods, there will be time and capacity for deeper focus and professional development.

About the Department

Your workplace will be at our headquarters in central Copenhagen, close to public transport at Dybbølsbro Station.

You will become part of the Safety & Interoperability section within the Signalling Programme. The section is responsible for ensuring safe solutions and safety approvals for infrastructure and rolling stock when changes have been made to them.

The section brings together Safety Managers and S&I Coordinators, working across safety and interoperability for both rolling stock (Onboard) and railway infrastructure (Trackside). The Onboard team focuses on safety related to the modification of rolling stock, while the Trackside team, which you will join, focuses on infrastructure.

We place strong emphasis on professional knowledge sharing, collaboration on tasks, and professionalism. At the same time, there is room for humor, and we value a supportive and collegial working environment. We also prioritize maintaining a flexible and balanced workplace, where you will work with a high degree of autonomy and influence when planning your own working life.

Salary and Employment Conditions

For candidates with an academic background employment will be based on the collective agreement applicable to academics employed by the Danish state, concluded between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the relevant academic organizations.

You will be placed on the salary scale based on your academic seniority and experience, either as Administrative Officer (fuldmægtig) or Senior Officer (specialkonsulent), in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and the salary framework issued by the Danish Agency for Public Finance and Management.

Salary and terms of employment will be determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and the salary framework for state employees.

Depending on your qualifications and experience, additional allowances may be negotiated. The remuneration package includes an employer-funded pension contribution of 18.07%.

For candidates covered by the HK collective agreement Employment will be based on the collective agreement applicable to office staff, laboratory technicians, and IT employees in the Danish state sector, including the General Collective Agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Public Employees' Organizations – The State Sector (OAO-S), and an organizational agreement concerning administrative officers, laboratory technicians and IT employees.

The position is classified within Salary Group 3.1 and salary, and terms of employment will be determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and the salary framework for state employees.

Depending on your qualifications and experience, additional allowances may be negotiated.

The remuneration package includes an employer-funded pension contribution of 16%.

Contact and Application

Please submit your application and CV through our website as soon as possible, as we review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact the Team Lead Martin Hougaard Messerschmidt at +45 23 84 30 81.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Different perspectives make us stronger. That's why Banedanmark values diversity and encourages all interested candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply.

If you proceed beyond the initial interviews, references will be obtained from previous employers. You will be informed before any reference checks are conducted.

title: Reparatør til teknisk afdeling i ABENA Produktion
description:
Vil du arbejde med fejlfinding, reparation og vedligehold på højteknologiske produktionsanlæg i en hverdag med faste rammer, dygtige kolleger og stor variation? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Du bliver en del af vores tekniske afdeling, hvor reparatører, elektrikere, teknikere og lærlinge arbejder tæt sammen om at holde produktionen kørende. Hos os møder du engagerede kolleger, høj faglighed og et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for både opgaverne og hinanden.

Hos ABENA producerer vi hver dag over 3 millioner højkvalitets-bleer til både babyer og voksne. Produktionen foregår på avancerede maskinanlæg, der kræver teknisk forståelse, præcision og godt samarbejde på tværs af produktion og teknisk afdeling.

Om jobbet

Din hverdag bliver alsidig og teknisk udfordrende. Du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre stabil drift på vores produktionsanlæg, og du arbejder tæt sammen med både kollegerne i teknisk afdeling og medarbejderne i produktionen.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • fejlsøge, reparere og vedligeholde maskinanlæg
  • udføre forebyggende vedligehold
  • ombygge og tilpasse maskinanlæg
  • koordinere opgaver ved vedligeholdsstop
  • arbejde i vores IT-baserede vedligeholdssystem
  • deltage i omstillinger og klargøring

Vi er i udvikling og investerer løbende i nye maskiner og ny teknologi. Derfor får du gode muligheder for at udvikle dig fagligt og bringe din viden i spil i en moderne produktion.

Jobbet er primært på daghold. Derudover skal du være indstillet på at arbejde på aftenhold i gennemsnit ca. hver 6. eller 7. uge og have tilkaldevagt ca. hver 12. weekend. Der kan også forekomme perioder, hvor der er brug for din hjælp på natskiftet.

Vi har stærkt fokus på sikkerhed. Hos os kommer sikkerhed altid først, både i måden vi arbejder på i produktionen, og i den måde vi passer på hinanden i hverdagen. Vi forventer, at du bidrager aktivt til et sikkert arbejdsmiljø.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi leder efter dig, der er fagligt stærk og trives med at være en del af et team, hvor vi løfter i flok.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en relevant baggrund som fx smed, landbrugsmekaniker, automekaniker, automatikmekaniker eller lignende
  • har erfaring med vedligehold
  • har kendskab til MAG/TIG svejsning, drejebænk, tegningslæsning, lejemontage, systematisk fejlfinding og pneumatikstyring
  • arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret
  • tager ansvar og hjælper dine kolleger
  • taler og skriver dansk

Hvorfor vælge ABENA?

Hos ABENA Produktion får du et spændende og afvekslende job i en virksomhed, hvor vi prioriterer både faglighed og mennesker. Du bliver en del af en afdeling med godt arbejdsklima, engagerede kolleger og gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

Vi lægger vægt på:

  • et stærkt fællesskab med samarbejde og godt humør
  • en moderne produktion med avancerede maskinanlæg
  • gode muligheder for udvikling og efteruddannelse
  • kantineordning, motionsrum og sundhedsordning
  • en arbejdsplads med tillid, retfærdighed og samarbejde

Hos ABENA skal det være trygt, rart og motiverende at gå på arbejde. Vi tror på ordentlighed, godt samarbejde og høj faglighed, og vi sætter en ære i at passe godt på hinanden, vores kunder og vores leverandører.

Er du vores nye kollega?

Send din ansøgning og CV snarest gennem vores ansøgningssystem. Vi behandler ansøgningerne efterhånden, som vi modtager dem, indtil vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Såfremt der er spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte vedligeholdelsesleder Bo Amdi Holm på tlf.: 51580560.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Spacious floor plans with sleek fixtures and finishes are complemented by amenities including a swimming pool and fully equipped fitness center. As a member of our team, you will play an important role in delivering outstanding service, building meaningful resident relationships, and helping create a welcoming community people are proud to call home. If you are passionate about customer service, collaboration, and making a positive impact every day, we would love to hear from you!

The LC delivers a welcoming, professional experience while ensuring all leasing activity complies with LIHTC, HUD/Section 8, and fair housing regulations.

Leasing & Marketing

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

  • Prior customer service, sales, or leasing experience preferred

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Ability to manage multiple prospects and priorities in a fast-paced environment

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  • Primarily on-site in the leasing office, with regular property and model apartment home tours
  • Standard business hours, including regular weekend availability
  • Some exposure to outdoor conditions and walking during property tours
  • Regular use of computer, phone, and office equipment
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and electronically
  • Occasionally move about the office to access files, office equipment, and meeting locations
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 15-25 pounds occasionally
  • Ability to bend, reach, stoop, and kneel as needed
  • Frequently stand, walk, climb stairs, and move throughout the property
  • May be exposed to varying weather conditions while performing outdoor duties
WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE: Elmington Living offers competitive compensation that reflects the market and the impact of the role, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being. Medical, dental, and vision coverage begins on the first of the month following your hire date, with no long waiting period. The company also provides life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage. Employees become eligible for the 401(k) plan with company match after 90 days and accrue vacation, sick, and personal time to recharge, in addition to receiving 10 paid holidays each year.

title: Senior Material Engineer
description:
With Aibel you have a chance to develop your career through a range of projects in renewables and oil and gas. We call ourselves Engineering Pioneers. Whatever our job is, we approach it with creativity, curiosity and a drive to find new and better solutions. First we imagine the future. Then we build it.

Job responsibilities:

  • Report to the Section Manager - System Engineering at basis level and to the Engineering Manager or Lead Technical Safety Engineer at project level.
  • Act as the single point of contact (as applicable) for the Material Technology Discipline and support the project team during Tenders or Conceptual, FEED or Detailed Engineering phases.
  • Be responsible for the cost-effective selection of materials and corrosion management framework to ensure integrity of materials applied in company projects through project lifecycle phases incompliance with relevant client requirements.
  • Review and provide inputs on metallurgy related technical matters during the development of equipment and bulk material specifications and review of bidder offers for packages.
  • Implement Company work processes, proceduresand quality policies as required by project.
  • Adhere to Company contractual requirements,Scope Boundaries and support the Project Engineering Manager/ Lead Technical Safety Engineer with the Management of change on assigned areas.
  • Be responsible for the technical integrity of all Material Technology design activities and deliverables under his/ her supervision through the project lifecycle and for the compliance with relevant project performance, integrity, quality and HSE requirements.
  • Review and provide technical inputs on Material Technology related technical matters to interfacing disciplines, during the development of design on projects.
  • Manage Material Technology interfaces with equipment and package suppliers to comply with technical requirements, specifications and Client’s Basis of Design, Standards &Project Specifications.
  • Be responsible for the Engineering for Procurement of packages such as insulation, Passive Fire Protection, painting, etc. and address bidder’s technical clarifications for application aspects of such material.
  • Support QAQC and review material related deviation requests for the project.
  • Review project Piping Material specifications and provide technical support to discipline clarifications.
  • Be responsible for the management of resources and progress of the Material technology scopes and for internal and external deliverables in line with the project budget and schedule.
  • Ensure that that all risks related to his/her area or responsibility are identified, assessed and preventive measures are implemented in a timely manner when required.
  • Be responsible for the progress of assigned Material Technology scopes, the internal and external deliverables in line with project budget and schedule.
  • Provide support to the project on verification activities as required by the verification body/classification society or other applicable approving authorities.
  • Represent the Material Technology discipline during meetings, audits, verifications, workshops and technical reviews and be responsible for an effective and timely resolution of identified issues.
  • Provide technical support related to Material Technology at the fabrication site, whenever required.
  • Continuously seek to improve working methods, tools and procedures and contribute actively to the Material Technology Discipline development and experience transfer.
  • Perform any other duties as assigned by his/her supervisor.

Work experience requirements:

  • Must have a minimum of 10 years of experience having worked in an engineering setup for upstream oil & gas projects (Fixed and Floating Installation projects) serving in the capacity of a material engineer, having accrued thereof a minimum experience of 5 years in the capacity of a Senior Material Engineer.
  • Must have work experience with medium/ large sized brownfield and greenfield projects in the Oil and Gas sector with similar roles and accountabilities and possess an excellent understanding of project phases, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Must have demonstrable experience in material selection (metallic and non-metallic materials), corrosion/ erosion principles, metallurgy and welding, corrosion/ erosion protection & management, cathodic protection and coating systems based on life cycle analysis and cost-effectiveness with a proven track record on projects in the upstream oil and gas sector.
  • Shall possess demonstrable design experience with development/ update and/ or review of typical Materials Selection and Protection related deliverables such as philosophies, specifications, procedures, study reports etc.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Material and/ or Corrosion Engineering or other equivalent engineering specialisation.

Other skills:

  • Must possess a sound understanding and knowledge of oil and natural gas industry standards such as, but not limited to, API (American Petroleum Institute), ASME (American Society of Mechanical Engineers), NACE (National Association of Corrosion Engineers), ISO(International Organisation for Standardisation) and other relevant standards related to material, erosion/ corrosion, examination, welding processes,testing/ inspections, thermal insulation etc.
  • Shall have strong computer literacy in commonly used business software applications such MS Office and shall be experienced in the use of the latest versions of Material selection tools such as Socrates, Predict and NORSOK M506 or similar.
  • Excellent technical communication (verbal and written) skills with proven ability to present technical issues to design teams, client, technical authorities and verification bodies.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work well with people at all levels.
  • A self-starter who can work independently, make sound decisions, analyse problems and provide focused solutions.

Other information:
Work location: Singapore
Application deadline: 06 December 2026

title: Senior Source Selection and Acquisition Strategy Specialist
description:
SABG is seeking a Senior Source Selection and Acquisition Strategy Specialist to support U.S. Space Force acquisition activities through the development, evaluation, and implementation of effective acquisition strategies and source selection approaches. This role provides expert-level acquisition planning, procurement analysis, and negotiation strategy support to Government contracting officers and program leadership. The successful candidate will apply extensive knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) requirements, evaluate complex acquisition needs, develop innovative procurement approaches, and recommend negotiation strategies that address cost, schedule, performance, and contracting risks. This position requires a seasoned acquisition professional with strong analytical capabilities, sound judgment, and the ability to support complex Government procurements in a mission-focused environment.

This position is contingent upon contract award.

Travel: N/A

JOB TITLE: Source Selection & Acquisition Strategy Support

CLEARANCE: Active TS, SCI Eligible
LOCATION: El Segundo, CA

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

  • Develop, evaluate, and recommend acquisition strategies aligned with program objectives, mission requirements, procurement regulations, and Government acquisition policies
  • Provide source selection and acquisition strategy support throughout the acquisition lifecycle, from requirements development and acquisition planning through solicitation, evaluation, negotiation, and award
  • Analyze new and complex acquisition requirements and apply analytical and evaluative techniques to develop innovative, effective, and efficient acquisition strategies
  • Advise Government contracting officers on procurement approaches, solicitation structures, contract types, competition strategies, and acquisition risks
  • Apply applicable FAR requirements, including FAR Parts 8.4, 12, 13, 15, and 16.505, to support acquisition planning, solicitation development, source selection, and task and delivery order competitions
  • Develop and assess negotiation strategies for complex procurement actions, including sole-source acquisitions and negotiations involving cost, delivery schedules, performance requirements, and contractual terms
  • Recommend approaches to resolve negotiation challenges, reduce costs, adjust delivery schedules, improve contract terms, and achieve favorable acquisition outcomes for the Government
  • Evaluate acquisition alternatives, procurement methods, market research, contractor capabilities, and cost and schedule considerations to support sound Government decision-making
  • Support the development and review of acquisition plans, source selection documentation, evaluation criteria, solicitation materials, negotiation objectives, and award recommendations
  • Assist with the development and evaluation of source selection approaches that promote fairness, consistency, transparency, competition where appropriate, and compliance with applicable requirements
  • Analyze technical, cost, schedule, performance, and contractual information to identify acquisition risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement
  • Coordinate with contracting officers, program managers, technical subject-matter experts, legal counsel, financial analysts, and other stakeholders to develop and implement acquisition strategies
  • Prepare briefings, decision memoranda, reports, and recommendations communicating acquisition alternatives, negotiation considerations, and procurement risks to Government leadership
  • Review acquisition documentation for completeness, consistency, regulatory compliance, and alignment with program objectives
  • Monitor changes in acquisition requirements, regulations, policies, and procurement conditions and assess their implications for acquisition strategy and execution
  • Independently manage complex acquisition support assignments, exercise sound professional judgment, and provide actionable recommendations to Government stakeholders.

SUPERVISION: N/A

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Master’s degree (MA/MS) in business, acquisition, contracting, management, public administration, or a related field
  • Ten or more years of relevant experience in Government contracting, acquisition strategy, source selection, procurement planning, or acquisition program support
  • Demonstrated contracting experience applying FAR Parts 8.4, 12, 13, 15, and 16.505 to Government acquisition activities
  • Knowledge of negotiation techniques and demonstrated skill in developing negotiation strategies for recommendation to the Government Contracting Officer to resolve complex issues, including cost reductions, delivery schedule adjustments, and negotiations in sole-source environments
  • Knowledge and demonstrated skill in applying analytical and evaluative techniques to new acquisition requirements to support innovative, effective, and efficient acquisition strategy development and implementation
  • Experience developing, evaluating, or implementing acquisition strategies for complex Government procurements
  • Experience supporting source selection activities, including acquisition planning, solicitation development, evaluation approaches, negotiation preparation, and acquisition documentation
  • Ability to analyze acquisition requirements, procurement alternatives, cost and schedule considerations, and contractual risks to develop well-supported recommendations
  • Experience advising or supporting Government contracting officers and acquisition leadership on procurement methods, contract structures, negotiation objectives, and acquisition decisions
  • Understanding of competition requirements, contract types, solicitation procedures, and task or delivery order competition processes
  • Ability to develop clear, defensible acquisition recommendations and supporting documentation that comply with applicable regulations and Government policies
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level briefings, decision documents, and acquisition recommendations
  • Ability to manage multiple complex assignments, work independently, and collaborate effectively with Government and contractor stakeholders in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment.

COMPUTER SKILLS:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Skills in operating a personal computer and standard office equipment

COMPETENCIES: To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems promptly; gathers and analyzes information skillfully; develops alternative solutions; works well in group problem-solving situations; and uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics
  • Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; edits work for spelling and grammar; varies writing style to meet needs; presents numerical data effectively; and able to read and interpret written information
  • Diversity – Shows respect and sensitivity for cultural differences, and promotes a harassment-free environment
  • Ethics - Treats people with respect; keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; works with integrity and ethically; and upholds organizational values
  • Planning/Organizing - Prioritize and plans work activities; uses time efficiently; plans for additional resources; sets goals and objectives; organizes or schedules other people and their tasks if needed; and develops realistic action plans
  • Professionalism - Tactfully approaches others; reacts well under pressure; treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; accepts responsibility for own actions; follows through on commitments

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, analyze, and interpret governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the public.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

REASONING ABILITY: Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to question activities and issues in all functional areas and make sound business decisions based on that data.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk, and hear. The employee is regularly required to write and type on a computer. The employee is frequently required to walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand; climb, or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Job duties are performed in a manufacturing/office environment utilizing standard office equipment such as a computer, photocopier, and telephone. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

title: Technical Support Engineer II, ShareFile
description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) - the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI-powered applications and experiences with agility and ease.

We’re proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a Technical Support Engineer II and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. This will be a hybrid role splitting your time between your home office and our Belen CR location.

In this role, you will:

  • Handles technical issues in assigned products of low to moderate complexity with little to no supervision by following established processes and procedures for the workflow.
  • Maintains confidentiality while engaging courteously and calmly with customers and peers, remaining approachable and receptive to feedback—even under pressure.
  • Maintains complete and accurate log of customer interactions and technical detail.
  • Investigates customer environment, customer logs and/or code, identifies bugs, proposes workarounds and working solutions and creates feature requests.
  • Manages difficult communication with customers in an effective and professional manner with assistance from senior team members and knows when to escalate issues.
  • Conducts research using a variety of resources, including documentation, Knowledge Base, bug database, and the world wide technical and field teams via Community forums.
  • Reviews product documentation, identifies and contributes to topics needing improvement.
  • Drives the creation and update of knowledge base articles and documentation to meet evolving customer needs.
  • Ensures readiness for support of new product versions and features.
  • Increases product and procedural knowledge through formal and self-training, work with colleagues, and experience with customer issues.
  • May be required to participate in on-call rotations (including weekends and holidays) based on business needs. Schedules will be communicated and coordinated in advance to ensure appropriate planning.
  • Responsible for the management of case and account escalations.

Operational Expectation

  • Participate in project work and performs independent work with some guidance, gradually gaining autonomy
  • Collaborates closely with engineering teams by logging product defects and feature requests clearly and engaging engineering when assistance is required.

Leadership

  • May provide guidance to new employees

Expertise

  • Requires expanded conceptual knowledge of technical support concepts while developing additional skill sets
  • Demonstrates and applies good understanding of knowledge capturing (e.g. delivering webinars or technical presentations to peers, highlighting product features or issues to support skill development across the team.)
  • Understands product domain

Your background:

  • This role requires demonstrated related professional experience in and may require a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related fields
  • Proven analytical and troubleshooting skills specific to software related issues.
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Basic programming experience or knowledge of programming languages/technologies.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with IP-based communication protocols and packet-level data transmission, including familiarity with network transport mechanisms such as TCP/IP and UDP.
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge of Unix and/or Windows Operating System and networking.

If this sounds like you and fits your experience and career goals, we’d be happy to chat.

What we offer in return is the opportunity to experience a great company culture with wonderful colleagues to learn from and collaborate with and also to enjoy:

  • Health insurance plan that provides coverage for a wide range of medical services, including doctor visits, dental, emergency care, and preventative care, for yourself, your spouse, or your dependent children (until 18 years old and up to 25 years old if they are full-time students, with proof of eligibility).
  • Life and disability insurance for our employees.
  • Competitive salary, bonus or commission (according to your position), and best-in-class Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) with a 27-month lookback
  • Besides your legal vacation days, you will received a paid day off for your birthday, and company holidays. A variety of leave plans, including additional paid time off and other leaves.

title: Skadedyrsbekæmper til Københavns Kommune
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med bekæmpelse af rotter, og er der gemt en detektiv i maven på dig?

Så kunne det her være jobbet for dig. Vi har fået mere travlt i Skadedyrsenheden og skal derfor have en ny kollega.

Om jobbet
I Skadedyrsenheden sætter vi en ære i at hjælpe københavnerne og byens erhvervsdrivende med at finde årsagen til, at rotter kommer og at få løst problemet.

Som miljøkontrollør vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver bestå i at

  • køre ud til borgere, restauratører eller andre, der har brug for hjælp til at bekæmpe rotter og undersøge problemet og rådgive i rottesikring og forebyggelse
  • føre digital sagsbehandling i forbindelse med dine tilsyn
  • føre opsyn med hygiejneforhold og renholdelse i beboelsesejendomme mv. og varetage den efterfølgende sagsbehandling

Hvem er du?
Vi forventer, at du

  • har kendskab til bygge- og anlægsforhold - fx som bygningshåndværker eller har erfaring med kloakering osv.
  • har kørekort til almindelig bil
  • besidder it-færdigheder på brugerniveau, blandt andet til sagsbehandling
  • har sproglige færdigheder til at formulere dig på dansk i både skrift og tale
  • kan begå dig på engelsk i almindelig samtale

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har autorisation til bekæmpelse af rotter. Hvis du ikke har autorisationen i forvejen, betaler vi for kurset hos Miljøstyrelsen, så du bliver autoriseret til at bekæmpe rotter.

Du skal varetage dele af dine arbejdsopgaver ude hos vores borgere samt på kontoret. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du er god til at tilrettelægge din dag og følge opgaverne til dørs, såvel praktisk som administrativt. Det skriftlige og administrative arbejde udgør ca. 1½ - 3 timer dagligt.

Da vi kommer som myndighedspersoner i private hjem, skal du desuden være villig til at fremvise en straffeattest.

Du bliver en del af

  • et stærkt fagligt hold på 27 medarbejdere, der deler det samme engagement med at holde rottebestanden nede i vores by og yde en god service
  • et godt kollegialt sammenhold med en humoristisk og uformel omgangsform, hvor vi sparrer og hjælper hinanden i det daglige
  • en organisation, der både har fokus på god ledelse og på at sikre gode udviklings- og uddannelsesmuligheder for sine medarbejdere

Vi tilbyder
Du får en attraktiv arbejdsplads, der skaber rammerne for, at vi har en god balance mellem privat- og arbejdsliv, herunder

  • fastansættelse med 37-timers arbejdsuge med betalt frokostpause
  • moderne kontorfaciliteter på Kraftværksvej 25 med gode parkeringsmuligheder
  • mulighed for løbende at uddanne dig gennem kurser udbudt i Klima- Miljø- og Teknikforvaltningen
  • en attraktiv pensionsordning
  • løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst for miljøkontrollører

Vi ønsker, at du kan tiltræde den 1. januar 2027.

Yderligere oplysninger
Hvis du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte enhedschef Kjeld Christensen på 61 24 94 65.

Søg via linket senest søndag den 22. november 2026
Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler i uge 48.

title: Medicinstuderende søges til forskningsprojekt om søvn og neurodegenerative sygdomme
description:
Medicinstuderende søges til forskningsprojekt om søvn og neurodegenerative sygdomme

Er du medicinstuderende og interesseret i klinisk forskning, patientkontakt og søvnmedicin?

Dansk Center for Søvnsygdomme søger 2-3 engagerede medicinstuderende til et forskningsprojekt med en forventet varighed på 12 måneder.

Projektets overordnede formål er at identificere tidlige markører for udviklingen af Parkinsons sygdom. Dette undersøges blandt andet ved løbende opfølgning og undersøgelse af patienter gennem forskellige søvnundersøgelser, herunder polysomnografi (PSG) og en nyere metode, øre-EEG.

Som studentermedhjælper vil du blandt andet få ansvar for:

  • Modtagelse og undersøgelse af patienter

title: Media and Communications Officer (P)
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from first- and second-tier candidates, particularly qualified female candidates as well as applications from the non-represented member countries of IOM. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process.

For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates:

  1. Internal candidates
  2. Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Cabo Verde, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Tuvalu, Vanuatu

Second tier candidates include:
All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM.

Organizational Context and Scope

Under the overall supervision of the Regional Director and the direct supervision of the Regional Crisis Coordinator, and in coordination with the Regional Media and Communications Officer and the Media, Innovation & Community Engagement Unit at Headquarters (HQ), the Media and Communications Officer will be responsible and accountable for managing the implementation of media and communications-related activities for IOM Gaza response. The operation in Gaza is framed around IOM's Strategic Plan for the Gaza Response, consisting of several areas of operations, including the establishment of a common pipeline and facilitating logistical access to partners operating in Gaza.

1. Coordinate the implementation of external communication strategies in line with the Organization’s strategic communications priorities and guidelines, promoting an accurate narrative on migration-related issues with the media, the general public, the UN, and other key partners.

2. Supervise the preparation of Media-related content on current and emerging issues and support the preparation of Media Lines to Take in crisis situations by the Regional Media and Communications Officer and relevant colleagues at the Media, Innovation & Community Engagement Unit at HQ.

3. Provide technical advice to the Crisis Coordination Team on strategic communications issues, including sensitive internal and external communications, and ensure the high quality and consistency of media and public outreach for IOM’s Gaza response.

4. Supervise and manage Media and Communications staff to ensure content is of the highest quality, aligned with IOM’s brand guidelines and consistent with the Organization’s strategic communications priorities. Enhance communications capacity by providing training and capacity building to the Media and Communications staff and other relevant teams.

5. Review all external communications content related to IOM’s Gaza response, including stories, blogs, video and social media content; provide timely editorial advice in consultation with the Regional Media and Communications Officer on whether they are best suited for publication on national, regional or global IOM platforms.

6. Assist the Crisis Coordination Team in preparing to represent IOM’s Gaza response, including arranging media interviews, reviewing speeches and preparing media Lines to take. Develop and contribute content to communications campaigns at a national, regional and international level, including for relevant UN Days.

7. Manage the IOM’s Gaza response online presence, including through its social media accounts and website to increase the impact of CO’s digital outreach.

8. Strengthen IOM’s links with media in-country to promote the activities of IOM’s Gaza response; maintain media contact lists, coordinate responses to media requests; prepare timely press releases/media packages, and organize press briefings, media trainings, and partnerships, among other relevant activities.

9. Draft media key messages, Statements, talking points, and other relevant background documents for IOM’s use.

10. Engage with the UN Country Team’s Communication Group and other relevant actors and lead on developing media messages on key issues by working together on campaigns and issues of joint concern.

11. Undertake duty travel to take photographs and video footage and gather material for multi-media content showcasing the humanitarian situation and IOM field activities. Ensure that Media and Communications content is clear and concise, and that digital informed consent is secured.

12. Ensure that there is appropriate gender, diversity, and inclusion awareness in all IOM external communications.

13. Perform such other duties as may be assigned.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Master’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or,

  • University degree in one of the above fields with seven years of relevant professional experience

Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.

Experience

  • Experience as a writer, editor, and content producer/manager in international Journalism and/or public information roles, preferably in the Region;

  • Experience in digital communications and social media;

  • Experience in corporate writing and editing;

  • Experience in managing donor visibility;

  • Experience with media liaison;

  • Experience in humanitarian communications;

  • Experience working in the region and/or in an emergency setting is an advantage; and,

  • Experience working in UN or other international organizations.

Skills

  • Skills in graphic design, particularly using Adobe programmes, are an advantage;

  • Skills in photography and videography, both shooting and editing, are an advantage;

  • Demonstrated gender awareness and gender sensitivity;

  • High level of professionalism and ability to work under pressure and adhere to strict deadlines in a complex and fast-changing environment; and,

  • Proven interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively and harmoniously with colleagues from varied cultures and professional backgrounds.

Languages

For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written).

Working knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian and Spanish) is an advantage.

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
  • Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
  • Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
  • Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
  • Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
  • Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
  • Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
  • Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2

  • Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential.
  • Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential.
  • Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty.
  • Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction.
  • Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings.

Notes

Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months.

Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security as well as accreditation, any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and any forms of discrimination. IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children.

IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times.

IOM does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for application, interview, processing, training, or otherwise—and does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM WAVE system (for internal candidates link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

title: Senior DevOps Konsulent
description:

Den ideelle kandidat har solid erfaring med transformationsrejser, hvor DevOps-processer og værktøjer er blevet effektfuldt implementeret. En vigtig del af rollen består i at drive kulturel forandring og kommunikere effektivt på tværs af teams. Det er et krav, at kandidaten taler og skriver flydende dansk.
