title: Shelter and Settlement Partnership Officer
description:
Danish Refugee Council (DRC) is a leading protection agency with a mandate to protect, advocate and promote durable solutions for displacement affected populations.

DRC has been operating in Ukraine since 2014, currently DRC employs over 800 staff in Ukraine and implements emergency response in the Protection, Livelihoods, Shelter/NFIs and Humanitarian Disarmament and Peacebuilding (humanitarian mine action) sectors, using direct interventions, support to duty bearers and civil society organizations (CSOs), and partnerships with CSOs. DRC will continue and adapt its durable solutions portfolio to the evolving context.

DRC is currently looking for a Shelter and Settlement Partnership Officer to work in Sumy, with possible regular field visits all around Sumskyi rayons (with the most frequent field visits to Okhtyrskyi rayon).

About the job:

Under the supervision of the Shelter and Settlement Manager and/or Team Leader, Shelter and Settlement Partnership Officer will provide comprehensive support and contribute to all activities related to the implementation of rehabilitation projects.

Your main duties and responsibilities will be:

  • Ensure effective implementation of Shelter and Settlement activities in line with approved project documents, objectives, work plans, budgets and relevant technical standards.
  • Maintain and regularly update beneficiary registers, ensuring accurate data disaggregation by gender, vulnerability and household size.
  • Monitor the quality and timeliness of internal reporting and ensure proper documentation, filing, storage and archiving of project records and tools.
  • Provide basic technical support to Shelter activities and monitor construction and maintenance works through regular field visits and contractor follow-up, ensuring compliance with agreed technical specifications and safety standards.
  • Represent DRC in relevant technical coordination meetings and facilitate effective integration and coordination of Shelter activities with other DRC sectors.
  • Act as the Shelter Programme Focal Point for assigned partners, supporting partner identification, onboarding and implementation of activities in alignment with project objectives, indicators and DRC standards.
  • Contribute to the development and review of partnership agreements, ensuring that programme-related components, including activities, indicators, Bills of Quantities (BoQs), implementation timelines and technical requirements, are accurate and feasible.
  • Monitor partner performance and implementation progress against agreed work plans, targets and indicators, identify potential delays or deviations, and support corrective actions where necessary.
  • Ensure the quality and compliance of partner-implemented activities with DRC Shelter technical standards, Shelter Cluster guidelines and applicable national regulations, including the review of technical documentation and verification of completed works.
  • Identify partners' technical and operational capacity gaps and contribute to the development and implementation of Capacity Development Plans, providing targeted on-the-job support, mentoring and guidance.
  • Review and verify partner narrative reports against agreed indicators, targets, work plans and Means of Verification (MoVs), ensuring the accuracy and consistency of reported achievements and supporting documentation.

About you

To be successful in this role we expect you to have at least 2 years professional experience working in non-governmental humanitarian organizations. Moreover, we also expect the following:

Required

  • Higher education in one of the following fields: Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction, Humanities, Development Studies, International Relations, Psychology, Management, Public Administration.
  • Fluency in Ukrainian.
  • English is required (upper intermediate).
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Computer literacy: confident user of MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Strong understanding of protection mainstreaming and inclusion principles in humanitarian programming
  • Willingness to travel frequently to field (one day tyravels/2-3 times per week) all over the Sumska oblast, but mostely to Okhtyrskyi rayon.
  • Personal discipline, punctuality, responsibility in decision-making, honesty, sociability.

Desirable

  • Experience interacting with aid recipients, local authorities, or participating in humanitarian projects.

In this position, you are expected to demonstrate DRC’ five core competencies:

  • Striving for excellence: You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process.
  • Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback.
  • Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation.
  • Communicating: You listen and speak effectively and honestly.
  • Demonstrating integrity: You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment.

We offer

  • Contract length: 7-months, including a 3-month probation period, with the possibility of extension subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funding
  • Designation of Duty Station: Sumy
  • Band: H
  • Start date: 1st December 2026

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with Danish Refugee Council’s Terms of Employment for employees on national contract; starting from EUR 2025 gross per month (depending on experience and qualifications).

Application process

All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English.

Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Closing date for applications: 16 Noveber 2026.

title: Surgery Scheduler - Gastroenterology
description:
At The Portland Clinic our mission is to be a trusted community collaborating to improve the health and well-being of those we serve. Join our team and let us work together to offer a welcoming, inclusive environment for our patients and the communities we serve.

SUPERVISOR: Office Supervisor/Branch Manager

HOURS PER WEEK: 40hrs M-F (8:00am - 5:00pm)

DEPARTMENT: Nursing Services

HIRING BONUS: $1,000 after 90 days

PRIMARY FUNCTION: Schedules general and local surgeries and procedures as directed by the physicians and/or their office personnel, according to established Portland Clinic policies. Performs a variety of clerical and record-keeping task related to the patients surgery, procedure and/or pre-operative testing. Instructs patients regarding surgery schedule, preparation and insurance issues.

5. Educate patients regarding their preparation for procedures or surgery. Provide them with appropriate medication and written information. Advise patients regarding specific medical problems that may impact their surgery, procedure or preparation.*
6. Screen calls and requests and route/escalate messages as needed for procedures or surgeries. Re schedule patients when necessary.*

10. Follow TPC guidelines for documentation, including use of forms and computer data entry using Electronic Health Record (EHR).*
11. Comply with HIPAA regulations at all times.*
12. Follow OSHA and TPC guidelines and policies for the prevention of the spread of blood-borne pathogens, including; maintaining a clean work environment, use of safety and personal protective equipment and engineering controls. *
13. Maintain safety standards such as use of patient safety equipment, knowledge of emergency procedures, use handrails on stairs, body mechanics and ergonomics.*
14. Maintain current CPR card if appropriate.
15. Attend nursing meetings and in-services.

17. Participate as a team member to assist and train others as needed. Work under the supervision of a Physician, Nurse Practitioner, Registered Nurse or Practical Nurse.*

21. Abide by company policies.*

23. Maintain regular, in person, work attendance and punctuality, as scheduled.*

High School Diploma or equivalent

Values team success

Contributes to an environment where people feel valued
Keyboarding skills

Organizational skills and ability to prioritize work flow
Oral communication skills and excellent phone etiquette with an ability to convey and receive information via the telephone

Capability of effectively working on more than one task without a reduction in the quality of work and service performed

title: Chief of Party (Proposed), DRC
description:
Counterpart International is seeking a Chief of Party (COP) for an anticipated five-year, USDA Title II Food for Peace Non-Emergency Program. The Food for Peace program has three principal objectives: to reduce chronic hunger and malnutrition, to improve livelihoods, and to build resilience in vulnerable communities.

The COP provides overall vision, technical, and administrative leadership for the project. The COP will manage a team of senior staff to ensure the quality, timeliness, and efficiency of all products and activities generated under the project. The COP will be responsible for communications with USDA, for publicly representing the project, and for liaising with government entities and broader stakeholders.

The COP is responsible for ensuring that implementation adheres to standards of technical quality in accordance with USDA and Counterpart International standards. They will be responsible for the completion of project deliverables.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Provide overall project leadership, management, quality control, and technical direction, while ensuring compliance with donor requirements and regulations and Counterpart policies and procedures.
  • Build an integrated vision among diverse project components and stakeholders, with a focus on achieving results.
  • Identify obstacles and risks related to implementation in a timely manner and suggest appropriate adjustments to the home office and donor.
  • Liaise with USDA and key stakeholders.
  • Manage and supervise the work of project personnel, subcontractors, and grantees, with a focus on achieving work plan targets and results in a timely manner.
  • Provide mentoring and professional development support to project staff, with emphasis on building capacity of national staff.
  • Oversee field office finances and administration of sub-contracts and sub-awards.
  • Oversee field office HR practices, ensuring hiring, employee evaluations and promotions are in compliance with Counterpart policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate activities between the field office and Counterpart headquarters.
  • Leverage networks, program investments, and project successes to seek opportunities for program expansion and promoting Counterpart’s practice areas.
  • Job descriptions are not exhaustive and the job holder may be required to undertake duties which are broadly in line with the above responsibilities.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivelant in international development, agriculture, agribusiness, economics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in food security and nutrition, with a specific focus on food assistance, commodity distribution, nutrition, and resilience among vulnerable populations.
  • Successful track record leading implementation US Government-funded projects (USDA or USAID) in developing country contexts, including oversight and management of personnel, finances, partnerships, host country relationships, and administration.
  • Prior Chief of Party experience or equivalent experience leading USG-funded projects.
  • Experience supervising teams of diverse staff and demonstrated leadership capacity.
  • Advanced leadership, interpersonal, and strategic analysis skills.
  • Experience working on programs pertaining to commodities management, proven track record working with a range of government and community actors and managing teams in multiple offices and locations.
  • Demonstrated track record working successfully with diverse stakeholders in the private and public sectors to achieve a common goal.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and deliver quality outputs.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience working in Africa; experience in DRC is strongly preferred.
  • Professional proficiency in French is strongly preferred.

title: Donation Door Attendant
description:

Location: LOCATION NAME (CITY, FL)

Goodwill Southwest Florida is seeking a Donation Door Attendant to serve as a front-line representative of the organization while receiving, recording, and sorting donated goods through the Kaizen system. This position provides excellent customer service to donors, maintains a clean and safe donation area, and ensures donations are processed according to established procedures and guidelines.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Retail and/or stock handling experience preferred.
  • Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods of time and independently stoop, bend, kneel, push, and pull.
  • Ability to use a donation tablet.
  • Ability to frequently lift at least 40 pounds and occasionally team-lift up to 100 pounds.
  • Ability to exercise good judgment, patience, and understanding while providing excellent customer service.

Why Goodwill?

Pensions Committee Independent Person

Part–time -3.5hr per week -15days per year.

About Us:

Located in the heart of South London, Lambeth Borough is a vibrant community of over 317,600 residents. Stretching from the dynamic neighbourhood of Streatham in the South to the iconic landmarks of Waterloo in the North, we are proud to be the 9th largest borough in London. Our diversity is our strength, with more than 130 languages spoken, making Lambeth the home of the Windrush generation, London's largest LGBTQ+ community, and a thriving Portuguese-speaking community.

It is an exciting time to join Lambeth Council, we have bold ambitions for the future of Lambeth’s communities and residents through ourLambeth 2030 Plan ‘Our Future, Our Lambeth.

With exceptional schools, lush green spaces including Brockwell Park, cultural gems like the Black Cultural Archives, and world-renowned institutions such as St Thomas's Hospital, Lambeth offers an enriching and dynamic environment.

Please have a look at our dedicated One Lambeth Values and Behaviours page.

About the Team:

The London Borough of Lambeth is the Administering Authority for the Lambeth Pension Fund, which is part of the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS).

Following recent reforms to the LGPS and the introduction of Regulation 53A, the Fund is required to appoint a named Independent Person. This is a non-voting position that will provide independent strategic advice, support and constructive challenge to the Pension Fund Committee, the Senior Officer and the asset pool. The role is intended to strengthen the Fund's governance arrangements through supporting the Senior Officer and Chair of the Pensions committee by providing independent scrutiny of advice and recommendations received by the fund, ensuring alignment with statutory guidance.

The postholder will also support the development and review of key Fund strategies, policies and governance documents.

About the Role:

Comparable to the role of a Non-Executive Director or Professional Trustee, the position will be expected to cover a wide range of duties. These include but are not limited to:

• To support and contribute to the development of all strategies for which the Pensions Committee is responsible

• To scrutinise any advice given to the Committee, whether from the pool or any other organisation or individual

• To help monitor and assess performance against targets set in LGPS strategies, including administrative performance and the London CIV’s implementation of the investment strategy, and help monitor whether the collective pool oversight process is meeting the requirements of the administering authority

• To support consideration of the Committee’s governance arrangements, including any action plans arising from Independent Governance Reviews

• Uphold independence and avoid conflicts, providing assurance to scheme

members and employers through high standards of conduct.

• To contribute in any other way appropriate to the authority’s LGPS functions

The role will also encompass oversight of the administering authority's position as both shareholder and client of its asset pooling company, London CIV, supporting the monitoring of the asset pool’s implementation of the Fund’s investment strategy.

The successful candidate will bring significant pensions experience and expertise together with a understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing the LGPS. Applicants should either:

• Hold a relevant qualification from the Pensions Management Institute (PMI)

• be a member of, and accredited by, the Association of Professional Pension Trustees (APPT)

• or be able to demonstrate extensive knowledge and experience within the LGPS environment.

How to Apply:

To be considered for interview, your CV and supporting statement will clearly evidence how you meet the shortlisting criteria on the personal specification marked “A” for application:

Schools Evaluation & Support Review Officer JD&PS

We operate an anonymised application process, so be sure to remove personal details when uploading your CV or personal statement.

For an informal discussion about the role, please contact Patrick Kilgallen Pkilgallen@lambeth.gov.uk

We are committed to safer recruitment and are proud to be a Stonewall diversity champion, a Living Wage Employer, and to guarantee interviews for all disabled candidates who meet the minimum criteria of the role. title: Øjenoperationsafsnit EO søger en ny kollega
description:
Øjenoperationsafsnit EO søger en ny kollega

Vi søger en sygeplejerske (37 timer/uge) til operationsafsnit EO med ansættelse fra d. 1. januar 2027.

Om operationsafsnit EO

På operationsafsnittet opererer vi patienter med øjenlidelser, og vi har et stort flow af patienter til såvel elektive som akutte operationer. Vi modtager patienter i alle aldre.

Vi er 23 sygeplejersker i afsnittet. Vi opererer på 5 stuer, og på Patienthotellet 2.sal har operationsafsnittet tre injektionsstuer, hvor vi behandler patienter med bl.a. AMD.

Desuden bemander vi vores Dagkirurgiske afsnit, hvor vi modtager og klargør de af vores patienter, som skal opereres i generel anæstesi.

Vi har vagtordning for hele Region Syddanmark alle ugens dage. I hverdagene er der dagligt en sygeplejerske med tilkaldevagt fra hjemmet fra 15.30 til kl. 22.00, og lørdage er der fremmøde i afdelingen fra kl. 07.30-13.30, hvorefter man har tilkaldevagt fra hjemmet indtil kl. 22.00. Søndage er med tilkaldevagt fra kl. 07.30-22.00.

Vi arbejder på tværs af de faglige subspecialer inden for oftalmologi, men har mulighed for at fordybe og dygtiggøre sig inden for et udvalgt subspeciale. Desuden har vi en klinisk vejleder og et vejlederteam, som varetager de primære funktioner omkring de sygeplejestuderende og social-og sundhedsassistent-elever vi modtager i øjenafdelingen.

Vi har en klinisk sygeplejespecialist, som bistår med udviklingsopgaver i tæt samarbejde med afsnittets kolleger og ledelse.

Øjenafdeling E består desuden af 3 øjenambulatorier og en forskningsenhed.

På øjenoperationsafsnit EO er vi bl.a.

◾ åbne for forandringer

◾ vi samarbejder

◾ vi har medansvar

◾ vi er engagerede

◾ vores faglige viden er opdateret

◾ vi har medindflydelse

◾ vi er loyale og ærlige

◾ vi er rummelige

◾ vi har god kommunikation med vores omgivelser

◾ vi udvikler og bruger vores viden

  • Og vi søger en kollega, som kan matche disse værdier!

Desuden kan vi bl.a. tilbyde:

◾ grundig oplæring i de forskellige funktioner i afsnittet og i øjenspecialets forskellige operationer, ved hjælp af kompetencekort for operationssygeplejersker, MySkills samt kontaktsygeplejerskeprincippet

◾ et godt humørfyldt arbejdsmiljø med tæt tværfagligt samarbejde, som vi vægter højt

◾ en god kombination af pædagogisk og instrumental sygepleje

◾ gode tværfaglige teams, hvor der er mulighed for subspecialisering

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår for stillingen følger af sundhedskartellet, 32.17.1. Startlønnen for stillingen kan findes via følgende link: Se startløn for stillinger i Region Syddanmark.

Hør mere:

Du er velkommen til at kontakte oversygeplejerske Rikke Schmidt-S. Bergmann på telefon 6541 2783 eller mail: rikke.schmidt-soerensen@rsyd.dk

I forbindelse med ansættelse indhentes der børneattest.

Ansøgningsfrist: Søndag d. 22. november 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt onsdag d. 25. november 2026

title: Kommunikationskonsulent til Ungdomsskolen
description:
Har du en kommunikationsfaglig baggrund, og vil du være med til at skabe gode løsninger for Københavns unge?

Som kommunikationskonsulent får du en central rolle i at synliggøre Ungdomsskolens mange aktiviteter og tilbud, der spænder fra fritidsundervisning og heltidsundervisning til 10. klasse og Ungeråd KBH.

Ungdomsskolen er en af de større aktører på ungeområdet i København, og det er vigtigt for os, at både byens unge og vores mange samarbejdspartnere har et tydeligt kendskab til de aktiviteter og muligheder, vi tilbyder.

Det kræver, at du kan omsætte vores aktiviteter og faglighed til relevant og vedkommende kommunikation og sikre, at vi er synlige på de rette platforme og i de rette sammenhænge.

Om stillingen
Det er dig, der står for Ungdomsskolens daglige kommunikationsindsats – fra idé og planlægning til produktion og publicering. Du omsætter fælles retning og prioriteringer til konkret kommunikation og sikrer fremdrift i opgaverne.

Det kræver, at du kan arbejde proaktivt og selvstændigt, tage initiativ og besidder en god portion dømmekraft ift. at prioritere din tid og indsats.

Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt team med forskellige kompetencer, der arbejder med at understøtte Ungdomsskolens afdelinger på tværs af organisationen. Her får du kolleger at sparre med og samarbejde med, men du skal trives med selv at være den, der driver kommunikationsopgaven.

Derudover får du en vigtig rolle i at varetage og koordinere en række tværgående administrative opgaver, som er en del af at drive en kommunal organisation. Det kunne blandt andet være dokumenthåndtering, samtykker samt vedligeholdelse og udvikling af procedurer og arbejdsgange. Du bliver dermed også en vigtig drivkraft i at sikre, at vi har styr på de systemer og rammer, der understøtter en velfungerende organisation, og at de er formidlet og tilgængelige for afdelingerne.

I teamet hjælper vi hinanden på tværs af opgaver og fagligheder. Du skal derfor også have lyst til at tage fat på opgaver uden for dit eget felt, når der er brug for en ekstra hånd.

Dine opgaver bliver bl.a. at

  • vedligeholde og udvikle Ungdomsskolens hjemmesider i samarbejde med koordinatorerne
  • udvikle og være projektleder på kommunikationskampagner
  • optage, producere og redigere film og fotos fra vores afdelinger, aktiviteter og events
  • udarbejde og opdatere grafisk materiale og tryksager
  • planlægge og vedligeholde indhold på sociale medier
  • understøtte og facilitere de lokale afdelingers arbejde med at formidle de gode historier fra deres hverdag
  • udvikle og vedligeholde procedurer og arbejdsgange, der sikrer, at vi lever op til gældende krav – samt sikre, at procedurerne er tilgængelige og letforståelige
  • indgå i administrative opgaver, herunder sagsbehandling og udviklingsopgaver efter behov

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • har en akademisk kommunikationsfaglig uddannelse og erfaring med ekstern kommunikation – gerne fra en organisation med mange forskellige målgrupper og aktiviteter
  • har erfaring med at planlægge, producere og publicere indhold til sociale medier og hjemmesider samt med grafisk produktion og foto/video
  • kan drive kommunikationsopgaver selvstændigt fra idé til færdigt produkt
  • har en god fornemmelse for, hvordan du prioriterer din tid og indsats. Du kan skelne mellem opgaver, der kræver grundighed og fordybelse, og opgaver, der skal løses enkelt og effektivt
  • har forståelse for rammerne og vilkårene i en politisk styret organisation og kan navigere i en hverdag med forskellige interesser, hensyn og beslutningsprocesser
  • har blik for detaljen og trives også med de mere systematiske opgaver, hvor det handler om at skabe struktur, vedligeholde arbejdsgange og sikre, at vi overholder gældende krav
  • har gerne erfaring med unge som målgruppe og kendskab til skole- og uddannelsesområdet
  • har let ved at skabe relationer på tværs af fagligheder og funktioner. Du møder andre åbent og nysgerrigt og formår at skabe gode samarbejder med mange forskellige typer mennesker
  • bidrager aktivt til fællesskabet, byder ind med idéer og tager fat, hvor der er brug for det. Du deler gerne din viden, hjælper dine kolleger og ser dig selv som en del af et hold, hvor det fælles mål er at understøtte afdelingerne bedst muligt

Vi tilbyder
Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til at sprede vingerne og få indflydelse på både opgaverne og måden, vi løser dem på. Du får en hverdag med stor kontaktflade til hele organisationen og mulighed for at sætte dit præg på, hvordan vi synliggør Ungdomsskolens mange aktiviteter og tilbud.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team, hvor vi sparrer med hinanden, deler viden og hjælper til, hvor der er brug for det. Vi har en uformel omgangstone, højt til loftet og en fælles ambition om at skabe gode løsninger – altid med Københavns unge i centrum.

Om Ungdomsskolen
Ungdomsskolen arbejder med at skabe fritids- og undervisningstilbud for alle byens unge. Vi er organiseret i tre hovedområder: Almenafdelingen, heltidsundervisningen og 10. klasse. Derudover varetager vi sekretariatsfunktionen for Ungeråd KBH, ungedemokratiindsatser, praktiske undervisningsforløb i juniormesterlære og meget mere.

Almenafdelingen tiltrækker hvert år tusindvis af elever fra alle dele af byen til blandt andet fritidsundervisning, mens vores tilbud inden for heltidsundervisning og 10. klasse henvender sig til unge med forskellige behov for uddannelse og afklaring.

Ansættelsesforhold
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst. Stillingen er med en arbejdstid på 37 timer ugentligt.

Mere information
Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte Frank Størup på 20 85 48 18 eller mail frstoe@kk.dk.

Søg via linket senest søndag den 22. november 2026

· Ability to communicate in English both written and verbally

Experience:

· Position requires minimum two (2) years’ experience specific to the position and civil and/or structural engineering, including testing, inspection, scheduling and quantity reporting, material purchasing, construction specifications, working knowledge of construction equipment, drawings, and coordinating subcontractors.

· Prefer experience with geotechnical engineering and bridge foundations.

Education:

  • Required: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering is preferred, with an emphasis on Heavy Structural, Civil Roadway, and Geotechnical Foundations.

Essential Functions:

Scheduling

· Initiate and develop detailed work plans for specific crews with Field Supervision to ensure work is completed safely and timely with a high degree of quality. Implement and monitor the work plans in the field with Field Supervision, Subcontractors, Vendors, Inspectors, and Craft. Submit final work plan to Project Manager for final approval prior to performing the work.

· Responsible for building 3-week schedules for crews and update on a weekly basis.

· Provide the Project Manager with accurate CPM schedule updates to meet project requirements.

· Assist Project Manager co-ordinate the work with Owner’s Design Engineers, Inspection staff, Subcontractors, Vendors, Haulers, and Regulatory Agencies.

Ordering & Coding

· Confirm receipt of materials and services with invoicing from vendors and subcontractors through OnBase invoice coding. Review timecards in Heavy Job for accuracy for all labor and equipment hours and ensure correct cost codes are being utilized.

· Order materials / tools required as related to specific crews.

Technical Support & Engineering

· Assist Project Manager with all administrative requirements within Wagman internal processes.

· Assist the Project Manager review and approve shop drawings, draft RFIs and maintain submittal log. Provide technical support and interpretation to company supervisors and subcontractors through the ability to read and understand complex construction plans to ensure work complies with all engineering standards, codes, specifications and design instructions.

· Understand and assist with Project Quality Control Plan

· Monitor all work for compliance with the Project Site Specific Safety Plan and the Wagman Environmental- Health and Safety Plan.

· Monitor Field production rates for in place work daily to ensure bid productions are attained.

· Review, analyze and resolve field construction problems, plan discrepancies or plan errors and omissions.

· Provide Project Manager with daily quantities specific to Contract Items to ensure accurate payment from the Owner. Reconcile monthly Pay Estimate with the Project Manager.

· Assist Project Manager initiate and develop a detailed Utility Matrix project wide and continue updates for new and relocated utilities.

· Assist Project Manager organize and maintain contract documents and Shop Drawings through a detailed Document Control policy.

· Assist Project Manager with Final Quantities and Project close out including all required “as-built plans”.

· Perform QA/QC testing functions such as pile load tests, soil nail verification and proof tests, and tie-back testing and lock-off.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to lift up to 30 pounds from ground level to waist level.
  • Able to bend, squat and kneel occasionally throughout a scheduled work shift.
  • Able to climb ladders, if required.
  • Continuous standing and walking required while outside.
  • Able to perform simple grasping and fine manipulation tasks with both hands.
  • Working outdoors in wet, muddy, cold, hot, and humid weather, may occur during site visits.
  • Acceptable corrected vision (in both eyes) and acceptable corrected hearing required.

Our Values

Wagman’s Core Values of integrity, mutual respect, safety, innovation, sense of urgency, and community are an integral part of every decision, and every plan made at Wagman and these values have laid the foundation for our success and longevity for our past, present, and future.

Beyond the buildings and bridges which connect and improve our communities, Wagman has community engagement programs and initiatives which help to build better, for our people.

Wagman Culture
Wagman is committed to cultivating a workforce and preserving a culture built on our core values. Our people are our most valuable assets. We value the diverse identities, experiences, perspectives, backgrounds capabilities and talents that our people bring to Wagman.

From hiring to training, development, and promotions to special events, Wagman is committed to providing equal and equitable opportunities and rewarding experiences. As a family business providing a safe and healthy work environment in accordance with our mission, we foster diverse and inclusive work experiences and a sense of belonging.

Wagman is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. We recognize and value our diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Wagman is proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V.

title: Medical Office Specialist II
description:
JOB PURPOSE OR MISSION: Performs multiple administrative and clerical duties within a clinic setting.

PERFORMANCE CRITERIA

CRITERIA A: Everyday Excellence Values - Employee demonstrates Everyday Excellence values in the day-to-day performance of their job.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS:
• Demonstrates courtesy and caring to each other, patients and their families, physicians, and the community.
• Takes initiative in living our Everyday Excellence values and vital signs.
• Takes initiative in identifying customer needs before the customer asks.
• Participates in teamwork willingly and with enthusiasm.
• Demonstrates respect for the dignity and privacy needs of customers through personal action and attention to the environment of care.
• Keeps customers informed, answers customer questions and anticipates information needs of customers.

CRITERIA B: Corporate Compliance - Employee demonstrates commitment to the Code of Conduct, Conflict of Interest Guidelines, and the GHS Corporate Compliance Guidelines.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS
• Practices diligence in fulfilling the regulatory and legal requirements of the position and department.
• Maintains accurate and reliable patient/organizational records.
• Maintains professional relationships with appropriate officials; communicates honesty and completely; behaves in a fair and nondiscriminatory manner in all professional contacts.

CRITERIA C: Personal Achievement - Employee demonstrates initiative in achieving work goals and meeting personal objectives.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS
• Uses accepted procedures and practices to complete assignments. Uses creative and proactive solutions to achieve objectives even when workload and demands are high.
• Adheres to high moral principles of honesty, loyalty, sincerity, and fairness.
• Upholds the ethical standards of the organization.

CRITERIA D: Performance Improvement - Employee actively participates in Performance Improvement activities and incorporates quality improvement standards in his/her job performance.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS
• Optimizes talents, skills, and abilities in achieving excellence in meeting and exceeding customer expectations.
• Initiates or redesigns to continuously improve work processes.
• Contributes ideas and suggestions to improve approaches to work processes.
• Willingly participates in organization and/or department quality initiatives.


CRITERIA E: Cost Management - Employee demonstrates effective cost management practices.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS
• Effectively manages time and resources
• Makes conscious effort to effectively utilize the resources of the organization — material, human, and financial.
• Consistently looks for and uses resource saving processes.


CRITERIA F: Patient & Employee Safety - Employee actively participates in and demonstrates effective patient and employee safety practices.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS
• Employee effectively communicates, demonstrates, coordinates and emphasizes patient and employee safety.
• Employee proactively reports errors, potential errors, injuries or potential injuries.
• Employee demonstrates departmental specific patient and employee safety standards at all times.
• Employee demonstrates the use of proper safety techniques, equipment and devices and follows safety policies, procedures and plans.


JOB FUNCTIONS

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS include, but are not limited to:

1. Answers telephone, greets visitors and schedules appointments.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS:
• Courteously and professionally greets guests/answers phone calls and handles appropriately according to clinic protocols.
• Maintains master scheduling program for all areas and makes appointment schedules for all patients, via computer system according to established procedures.
• Coordinates transportation needs of patients as needed.
• Coordinates insurance coverage with patients, insurance company, and Business Office as indicated.
• Communicates special patient needs to appropriate staff.

2. Enters patient charges, completes chart maintenance and provides a variety of clerical support functions.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS:
• Enters charges accurately on the same day it is incurred.
• Coordinates charge data functions according to established procedures Types and proofs a variety of material (e.g., letters, forms, reports, etc.) from rough draft and corrected copies.
• Maintains accurate and current files of all patient records, correspondence, reports, and information, as required.
• Forwards completed discharged charts to Medical Records according to established procedures.
• Prepares patient folders and files patient information appropriately, copies charts as approved by Medical Records, faxes and files a variety of materials.
• Mails patient evaluations, progress notes, prescriptions, etc., and follows-up on all correspondence within defined time lines.

3. Performs billing functions to ensure proper billing and collections.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS:
• Identifies and records required billing information according to insurance carrier requirements with 100% accuracy.
• Completes billing information accurately.
• Processes claims electronically with 100% accuracy and mail claims to insurance carriers daily.
• Enters documentation and adjustments through computer system to maintain a correct account balance.
• Updates system information daily according to correspondence received and processed.
• Documents any changes on a daily basis and submits information to appropriate personnel.
• Seeks clear directions to resolve issues and bring problems to a proper resolution.


4. Reviews and identifies charge discrepancies and completes all requests for rebilling from inter-department personnel.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS:
• Reviews charge summaries on each patient bill that is produced and identifies discrepancies with 100% accuracy.
• Audits requests for accurate information.
• Completes rebilling within 10 days according to established rebilling procedures.
• Manually documents rebilling log upon completion with 100% accuracy.


5. Prepares daily production reports, maintains required records, reports, and files while evaluating account information.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS:
• Monitors number of accounts and outstanding balances within three days of receiving report.
• Consistently applies appropriate procedures to prevent accounts from becoming delinquent or remaining unbilled.
• Initiates appropriate follow-up.


6. Performs all other duties as assigned.


SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS
Sufficient prior experience with billing, scheduling and general office responsibilities in a clinic setting.

SPECIFIC EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS
High School Diploma preferred, post high school vocational/specialized training encouraged.

SPECIAL SKILL, LICENSE AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS
Minimum typing skills of 45 wpm, ten key by touch, data entry skills.

HIPAA REQUIREMENTS:
Maintains knowledge of and adherence to all applicable HIPAA regulations appropriate to Job Position.

SAFETY REQUIREMENTS:
Maintains knowledge of and adherence to all applicable safety practices appropriate to Job Position including but not limited to: incident reporting, handling wastes, sharps and linens, PPE, exposure control plan, hand washing, and environmental round to ensure safety,

title: Seniorforsker inden for børns sundhed, trivsel og læring med ansvar for forskningsledelse
description:
Center for Klinisk Forskning og Forebyggelse (CKFF) ved Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospital søger en erfaren og engageret seniorforsker med en stærk forskningsprofil inden for sundhedsfremme og forebyggelse blandt børn og unge. Stillingen kombinerer selvstændig forskning med ansvar for den faglige, organisatoriske og strategiske ledelse af forskningsgruppen CHESS (Children’s Health and Education in School and community Settings) i Sektion for Sundhedsfremme og Forebyggelse.

Vi søger en seniorforsker med solid erfaring i at udvikle, lede og gennemføre tværvidenskabelig, praksisorienteret forskning samt dokumenterede kompetencer inden for forskningsledelse, forskningsfinansiering og udvikling af stærke forskningsmiljøer og arenaer som familier, dagtilbud, skoler, fritid og boligområder.

Om stillingen

Som seniorforsker skal du bedrive selvstændig forskning i krydsfeltet mellem børn og unges sundhed, trivsel og læring med særligt fokus på populationsbaseret strukturel forebyggelse og befolkningsrettet sundhedsfremme i børn og unges hverdagsmiljøer.

Dit forskningsområde skal have fokus på sundhedsfremme og forebyggelse i børn og unges hverdagsmiljøer, herunder i dagtilbud og skoler. Et centralt element er udvikling, evaluering og implementering af komplekse interventioner og forebyggende indsatser med blik for, hvilken betydning pædagogiske, fysiske og organisatoriske rammer har for virkninger og forankring.

Du skal samtidig varetage den faglige og organisatoriske ledelse af forskningsgruppen CHESS med ansvar for at videreudvikle gruppens forskningsstrategi, skabe faglig sammenhæng på tværs af projekter og medarbejdere og understøtte et stærkt og attraktivt forskningsmiljø. Du skal desuden bidrage til udviklingen af sektionens samlede strategiske retning gennem tæt sparring med sektionslederen.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du kan kombinere selvstændig forskning på højt videnskabeligt niveau med evnen til at udvikle forskningskapacitet og skabe fælles faglig retning. Du skal kunne forene forskningsmæssig kvalitet og excellence samt faglig specialisering med missionsorienteret forskning og praksisbehov i tråd med CKFF's overordnede mission.

Dine primære opgaver vil være at:

  • Initiere, udvikle, lede og gennemføre selvstændige forskningsprojekter og større tværvidenskabelige forskningssamarbejder samt sikre videnskabelig produktion af høj kvalitet.
  • Lede og videreudvikle CHESS som tværvidenskabeligt forskningsmiljø, herunder sætte den faglige retning, udvikle forskningsporteføljen, koordinere forskningsaktiviteter og understøtte et stærkt og attraktivt forskningsmiljø både i CHESS, i sektionen og på CKFF.
  • Initiere og koordinere fondsansøgninger, tiltrække ekstern forskningsfinansiering og bidrage til en langsigtet, bæredygtig udvikling af forskningsaktiviteterne.
  • Vejlede og supervisere ph.d.-studerende, postdocs og yngre forskere samt understøtte kompetenceudvikling og forskningsmæssig karriereudvikling.
  • Etablere og videreudvikle nationale og internationale forskningssamarbejder og tværsektorielle partnerskaber med blandt andet universiteter, professionshøjskoler, kommuner og civilsamfundsorganisationer.
  • Bidrage til forskningskommunikation, herunder forskningsbaseret undervisning, formidling, rådgivning og vidensudveksling samt understøtte anvendelse og implementering af forskningsresultater i praksis.

Om CKFF, Sektion for Sundhedsfremme og Forebyggelse og CHESS

På CKFF bliver du en del af et stærkt tværvidenskabeligt forskningsmiljø, der arbejder med at udvikle viden og indsatser, som kan forbedre befolkningens sundhed og reducere ulighed i sundhed.

Sektion for Sundhedsfremme og Forebyggelse udfører forskning med et anvendelsesorienteret perspektiv og særligt fokus på udvikling, evaluering og implementering af komplekse interventioner.

CHESS omfatter et tværvidenskabeligt forskningsmiljø med omkring 20 forskere, heraf seks medarbejdere med ansættelse på CKFF. Gruppen arbejder med forskning i børn og unges (0-17 år) sundhed, trivsel og læring med særligt fokus på de institutionelle og sociale rammer, der former deres hverdagsliv. Forskningsgruppen beskæftiger sig blandt andet med bevægelse og fysisk aktivitet, leg, deltagelse og inklusion, pædagogiske praksisser, natur og udeliv, mental sundhed og sociale fællesskaber i dagtilbud, skoler, familier og lokalsamfund.

Et centralt kendetegn ved CHESS er udvikling af videnskabeligt velfunderet og missionsorienteret forskning i tæt samarbejde med børn, unge, fagprofessionelle, beslutningstagere og andre forskningsmiljøer. Ambitionen er at skabe ny viden af høj videnskabelig kvalitet, som samtidig kan bidrage til udvikling af bæredygtige forebyggelsesindsatser og forbedrede muligheder for børn og unge.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi lægger vægt på, at du har:

  • Ph.d.-grad inden for et relevant forskningsområde og kvalifikationer på seniorforskerniveau, dokumenteret gennem videnskabelig produktion, selvstændig forskningsvirksomhed og en tydelig forskningsprofil.
  • En stærk, internationalt orienteret forskningsprofil inden for sundhedsfremme og forebyggelse med særlig erfaring i forskning i børn og unges sundhed, trivsel og læring i institutionelle og pædagogiske sammenhænge.
  • Solid forskningsmæssig erfaring med udvikling, evaluering og implementering af komplekse interventioner i børn og unges hverdagsmiljøer, f.eks. inden for fysisk aktivitet, trivsel, deltagelse, læring eller pædagogiske og organisatoriske rammer for sundhedsfremme.
  • Stærke metodiske kompetencer inden for relevante forskningsmetoder samt erfaring med at udvikle og lede tværvidenskabelige forskningsprojekter, der integrerer kvantitative og kvalitative tilgang
  • Solid erfaring med selvstændig projekt- og forskningsledelse samt faglig og organisatorisk udvikling og koordinering af tværvidenskabelige forskningsmiljøer.
  • Dokumenteret erfaring med at tiltrække ekstern forskningsfinansiering og udvikle større forskningsansøgninger og tværinstitutionelle forskningssamarbejder.
  • Erfaring med vejledning og supervision af ph.d.-studerende og yngre forskere samt forskningsbaseret undervisning og kompetenceudvikling.
  • Et veletableret nationalt og internationalt forskningsnetværk samt erfaring med samarbejde mellem forskningsinstitutioner, kommuner og øvrige praksisaktører.

Vi forventer desuden, at du arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og strategisk, har stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner og kan skabe engagement og fælles retning i et tværfagligt forskningsmiljø. Du har en inkluderende og udviklingsorienteret tilgang til forskningsledelse og evner at kombinere videnskabelige ambitioner med organisatorisk forståelse og forskningens samfundsmæssige relevans.

Vi kan tilbyde

  • En selvstændig seniorforskerstilling med betydelige muligheder for at udvikle egen forskning og præge forskningsområdets videre udvikling.
  • En central rolle med ansvar for at sætte et tydeligt fagligt og strategisk aftryk på udviklingen af CHESS i tæt samarbejde med forskningsgruppens medarbejdere, sektionsledelsen og CKFF’s øvrige forskningsmiljøer
  • Et stærkt forskningsmiljø med engagerede kolleger og mulighed for faglig sparring og udvikling.
  • En bred kontaktflade til nationale og internationale forskningsmiljøer samt kommunale og øvrige praksisorienterede samarbejdspartnere.
  • Mulighed for at bidrage til udvikling af forskning med høj videnskabelig kvalitet og betydelig samfundsmæssig relevans.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er placeret ved Center for Klinisk Forskning og Forebyggelse, Sektion for Sundhedsfremme og Forebyggelse, Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospital, Region Øst. Tjenestested er Frederiksberg Hospital.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling og ønskes besat pr. 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst for akademikere ansat i regioner m.v. 33.01.1
Se regionens oversigt over star​​​​tlønninger her

Ansøgningsprocedure

Din ansøgning skal indeholde en motiveret ansøgning (max. 1 side), CV, fuldstændig publikationsliste, forskningsplan samt dokumentation for akademiske kvalifikationer og eventuel tidligere seniorforsker- eller lektorbedømmelse.

Ansøgningsfrist: 19. november.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 48 og 49.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte: Sektionschef Christina Bjørk Petersen, christina.bjoerk.petersen@regionh.dk.

Ansøgning fremsendes via Region Hovedstadens elektroniske rekrutteringssystem.

title: Project Assistant  G4 - Manakara
description:
Introduction

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates.

Organizational Context and Scope

The Regional Responses to Climate Displacements in Sub-Saharan Africa (RE2CLID) project aims to enhance the resilience and self-reliance of Displacement-Affected Communities (DACs) in Sub-Saharan Africa who face the risks of disasters, the adverse effects of climate change and environmental degradation. This initiative targets the highly vulnerable displacement affected communities in Southern Africa and the Indian Ocean Countries, namely Malawi, Mozambique, Madagascar, Comoros, Mauritius and Seychelles (i.e. Cluster 2).

Under the overall supervision of the Project Manager of the RE2CLID project in Madagascar and the direct supervision of the RE2CLID Project Officer in Madagascar and in close collaboration with the RE2CLID SAIO Programme Coordinator in Malawi and relevant parties, including the IOM team in country, the successful candidate will be responsible and accountable for supporting the implementation, monitoring and reporting of the project activities of the RE2CLID project in Madagascar.

  1. Assist in the implementation and monitoring of project activities.
  2. Retrieve, compile, summarize, and present information/data on specific project topics.
  3. Monitor budget; verify availability of funds; obtain necessary approval and update budget related information.
  4. Support administrative coordination of project implementation, involving liaison with diverse organizational units and external parties to initiate requests, obtain necessary clearances, process and follow-up on administrative actions, etc.
  5. Draft status reports, identifying shortfalls in delivery and bringing them to the attention of the supervisor.
  6. Draft correspondence, reports, briefing notes, graphics, statistical tables, presentations and other forms of documentation.
  7. Organize meetings, workshops and training sessions.
  8. Respond to general information requests and inquiries; set up and maintain files/records.
  9. Perform other related duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • School diploma with four years of relevant experience; or,

  • Bachelor’s degree in Political or Social Sciences, International Relations, Development Studies, Migration Studies, Human Rights, Law or related fields from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience.

    Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.

Experience

  • Experience in liaising with governmental authorities, national/international institutions, United Nations agencies and non-governmental organizations;
  • Experience in working with migrants, refugees, internally displaced persons, victims of trafficking and other vulnerable groups; and,
  • Prior work experience with international humanitarian organizations, non-government or government institutions/organization in a multi-cultural setting is an advantage.
  • Experience in assisting with logistics, organization of meetings, workshops, and outreach events.
  • Experience in collecting and compiling field-level data, activity reports, and participant feedback.
  • Experience in multi-cultural settings with international organizations, NGOs, or government institutions is an advantage.

Skills

  • Strong organizational and administrative skills to support day-to-day project operations.
  • Ability to coordinate logistics and ensure smooth implementation of field activities.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with communities and local stakeholders.
  • Capacity to work effectively in a team and adapt to diverse cultural contexts.
    Attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures and guidelines.

Languages

All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish).

For this position, fluency in French is required (oral and written).

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

Required Competencies

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

  • Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
  • Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.

title: Asset Integrity Engineer
description:
Asset Integrity Engineer | Energy & Resources

Philippines | Remote Delivery Supporting Australian Project Teams

  • Build specialist capability in storage tank integrity and fitness-for-service assessment
  • Deliver finite element models, calculations and technical reports for degraded API 650 storage tanks
  • Learn directly from senior engineers while contributing to high-quality Australian project delivery

The Opportunity

Fyfe is strengthening its offshore asset integrity delivery capability, and we're looking for an Asset Integrity Engineer to support our growing portfolio of storage tank assessment work.

Reporting to the Section Manager, you'll work remotely from the Philippines as part of Fyfe's offshore delivery team, collaborating closely with Australian-based engineers and project managers. You'll undertake engineering calculations, finite element analysis, data reviews and technical reporting, with a particular focus on degraded above-ground metal storage tanks.

This is an opportunity to develop specialist expertise while contributing to real project outcomes. With guidance and technical review from senior engineers, you'll build your capability in tank integrity engineering, Strand7 modelling and the application of API standards, taking on greater autonomy as your experience grows.

The Impact You'll Have

  • Deliver asset integrity, fitness-for-service and remaining-life assessments for above-ground storage tanks and related infrastructure.
  • Develop axisymmetric finite element models in Strand7, applying approved inputs, modelling methods and acceptance criteria.
  • Turn design, inspection, operating and condition data into clear, traceable calculations, models and technical reports.
  • Support the assessment of corrosion, cracking, fatigue, distortion and other service-related degradation.
  • Strengthen technical quality by identifying data gaps, documenting assumptions and uncertainties, completing self-checks and incorporating review feedback accurately.
  • Work with Australian-based project teams and other engineering disciplines to deliver coordinated outcomes within agreed scope, quality, budget and schedule requirements.

What You'll Bring

You'll bring a strong foundation in mechanical engineering and the curiosity to develop specialist capability in storage tank integrity assessment.

  • A tertiary qualification in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • Foundation knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, stress analysis and the behaviour of metallic structures and equipment.
  • The ability to develop accurate and traceable engineering calculations and finite element models under appropriate technical supervision.
  • Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, supported by a methodical approach and close attention to detail.
  • The ability to interpret engineering drawings, inspection data, material information and operating conditions, and identify missing or inconsistent inputs.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare calculation sheets, technical reports and engineering documentation.
  • The organisation, accountability and adaptability to manage assigned work, collaborate across locations and meet project deadlines in a structured remote delivery environment.

It would be great if you also have graduate or early-career experience in mechanical engineering, asset integrity, stress analysis, inspection, design or industrial project delivery. Experience with Strand7 or similar finite element analysis software, together with developing knowledge of API 650, API 653, API 579 and relevant ASME and Australian Standards, would also be valuable.

Why Fyfe?

Fyfe is an Australian multidisciplinary consultancy specialising in engineering, environment, planning and surveying. We partner with clients across Energy & Resources, Renewables, Infrastructure and Property, delivering practical solutions that support the energy transition and critical infrastructure projects shaping Australia's future.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Build specialist capability in storage tank integrity and finite element analysis through practical project experience.
  • Learn from senior and principal engineers through technical guidance, coaching and structured review.
  • Contribute to meaningful engineering assessments supporting Australian project teams.
  • Help improve calculation sheets, modelling templates, standardised workflows and technical delivery practices.
  • Grow your autonomy and engineering judgement as your technical competence and experience develop.

Interested?

If you're ready to build specialist asset integrity expertise and apply your engineering skills to complex storage tank assessments, we'd like to hear from you.

Join Fyfe and help deliver reliable, accurate and high-quality asset integrity solutions while shaping your capability in a specialised area of engineering.

Only candidates who are Australian Citizens, Permanent Residents or hold full Australian working rights will be considered.

Agency applications will not be accepted.

for more information please contact careers@fyfe.com.au

ROLE CONTEXT

The BMC Shared Services Business Unit provides centralised HR, Finance, Commercial and Corporate Affairs support to Vedanta Zinc International’s operations at Gamsberg, Black Mountain Mine (BMM) and VZI Projects.

The Head Financial Reporting & Shared Services is responsible for leading the financial reporting, statutory compliance, external audit, financial governance and shared services finance functions across Vedanta Zinc International. The role ensures the integrity, accuracy and timeliness of financial information reported to Vedanta Group, shareholders, lenders, regulators and other stakeholders.

The position provides leadership over the Accounts Payable and Financial Reporting functions, ensuring compliance with IFRS, Vedanta Group Finance Standards and regulatory requirements while supporting strategic decision-making through robust financial analysis, impairment assessments, insurance management, covenant monitoring and financial risk management.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Head Financial Reporting & Shared Services leads all financial reporting, statutory reporting, audit management and shared service finance activities for Vedanta Zinc International.

The role is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting through Hyperion Financial Management (HFM), statutory financial statement preparation, impairment assessments, insurance administration, lender reporting and covenant compliance. The position drives financial control excellence, process automation and continuous improvement while developing a high-performing finance team and maintaining strong stakeholder relationships with auditors, bankers, insurers and Vedanta Group Finance

· Lead accurate and timely HFM, statutory and Group reporting.

· Ensure compliance with IFRS, Group policies and disclosure requirements.

· Review key consolidations, reconciliations and financial reporting submissions.

· Review and approve significant accounting journals and adjustments.

· Maintain effective financial controls and governance frameworks.

· Ensure integrity and accuracy of financial information.

· Lead the external audit and statutory reporting process.

· Deliver annual financial statements within agreed timelines.

· Resolve audit matters and achieve zero material misstatements.

· Ensure accuracy, integrity and reliability of financial data.

· Monitor financial covenants and identify potential risks.

· Engage with operational leaders, Shared Services teams and Group Finance.

· Present financial insights, risks and recommendations to senior leadership.

· Act as key liaison with auditors, bankers and insurers.

8. People Leadership & Capability Development

· Lead and develop a high‑performing Financial Reporting team.

· Set goals, conduct performance reviews and manage development plans.

· Build financial modelling, analysis and reporting capability within the team.

· Ensure compliance with Vedanta’s people management, diversity and inclusion standards.

9. Safety, Risk & Compliance

· Ensure all processes, reporting practices and financial governance activities comply with VZI safety standards and statutory requirements.

· Promote a culture of risk awareness, compliance and disciplined financial governance across the Shared Services Finance function.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

Qualifications

· Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field.

· CIMA, CA(SA) or equivalent professional qualification advantageous.

· Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills essential

Experience

· Proven experience managing statutory reporting, external audits and IFRS compliance within a large organisation.

· Experience leading finance teams and engaging with executive management, auditors, lenders and external stakeholders.

· Experience in mining, heavy industry or multi‑site operations advantageous.

· Expertise in financial reporting, IFRS compliance, statutory reporting and consolidation

· Advanced knowledge of HFM/Hyperion, SAP and financial reporting systems

· Proven capability in audit management, financial controls, treasury support, impairment modelling and risk management.

· Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP preferred), BI tools and reporting platforms.

· Knowledge of Vedanta Group Finance Standards (advantageous).

Behavioural

· Strong analytical and problem‑solving ability.

· High attention to detail and accuracy.

· Ability to work under pressure in a fast‑paced mining environment.

· Strong communication and presentation skills.

· Professionalism, integrity and sound judgement.

· Continuous improvement mindset.

Organisational Fit

· Alignment with VZI’s values of trust, entrepreneurship, innovation, excellence, integrity, respect and care.

· Commitment to operational excellence, zero harm, and community upliftment.

· Ability to thrive in a high‑performance, CBP‑integrated environment.
